Its reference instantiation, 128 locked tasks and 987 assertions over document, spreadsheet, chart, tool and database work, stays sealed: the procedure is the artifact, not the corpus. Across eleven systems, four results. Capability availability is measurable: two complete single-route runs on identical weights later failed distinct predicates of the finalized binding gate, while a third passed that gate before a fresh run. The advertised identifier exposed neither limit. Discrimination is not uniform: four of seven suites saturate under a six-system band, with the spread almost entirely from governed database work and multi-tab joins, so we report interval-backed resolution groups, not ranks; two of the nominal five-label output's four cuts fail multiplicity adjustment. Serving-arm choice moved one declared revision and precision from 77.38 to 82.54, paired interval [0.11,10.60], though the arms differ in access mode, harness generation, and the serving tool-call parser, and harness generation is a property of our evaluator, not any endpoint. Excluding failed responses from denominators changes the point ordering, so reliability inclusion changes a conclusion, not its wording.
summary_zh: 企业实际部署的是完整AI系统，而非孤立的模型检查点。系统的可用能力同时由模型权重、服务链路、精度、输出契约与测试框架共同决定，但目前已调研的18个基准评测全部基于公开的模型标识打分。本研究将这类问题定义为测量误差，提出了一套可报告该误差的评测协议，该协议包含三个部分：第一部分是无金标准的能力绑定预检机制，在任务进入执行链路前验证该链路是否可执行评测契约；第二部分是包含可靠性的首轮打分规则，将任务失败纳入最终得分，同时排除不支持的能力项；第三部分是结构上完全盲化的裁决机制。我们将该协议命名为IB2，开源了其算法、分类表、请求契约与清单模式。该协议的参考实现包含128个锁定任务，覆盖文档、电子表格、图表、工具与数据库类工作的987项断言，全程保持密封状态：协议流程本身是核心产出，而非评测语料库。研究在11个系统上开展测试得到四项结论：第一，能力可用性是可测量的：两次在相同权重上执行的完整单链路运行，后续在最终绑定门限处触发了不同的断言失败，而第三个系统在该门限通过后，后续新的运行仍出现失败，这些限制都无法通过公开的模型标识体现；第二，区分度并不均匀：7个测试套件中有4个在6个系统的区间内达到饱和，得分差异几乎全部来自受管控的数据库操作与多表连接任务，因此我们报告带区间支撑的分辨率分组而非排名，标称5标签输出的4个切分中有2个无法通过多重性校正；第三，服务端选择可将某一公开版本的精度从77.38提升至82.54，对应区间为[0.11,10.60]，不同服务端的访问模式、测试框架生成逻辑与服务工具调用解析器均存在差异，其中测试框架生成逻辑属于评测方属性，不属于任何端点属性；第四，将失败响应从分母中排除会改变得分排序，因此将可靠性纳入得分会改变最终结论，而非仅改变表述措辞。

title: JarvisGUI: Towards Cross-Device GUI Agents with Dynamic Task Composition
title_zh: JarvisGUI：面向动态任务组合的跨设备GUI智能体
authors: Zixiang Chen, Yuheng Lu, Zihao Cheng, Zeming Liu, Jizeng Bai 等 (11 人)
abstract: Real-world GUI usage frequently involves workflows that span multiple devices and platforms, requiring the transfer of intermediate results, maintenance of shared state, and coordination across heterogeneous environments. However, existing GUI benchmarks overwhelmingly evaluate agents on single-device, statically defined tasks, thus leaving such cross-device capabilities largely unexamined, resulting in an overly optimistic assessment of agents' readiness for real-world usage. We introduce JarvisGUI, a dynamic benchmark that evaluates GUI agents on cross-device workflows requiring coordinated interaction across heterogeneous platforms, including Android, Windows, and Ubuntu. Specifically, JarvisGUI formulates GUI tasks as input-output transformations under a lightweight type system, which allows us to automatically compose multi-step, cross-device workflows and dynamically evaluate agent performance within a unified framework. By evaluating agents in virtual environments spanning multiple operating systems, JarvisGUI reveals that state-of-the-art open-source GUI agents struggle with the state-transfer awareness, cross-platform contextual reasoning, and long-horizon dependency management required for real-world workflows, exposing a critical capability gap invisible to existing benchmarks.
summary_zh: 真实场景下的GUI使用流程经常涉及跨多设备、多平台的工作流，需要传输中间结果、维护共享状态、在异构环境间完成协同。但现有GUI基准评测几乎全部在单设备、静态定义的任务上评估智能体，导致这类跨设备能力几乎未得到检验，对智能体面向真实场景的就绪度评估过于乐观。本文提出JarvisGUI这一动态基准评测框架，在需要跨Android、Windows、Ubuntu等异构平台协同交互的跨设备工作流上评估GUI智能体。具体而言，JarvisGUI将GUI任务定义为轻量级类型系统下的输入输出变换，可自动组合多步跨设备工作流，在统一框架下动态评估智能体性能。通过在覆盖多操作系统的虚拟环境中评估智能体，JarvisGUI发现当前最先进的开源GUI智能体普遍缺乏真实工作流所需的状态传输感知能力、跨平台上下文推理能力与长时域依赖管理能力，暴露了现有基准评测无法发现的关键能力缺口。

title: ConvMem: Convolutional Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
title_zh: ConvMem：面向长上下文推理的卷积记忆框架
authors: Hongming Zhang, Zhaozhen Gu, Fengshuo Bai, Ming Hao, Qingyang Zhang 等 (9 人)
abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, they often struggle with extremely long contexts due to fixed context limits. To address this, sequential approaches like MemAgent extend the effective context by reading text in segments and iteratively updating a fixed-size memory. However, this sequential paradigm suffers from high latency and requires costly reinforcement learning (RL) training, which can lead to overfitting on specific datasets. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConvMem, a training-free, highly parallelizable framework that reformulates long-context reasoning as a hierarchical convolution. Inspired by CNNs, ConvMem treats an LLM prompted with a specific query as a convolutional kernel. This kernel summarizes text segments hierarchically, shortening the reasoning path from a linear chain into a logarithmic tree. Specifically, ConvMem integrates \textit{Configurable Strides} and \textit{Skip Connections} to ensure robust evidence capture and propagation, while employing \textit{Multi-Kernel Convolution} to decompose complex queries into disentangled semantic channels. This design not only mitigates error accumulation but also enables massive parallelization across both text segments and reasoning threads. Experiments on RULER-HotpotQA and RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA demonstrate that ConvMem outperforms training-free baselines and avoids the risk of overfitting to parametric priors often observed in RL-trained models on out-of-distribution tasks.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）尽管能力出众，但受限于固定上下文窗口，在处理超长上下文任务时仍存在困难。为解决该问题，MemAgent等序列类方法通过分段读取文本、迭代更新固定大小记忆体的方式拓展有效上下文长度，但这类序列范式延迟高，需要成本高昂的强化学习（RL）训练，还可能在特定数据集上出现过拟合。为克服上述缺陷，本文提出ConvMem这一无训练、高度可并行的框架，将长上下文推理重构为层级卷积操作。受卷积神经网络（CNN）启发，ConvMem将加载了特定查询提示的LLM视为卷积核，该卷积核对文本分段进行层级化摘要，将原本的线性链式推理路径缩短为对数树结构。具体而言，ConvMem集成了可配置步长与跳跃连接机制，确保证据的捕获与传播鲁棒，同时采用多核卷积将复杂查询解耦为相互独立的语义通道。该设计不仅缓解了误差累积问题，还支持文本分段与推理线程两个维度的大规模并行。在RULER-HotpotQA与RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA数据集上的实验表明，ConvMem的性能优于无训练基线方法，且在分布外任务上避免了RL训练模型常见的对参数先验过拟合的风险。

title: Forgetting Only What Matters: Layer-Selective Unlearning toward Robust LLMs
title_zh: 仅遗忘关键内容：面向鲁棒大语言模型的层级选择性遗忘方法
authors: Ravi Ranjan, Olivera Kotevska, Agoritsa Polyzou
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or otherwise undesirable training content, creating privacy, safety, and regulatory concerns. Machine unlearning offers a practical alternative to full retraining, but many existing methods apply broad or fixed parameter updates that can degrade utility and remain brittle under deployment changes such as post-training quantization, where forgotten knowledge may partially re-emerge. We propose Forgetting Only What Matters via Unlearning Layers (FOM-UL), a layer-level unlearning framework that selects transformer layers using a forget-to-retain significance score. This score identifies layers with high influence on the forget set and low sensitivity to the retain set, allowing FOM-UL to concentrate updates where they are most effective while leaving most of the model unchanged. This targeted update strategy improves the forgetting-utility trade-off and provides an empirical path toward quantization-resilient unlearning by reducing the chance that small, diffuse updates are erased by low-bit rounding. Across TOFU, KnowUnDo, and MUSE-style evaluations, FOM-UL reduces residual memorization compared with strong GA, NPO, KLD, SURE, ReLearn, and LUNAR-based baselines while preserving retain-set utility close to the vanilla model. Under 8-bit and 4-bit post-training quantization, FOM-UL maintains stronger memorization suppression and utility preservation than competing methods, and adversarial prompt evaluations show lower recovery of forgotten content. Overall, FOM-UL provides an efficient unlearning strategy that improves targeted forgetting, utility preservation, and deployment robustness without claiming formal guarantees of erasure.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可能记忆并复现敏感内容、受版权保护内容或其他不受欢迎的训练数据，引发隐私、安全与合规层面的担忧。机器遗忘是替代全量重训练的实用方案，但现有多数方法采用宽泛或固定的参数更新策略，会损害模型的可用性，且在训练后量化等部署变更场景下鲁棒性差，被遗忘的知识可能部分复现。本文提出FOM-UL（仅遗忘关键内容的层级选择性遗忘框架），该框架通过遗忘-保留显著性得分筛选Transformer层，该得分可识别对遗忘集影响大、对保留集敏感度低的层级，让FOM-UL将更新集中在最有效的位置，同时保持模型大部分参数不变。该靶向更新策略优化了遗忘效果与模型可用性的权衡，还通过降低微小弥散更新被低位舍入操作擦除的概率，为实现抗量化的遗忘提供了可行路径。在TOFU、KnowUnDo与MUSE风格的评测中，与GA、NPO、KLD、SURE、ReLearn、LUNAR等强基线方法相比，FOM-UL降低了残余记忆率，同时保留集上的模型可用性接近原始模型。在8位与4位训练后量化场景下，FOM-UL的记忆抑制能力与可用性保留度均优于对比方法，对抗性提示评估也表明被遗忘内容的复现率更低。整体而言，FOM-UL是一种高效的遗忘策略，在不提供正式擦除保证的前提下，提升了靶向遗忘效果、可用性保留度与部署鲁棒性。

title: Emergency Department Revisit Quality Review Screening: Exploring Human Decision-Making and Artificial Intelligence Support
title_zh: 急诊复诊质量评审筛查：人类决策与人工智能支持的探索性研究
authors: Jonathan A. Handler, Marlene I. Robles-Granda, Jacob E. Mefford, Jeremy S. McGarvey, Gregory S. Podolej 等 (8 人)
abstract: Background: Emergency Department (ED) return visits are commonly reviewed for quality assurance, but are often limited (e.g., to revisits within 48-72 hours) to increase actionable finding yield while minimizing chart review burden. Those limitations may lead to missed quality improvement opportunities.Methods: We conducted an exploratory, retrospective study of randomly selected ED visits to a multihospital health system having an ED revisit within 1-14 days to the same health system. Given only each visit's primary diagnosis, raters (2-3 clinicians and GPT-4 large language model [LLM]) assessed characteristics of the diagnosis pairs, including the "target": whether a pair warranted further assessment. Informed by rater response analyses, an algorithm leveraging an LLM-populated knowledge graph ("KGA") was created to automatically screen for potentially concerning pairs, then preliminarily assessed.Results: 99 diagnosis pairs were included. GPT-4 responses poorly correlated to clinician raters, rating nearly all (94%) pairs as warranting follow-up (4.4-13.3 times more than clinicians). However, prompt engineering was minimal. Among clinician raters, revisit medical gravity was consistently significantly associated with the target, while a differential diagnosis/complication composite was significantly associated on unadjusted, but not adjusted (though less powered) analysis. The KGA achieved 83-100% positive predictive value for at least one clinician rater determining further assessment was warranted based on the diagnosis pair.Conclusion: These results can inform next steps for improving screening with LLMs like ChatGPT. Further research is warranted to validate this preliminary work's finding that the KGA may enable enhancing the scope and yield of screening without substantially increasing reviewer workload.
summary_zh: 背景：急诊（ED）返诊通常需要接受质量保证评审，但现有评审大多限制在48-72小时内的复诊，以提升可落地问题的发现率，同时降低病历评审负担。这类限制可能导致质量改进机会被遗漏。方法：本研究开展了一项探索性回顾性研究，研究对象为某多院区医疗系统内随机抽取的、1-14天内返回同一医疗系统急诊的就诊记录。仅提供每次就诊的主诊断信息，由2-3名临床医生与GPT-4大语言模型（LLM）作为标注员，评估诊断对的特征，包括核心标注项：该诊断对是否值得进一步评审。基于标注员的响应分析结果，本研究开发了一套基于LLM填充的知识图谱（KGA）的算法，自动筛查潜在高风险诊断对并开展初步评估。结果：研究共纳入99组诊断对。GPT-4的标注结果与临床医生标注结果相关性很低，它将几乎全部（94%）的诊断对判定为值得跟进，数量是临床医生判定结果的4.4-13.3倍，但本研究仅做了极简的提示工程。在临床标注员的结果中，复诊的医疗严重程度始终与核心标注项显著相关，而鉴别诊断/并发症综合指标仅在未校正分析中显著，在校正分析中无显著相关性（但校正分析统计效力更低）。KGA算法的阳性预测值达到83%-100%，即至少有一名临床医生认为该诊断对值得进一步评估的命中比例。结论：本研究结果可为后续优化ChatGPT等LLM的筛查流程提供参考，后续有必要开展进一步研究验证本初步工作的结论：KGA可在不显著增加评审人员工作负担的前提下，扩大筛查的覆盖范围与发现率。

title: Fortunate Recall: Ontology-Driven Memory Lifecycle Management for Persistent Coherence in LLMs
title_zh: Fortunate Recall：基于本体驱动的记忆生命周期管理实现大语言模型的持久一致性
authors: Ansuman Mullick, Eray Tüzün
abstract: Current LLM memory systems treat all personal facts identically, so stores grow without bound while retrieval precision degrades. The core challenge is lifecycle management: which memories should persist, which should be replaced, and at what rate, conditioned on the behavioral type of each fact. Fortunate Recall (FR) is a composable policy layer that classifies personal facts into a 10+1 behavioral ontology and applies category-specific lifecycle policies (differential temporal decay, slot-key supersession, event-time validity, and category-aware retrieval routing) as deterministic functions over LLM-extracted metadata. FR-Bank, our infrastructure-independent implementation, reaches a 76.9% pass rate on LifecycleBench, a new 516-question temporal-disambiguation benchmark, ahead of Mem0, A-MEM, Memory-R1, and MemoryOS (61% to 70.5%), and 75.2% on the full LongMemEval-S under the canonical Wu et al. judge protocol, so lifecycle policies impose no measurable cost on standard retrieval. A pre-registered ablation locates the gains: replacing the typed layer with three generic lifecycle primitives leaves correctness statistically unchanged (-1.7pp, 95% CI [-6.0, +2.7]), so the generic lifecycle metadata carries the correctness advantage, while the behavioral ontology carries calibration, halving downstream confabulation (12.0% vs 24.2%, p<0.001). End-to-end, FR-Bank cuts confabulation from Mem0's 45.1% to 22.4% over answered queries and from 32.2% to 13.0% over all queries while answering more of them correctly (31.2% vs 18.6%); the ranking replicates on the open-weight Kimi K2.5. The decomposition transfers to BEAM, an independently built benchmark: 46.8% correct vs Mem0's 32.9% over 280 questions, with the ontology's benefit concentrated in contradiction resolution and saturating near seven policy clusters. The ontology, benchmark, and code are released.
summary_zh: 现有大语言模型记忆系统对所有个人事实的处理方式完全相同，导致记忆存储无限制增长，检索精度持续下降。该领域的核心挑战是生命周期管理：需要根据每个事实的行为类型，确定哪些记忆应当保留、哪些应当被替换、替换的速率是多少。Fortunate Recall（FR）是一套可组合的策略层，它将个人事实分类到包含11个类别的行为本体中，针对不同类别应用差异化的生命周期策略（差异化时间衰减、槽键替换、事件时间有效性、类别感知的检索路由），所有策略都作为基于LLM提取元数据的确定性函数执行。本研究实现的基础设施无关版本FR-Bank在新提出的包含516个问题的时间消歧基准LifecycleBench上通过率达到76.9%，优于Mem0、A-MEM、Memory-R1、MemoryOS等基线（得分区间61%-70.5%）；在标准Wu等人评判协议下的完整LongMemEval-S基准上通过率为75.2%，说明生命周期策略不会对标准检索性能造成可测量的负面影响。预先注册的消融实验明确了性能提升的来源：将类型层替换为3种通用生命周期原语后，准确率的变化在统计上不显著（-1.7个百分点，95%置信区间[-6.0, +2.7]），说明通用生命周期元数据带来了准确率优势，而行为本体带来了校准收益，可将下游的幻觉率减半（12.0% vs 24.2%，p<0.001）。端到端实验表明，FR-Bank将回答查询的幻觉率从Mem0的45.1%降至22.4%，将所有查询的幻觉率从32.2%降至13.0%，同时正确回答的占比更高（31.2% vs 18.6%）；该性能排名在开源模型Kimi K2.5上也得到了复现。该分解结论在独立构建的基准BEAM上也得到验证：在280个问题上准确率为46.8%，优于Mem0的32.9%，本体的收益主要集中在矛盾消解场景，在接近7个策略簇时收益达到饱和。本文开源了相关本体、基准与代码。

title: Can Foundation Models Moderate Online Content? Evaluating Instruction- vs. Example-Driven Policy Operationalization
title_zh: 基础模型能否完成在线内容审核？评估指令驱动与示例驱动的策略落地范式
authors: Ayan Majumdar, Shounak Paul, Pushpdeep Singh, Ines Abdelaziz, Sayeh Jarollahi 等 (9 人)
abstract: The growing complexity of content moderation policies presents a critical challenge for their consistent operationalization. While foundation models possess the basic capabilities needed to confront this challenge, whether they can reliably moderate online content remains an unanswered question. In this paper, we systematically compare two competing paradigms for Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance: an instruction-driven approach where models reason from policy precepts, and an example-driven approach where they generalize from prior precedents. We ground this investigation in ModerationBench, a new benchmark of 4,000 manually annotated, in-the-wild posts from the Bluesky platform. Our experiments reveal that foundation models can substantially outperform Bluesky's deployed moderation system, nearly tripling its $F_1$ score (0.60 vs. 0.22) on Random Posts in the benchmark, with both instruction- and example-driven paradigms achieving comparable peak effectiveness. Our findings thus chart a path toward reliable and adaptable policy operationalization at scale.
summary_zh: 内容审核策略的复杂度不断提升，为策略的一致落地带来了严峻挑战。尽管基础模型具备应对该挑战的基础能力，但它们能否可靠地完成在线内容审核仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本文系统对比了两种指导视觉语言模型（VLM）的竞争范式：第一种是指令驱动范式，模型基于审核策略规则开展推理；第二种是示例驱动范式，模型从过往先例中泛化出审核规则。本研究基于新提出的基准ModerationBench开展实验，该基准包含4000条来自Bluesky平台的人工标注真实帖子。实验结果表明，基础模型的性能可大幅超越Bluesky当前部署的审核系统，在基准的随机帖子子集上F1得分接近后者的3倍（0.60 vs 0.22），且指令驱动与示例驱动两种范式的峰值性能相当。本研究结果为大规模场景下可靠、自适应的审核策略落地提供了可行路径。

title: MOONWALK: Mediating Operations with Intent-Evidence-Action Alignment Across Junior-Supervisor Review Workflows in Animation/VFX Pre-Production
title_zh: MOONWALK：动画/视觉特效（VFX）前期制作上下级评审工作流中实现意图-证据-行动对齐的调度系统
authors: Shih-Yu Lai, Wen-Fan Wang, Sai Ling, Shaune Jan, Bing-Yu Chen 等 (6 人)
abstract: Animation and VFX pre-production review requires teams to translate loosely specified creative intent--briefs, evolving specifications, heterogeneous references, and verbal decisions--into revisions that junior artists can execute without repeated clarification. In practice, criteria drift across iterations, review judgments lose their evidential basis, and the reasoning behind a request rarely survives the senior-junior handoff. We contribute a design framework for intent-evidence-action alignment: intent is articulated into a shared project record, judgments are anchored to grounded evidence, and authorized decisions are converted into clear revision tasks tied directly to reference notes. We instantiate this framework in MOONWALK, a professional pre-production review system comprising a shared intent record, reference/specification anchoring, structured work-in-progress comparison, and supervisor-authorized action planning. In this workflow, AI handles administrative coordination--flagging missing context and organizing notes--while artists retain full creative direction. An in-studio study with professional practitioners compares MOONWALK with a chat-only (chatbot) interface using matched production materials, while participants' existing workflows provide a retrospective ecological baseline. Results indicate stronger intent alignment, decision traceability, and checklist executability, while also showing that aesthetic authority and final prioritization must remain with practitioners. The evaluation establishes the value of the integrated structured workflow over unstructured conversational AI chatbot. Code:this https URL
summary_zh: 动画与VFX前期制作评审需要团队将表述松散的创意意图（包括创意简报、迭代中的规范文档、异构参考资料和口头决策）转化为初级艺术家可直接执行的修改方案，避免反复澄清。实践中，评审标准会随迭代发生偏移，评审判断失去证据支撑，需求背后的推理逻辑很少能在上下级交接过程中完整留存。本文提出了意图-证据-行动对齐的设计框架：将意图明确录入共享项目记录，评审判断锚定到可溯源的证据，授权决策转化为与参考注释直接绑定的清晰修改任务。我们将该框架落地为MOONWALK这一专业前期制作评审系统，包含共享意图记录、参考/规范锚定、结构化在制品对比、主管授权行动规划四大模块。该工作流中AI负责行政协调工作，包括标记缺失上下文、整理笔记，艺术家完全保留创意主导权。我们使用匹配的生产素材在专业从业者群体中开展工作室实测研究，将MOONWALK与仅支持聊天的聊天机器人界面进行对比，同时将参与者原有工作流作为回溯性生态基线。结果表明，MOONWALK可实现更强的意图对齐度、决策可追溯性和任务清单可执行性，同时也确认审美决策权和最终优先级排序权必须保留在从业者手中。该评估验证了集成化结构化工作流相比非结构化对话式AI聊天机器人的价值。代码见提供的链接。

title: OmniMed-FL: A Robust Multimodal Federated Learning Framework for Clinical Diagnosis
title_zh: OmniMed-FL：面向临床诊断的鲁棒多模态联邦学习框架
authors: Ayush Debnath, Ruelia Saha, Sudip Misra
abstract: Simultaneous assessment of medical imaging and patient records is often required in clinical diagnosis. However, standard machine learning algorithms cannot analyze these data types together. Meanwhile, compliance with HIPAA and GDPR can constrain centralized aggregation of sensitive patient data. This leaves a crucial void of secure fusion of visual and textual context across distant networks. Thus, we present OmniMed-FL, a controlled systems study of multimodal federated learning for five-class clinical condition classification (Normal, Pneumonia, COVID-19, Pleural Effusion, Cardiomegaly). Our proxy corpus pairs 3,000 public chest radiographs with 3,000 class-conditioned synthetic notes, matched by class, not by patient. The framework benchmarks eight fusion strategies, three initializations, four missing-text imputation rules, and matched federated baselines under non-IID Dirichlet partitioning across 3 to 20 hospital clients. As all notes are synthetic and pairing is not patient-level, these are descriptive proxy comparisons, not estimates of diagnostic performance or deployment readiness. Within those limits with clients ($K=5$) and severe skew ($\alpha=0.1$), local-only training achieves a macro-F1 score of 0.297, FedAvg achieves $0.662\pm0.074$, FedProx $0.737\pm0.085$, a matched FedMME-style one-shot ensemble $0.647\pm0.080$, and our SCAFFOLD-AdamW adaptation $0.070\pm0.015$, the 0.075 FedProx-FedAvg gap falling inside the wider of the two two-seed standard deviations. Over a $4\times3$ grid, label skew costs up to 0.27 F1 whereas a near-sevenfold client increase costs at most 0.10, while bidirectional volume grows linearly to 183.5 GiB at $K=20$. Multimodal fusion leads on both corpora, scoring 0.956 against 0.934 for text and 0.664 for images on the synthetic corpus and 0.906 against 0.880 and 0.737 on the radiograph corpus, for $2.3\times$ the model state of text alone.
summary_zh: 临床诊断通常需要同时评估医学影像和患者病历，但传统机器学习算法无法同时分析这两类数据。同时，HIPAA（健康保险流通与责任法案）和GDPR（通用数据保护条例）的合规要求限制了敏感患者数据的集中聚合，导致跨远程网络的视觉与文本上下文安全融合领域存在显著的研究空白。为此，本文提出OmniMed-FL，一套面向五类临床状态分类（正常、肺炎、新冠、胸腔积液、心脏肥大）的多模态联邦学习受控系统研究方案。我们构建的代理语料库将3000张公开胸部X光片与3000条按类别匹配而非按患者匹配的类别条件合成病历配对。该框架在3到20个医院客户端的非独立同分布狄利克雷划分场景下，对8种融合策略、3种初始化方案、4种文本缺失值插补规则以及匹配的联邦基线方法进行了基准测试。由于所有病历均为合成数据且配对不涉及患者层级，本研究仅为描述性代理对比，不代表诊断性能或部署就绪度的评估结果。在客户端数量K=5、分布严重偏移α=0.1的限制条件下，仅本地训练的宏F1值为0.297，FedAvg算法为0.662±0.074，FedProx算法为0.737±0.085，匹配FedMME风格的一次性集成方法为0.647±0.080，本文提出的SCAFFOLD-AdamW适配方案为0.707±0.015，FedProx与FedAvg之间0.075的性能差距落在两个双种子标准差的较大区间内。在4×3的参数网格测试中，标签偏移最多可导致F1值下降0.27，而客户端数量提升近7倍最多仅导致F1值下降0.10，双向通信量在K=20时线性增长至183.5GiB。多模态融合在两类语料上均表现最优：在合成语料上得分0.956，优于纯文本的0.934和纯图像的0.664；在X光片语料上得分0.906，优于纯文本的0.880和纯图像的0.737，模型参数量仅为纯文本模型的2.3倍。

title: Cyber-Financial Contagion: Modeling the Propagation of an AI Vendor Compromise Through the Banking System
title_zh: 网络金融传染：AI供应商入侵在银行系统中的传播建模
authors: Alex Leytes
abstract: The banking system now depends on a small set of shared artificial intelligence vendors for fraud screening, credit decisioning, anti-money-laundering triage, customer analytics, and internal decision support. This paper studies how a compromise inside one of those vendors can propagate along a chain of operational, informational, and financial linkages until it triggers losses that look, from the outside, like a classical banking crisis. We build a four-layer heterogeneous network that couples AI vendors, financial institutions, interbank exposures, and customer accounts, and we propose CFC-Prop, a stochastic epidemic-and-clearing model that runs on that network. On a synthetic dataset with 60 vendors, 220 banks, roughly 2,500 vendor-bank service edges, and 1,400 interbank exposures, CFC-Prop reproduces the heavy-tailed loss distributions and the sharp dependence on patch latency that are consistent with prior cyber-financial evidence. We also train an early-warning model, CFC-GNN, that uses vendor-side incident telemetry and graph structure to flag high-cascade-risk vendors before impact. Across four baselines the proposed model reaches AUROC 0.82 and AUPRC 0.60 while keeping calibration errors bounded. We release the full code, synthetic data, and reproducible scripts. The results argue that cyber concentration among AI vendors is a first-order financial-stability problem and give supervisors a concrete quantitative tool for reasoning about it.
summary_zh: 当前银行系统依赖少数共享的人工智能供应商提供欺诈筛查、信贷决策、反洗钱分诊、客户分析和内部决策支持服务。本文研究这类供应商内部发生入侵事件后，如何沿着运营、信息和金融关联链传播，最终触发从外部看与传统银行危机特征一致的损失。我们构建了耦合AI供应商、金融机构、银行间风险敞口和客户账户的四层异质网络，并提出在该网络上运行的随机流行病-清算模型CFC-Prop。在包含60个供应商、220家银行、约2500条供应商-银行服务边和1400个银行间风险敞口的合成数据集上，CFC-Prop复现了与过往网络金融事件证据一致的重尾损失分布，以及对补丁延迟的强依赖特性。我们还训练了预警模型CFC-GNN，利用供应商侧事件遥测数据和图结构在事件造成影响前标记高传播风险供应商。与4种基线方法相比，本文提出的模型AUROC达到0.82，AUPRC达到0.60，且校准误差保持在有界范围内。我们公开了全部代码、合成数据和可复现脚本。研究结果表明，AI供应商领域的网络安全集中度是影响金融稳定性的一级风险，可为监管机构提供可落地的量化分析工具。

title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
title_zh: 从符号感知到逻辑演绎：引导大语言模型完成几何推理的框架
authors: Weichen Dai, Rafael Medeiros Cabral, Ziyi Shou, Yan Cao, Xin Shen 等 (7 人)
abstract: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.
summary_zh: 平面几何是人工智能领域的重大挑战，需要融合视觉感知与数学推理能力。多模态大模型（LMM）虽然天然支持视觉-语言输入，但通常计算开销大且推理过程不透明。本文证明，纯大语言模型（LLM）在配备专用模块后，在复杂几何问题上的表现可与当前最先进的多模态大模型相媲美。我们提出的框架集成了几何视觉解析器与符号求解器：前者将几何图表转化为符号形式，后者执行形式化演绎，从而减少幻觉、提升推理可解释性。为实现严谨评估，我们从2025年中国中考题中筛选出高难度问题构建基准数据集，保证数据新颖性并测试模型的深度演绎能力。实验表明，本文方法的性能与Gemini 2.5 Pro相当，同时输出的解答更清晰、更符合人类思维习惯。

title: TRACE: Training Reasoning Agents for Causal Exploration with Synthesized Rewards
title_zh: TRACE：基于合成奖励训练因果探索推理智能体的框架
authors: Rui Sun, Zhan Shi, Bing He
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has advanced language-model reasoning in domains such as mathematics and code, where objective answers are inexpensive to check. Diagnostic reasoning over complex data lacks this advantage: establishing the true cause of an anomaly often requires costly expert investigation and may remain ambiguous after the fact. We ask whether this asymmetry of verification can instead be engineered. We sample an intervention, inject it into a controlled simulator, and generate the observations it would produce. The hidden intervention provides an oracle label and objective reward, while the agent must still investigate noisy, confounded, and distributed evidence.We instantiate this approach in TRACE, a digital-advertising diagnostic environment with 12 root causes and fine-grained segment attribution. Agents investigate each episode using Python and SQL and must identify both the root cause and, when applicable, the affected segment assignment. On a held-out 235-episode test set, the strongest prompted baseline, Claude Opus 5, reaches 0.686 FullAttr@1. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3.5-35B-A3B from 0.159 to 0.637, and subsequent RL with synthesized rewards reaches 0.757, outperforming all evaluated prompted baselines, including frontier closed-source models and a prompted Qwen3.5-122B-A10B model. The resulting policy also uses substantially fewer tool calls than the prompted 35B base. These results provide evidence that access to a scalable, objective training signal can be a more important constraint than model scale alone. More broadly, simulation-based verification can make otherwise ambiguous diagnostic reasoning tasks amenable to scalable reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 具备可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已推动大语言模型在数学、代码等领域的推理能力取得进展，这类领域的客观答案校验成本极低。但复杂数据的诊断推理不具备该优势：确定异常的根本原因通常需要成本高昂的专家调查，且事后仍可能存在歧义。本文探索能否对这种验证不对称性进行工程化利用：我们采样一个干预事件，将其注入受控模拟器，生成该干预会产生的观测结果，隐藏的干预事件同时提供了真值标签和客观奖励，而智能体仍需要对含噪、存在混淆因素、分布式的证据开展调查。我们将该方法落地为TRACE，一个面向数字广告诊断的环境，包含12个根本原因和细粒度的受众分段归因功能。智能体在每个交互轮次中使用Python和SQL开展调查，必须同时识别根本原因以及适用场景下的受影响分段分配。在包含235个轮次的留出测试集上，性能最优的提示基线模型Claude Opus 5的FullAttr@1得分达到0.686；经过监督微调后，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的得分从0.159提升至0.637，后续使用合成奖励开展强化学习后得分达到0.757，性能超过所有参与评估的提示基线模型，包括前沿闭源模型和经过提示工程的Qwen3.5-122B-A10B模型。最终得到的策略相比经过提示工程的35B基础模型，工具调用次数大幅减少。该结果证明，可扩展的客观训练信号是比模型规模本身更重要的约束条件。更广泛地说，基于模拟的验证可让原本存在歧义的诊断推理任务适配可扩展的强化学习方案。

title: RiLM: Parameter-Efficient Language Modeling via Geodesic Decoding
title_zh: RiLM：基于测地线解码的参数高效语言模型
authors: Fang Li
abstract: Language models under one million parameters matter for edge deployment, domain adaptation, and reproducible research, yet a two-layer LSTM or Transformer at embedding width d = 128 still spends roughly one third of its capacity on the output matrix W_out in R^(d x |V|). We propose Riemannian Language Models (RiLM), which remove that layer entirely: context unfolds as a trajectory on a Riemannian manifold, and next-token probabilities arise from squared geodesic distance between the current state and vocabulary embeddings. The same embedding map serves input and output -- decoding is geometry. We instantiate the framework on flat R^d (Flat RiLM) and the Poincare ball H^d (HypRiLM) with a shared MLP composition map phi (~290k parameters, d = 128, |V| = 2000). Across five seeds on WikiText-2, HypRiLM reaches 54.2 +/- 0.2 validation perplexity versus 87.6 +/- 0.6 for Flat RiLM; tied and matched LSTM, Transformer, and SSM controls remain at 113-147 PPL on WT-2 -- HypRiLM leads by roughly 2x over the strongest tied recurrent baseline (SSM, 113.0 +/- 3.8). Penn Treebank and a 10k-vocabulary stress test confirm that geodesic decoding transfers across corpora and larger |V|, while hyperbolic curvature helps selectively. We also characterize boundary collapse in naive hyperbolic recurrence and show how Mobius stabilization restores trainability. Claims are scoped to controlled small-model comparisons, not full-vocabulary state of the art.
summary_zh: 参数量小于100万的语言模型在边缘部署、领域适配和可复现研究场景中具备重要价值，但嵌入维度d=128的两层LSTM或Transformer模型仍有约三分之一的容量被维度为d×|V|的输出矩阵W_out占用。本文提出黎曼语言模型（RiLM），完全移除了该输出层：上下文以黎曼流形上的轨迹形式展开，下一个词的概率由当前状态与词表嵌入之间的平方测地线距离生成。输入和输出共享同一个嵌入映射，解码过程完全基于几何运算。我们在欧几里得空间R^d（Flat RiLM）和庞加莱球H^d（HypRiLM）上分别实例化该框架，共享MLP组合映射φ的参数量约为29万，d=128，词表大小|V|=2000。在WikiText-2数据集上的5次不同随机种子测试中，HypRiLM的验证集困惑度达到54.2±0.2，而Flat RiLM为87.6±0.6；作为对照的LSTM、Transformer、结构化状态空间序列模型（SSM）的困惑度在113-147区间，HypRiLM的性能比最强的对照基线SSM（113.0±3.8）高出约1倍。在Penn Treebank数据集和词表大小为1万的压力测试上的结果验证了测地线解码可跨语料和更大词表规模迁移，双曲曲率可带来选择性性能提升。我们还分析了朴素双曲循环模型中的边界坍缩问题，证明莫比乌斯稳定化方法可恢复模型的可训练性。本研究的结论限定于受控小模型对比场景，不代表全词表规模下的当前最优水平。

title: Learning Intrusion Response Strategies for OT Systems
title_zh: 面向运营技术（OT）系统的入侵响应策略学习
authors: Duc Huy Le, Rolf Stadler
abstract: Cyberattacks against Operational Technology (OT) systems, which monitor and control industrial processes, pose an increasing threat to essential societal services. For this reason, developing automated intrusion response strategies is highly important. In this paper, we present a formal model of an OT intrusion response use case using the POMDP framework. It includes a realistic model of partial observability that is based on traffic measurements. This approach allows us to develop tractable, learning-based solution methods for automated intrusion response, which are based on PPO. We evaluate the obtained response strategies on an emulated OT system and find that they are effective against several types of MITRE attacks for the studied use case.
summary_zh: 针对监控和控制工业流程的运营技术（OT）系统的网络攻击，正对社会基础服务构成日益严重的威胁，因此开发自动化入侵响应策略具有极高的重要性。本文采用部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）框架构建了OT入侵响应用例的形式化模型，其中包含基于流量测量的符合真实场景的部分可观测性建模。基于该方法，我们开发了基于PPO算法的可落地学习式自动化入侵响应求解方案。我们在仿真OT系统上对得到的响应策略开展评估，结果表明在测试用例场景下，该策略可有效防御多种MITRE定义的攻击类型。

title: GANDR: Claim Auditing for Verifiable Legal Answer Generation
title_zh: GANDR：面向可验证法律答案生成的主张审计系统
authors: Chen Qian, Yimeng Wang, Yu Chen, Lingfei Wu, Andreas Stathopoulos
abstract: In high-stakes domains such as legal practice, a language-model answer is only useful to the extent that a reader can verify each claim against the source the system cites. Current grounded-generation pipelines score the answer as a whole, so a correct conclusion can rest on fabricated or loosely matched citations and still score well. Closing this gap requires both a system built for per-claim verification and an evaluation that measures it. We introduce GANDR (Grounded ANswer DRafter), a two-agent system in which a Drafter writes an answer in a structured legal-reasoning format and a separate Critic, with the same view as a human verifier, audits each claim against its cited source and emits a per-claim audit trace on every round. We pair it with a strict correctness criterion requiring every citation to resolve to a passage the retriever returned. On a 185-item legal benchmark where all six systems share one backbone, one retrieval surface, and one citation instruction, GANDR ranks first on every primary metric, reaching 70.8% strict accuracy and leading the strongest baseline by 11.3 points (p<0.01). Reverting the protocol-anchored commit rule lowers strict accuracy by 22.7 points, and the strict lead stays positive on three further backbones, at +3.2 to +6.5 points. This lead traces to the Drafter configuration and the protocol-anchored commit, not to rewriting. Against two law-trained annotators the audit flags under-supported claims at F1 0.84 as a binary detector, while its four-way verdict labels agree only weakly and are advisory. Code is available upon request.
summary_zh: 在法律实践等高风险领域，大语言模型生成的答案只有当读者能够对照系统引用的来源逐一核验每个主张时才具备实用价值。当前的 grounded 生成流水线会对答案整体打分，因此正确的结论可能建立在伪造或松散匹配的引用之上，仍能获得较高得分。填补这一空白需要同时构建支持逐主张核验的系统和对应的评估方案。本文提出GANDR（结构化法律答案生成器），一个双智能体系统：起草智能体按照结构化法律推理格式撰写答案，独立的评审智能体以与人类核验者完全相同的信息视图对照引用来源审计每一个主张，每轮生成逐主张审计轨迹。我们为其配套了严格的正确性判定标准，要求每一条引用都必须对应检索器返回的相关段落。在包含185个样本的法律基准测试集上，6个参与对比的系统共享同一个骨干模型、同一个检索资源和同一份引用指令，GANDR在所有核心指标上排名第一，严格准确率达到70.8%，比最强基线高出11.3个百分点（p<0.01）。移除协议锚定的提交规则后，GANDR的严格准确率下降22.7个百分点，在另外3个骨干模型上仍保持3.2到6.5个百分点的性能优势。该性能优势来源于起草智能体的配置和协议锚定提交规则，而非答案重写。与两位受过法律训练的标注员相比，该审计系统作为二分类检测器识别证据不足主张的F1值达到0.84，但其四类判定标签的一致性较弱，仅作为参考性建议使用。代码可通过申请获取。

title: What Should an Agent Forget? Separating What Is Stored from What Is Used
title_zh: 智能体应当遗忘什么？区分存储内容与使用内容的框架
authors: Yuhang Li, Yuchen Li
abstract: Persistent language agents need stored experience to remain available across time, while each answer requires evidence suited to a particular question. A superseded fact can mislead a current-state answer and still be essential for a historical query. We present RD-Forget, a training-free framework that separates what an agent stores from what it uses. A retained source archive preserves observations, and a query-conditioned memory view controls their influence on the current answer. A frozen language-model curator extracts relevant evidence, groups facts into semantic slots, and preserves the relations needed for multi-hop reasoning. Same-slot replacement links suppress superseded values in current-state contexts, while intent-aware retrieval makes earlier evidence eligible again. A rate-distortion formulation guides construction of the answer-time view within a memory budget. Experiments span conversational memory, knowledge updating, fact consolidation, long-context reasoning, and personalization under a shared answering pipeline. The results associate accurate answers with both query-relevant evidence construction and control over obsolete alternatives. Configurations without forgetting or query conditioning have the largest score deficits, while slot grouping, historical access, and relation preservation contribute complementary functions. Retaining history while selectively controlling its use offers a practical way to accommodate changing facts and future questions.
summary_zh: 持久化语言智能体需要长期留存历史经验，而回答特定问题时又需要匹配对应场景的证据。已经过时的事实可能误导当前状态下的回答，但对于历史查询场景仍具备重要价值。本文提出RD-Forget，一种无需训练的框架，用于分离智能体的存储内容与使用内容：留存的原始资源档案完整保存所有观测数据，查询条件化的内存视图控制这些观测数据对当前答案的影响。冻结的大语言模型管理员提取相关证据，将事实分组到语义槽中，保留多跳推理所需的关联关系。同槽替换链接会在当前状态上下文中抑制过时的取值，而感知意图的检索机制可让早期证据重新获得使用权限。率失真优化框架指导在内存预算范围内构建回答时刻的内存视图。我们在统一的回答流水线中开展了覆盖对话记忆、知识更新、事实整合、长上下文推理和个性化场景的实验。结果表明，准确的回答同时依赖于查询相关证据的构建和对过时备选内容的控制。未配置遗忘机制或查询条件化机制的模型性能损失最大，而语义槽分组、历史访问权限和关联关系保留分别提供了互补的功能。完整留存历史同时选择性控制其使用方式，是适配不断变化的事实和未来未知查询的可行方案。

title: DiSCo: A Distribution-First Steering and Cultural Prior Evaluation Framework for Measuring Cultural Preference Bias in LLMs
title_zh: DiSCo：面向大语言模型文化偏好偏差测量的分布优先引导与文化先验评估框架
authors: Bhuvan Arora, Devesh Saraogi, Sravya Varada, Dhruv Kumar
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in globally used assistants, yet their default choices in culturally grounded everyday situations can systematically favour some cultures over others, affecting localisation, user trust, and equitable behaviour. Existing cultural benchmarks evaluate accuracy against a single "correct" answer, making it difficult to characterise an LLM's cultural preference prior when multiple culturally grounded responses are all valid; they also conflate default preferences with context-driven adaptation. We propose DiSCo, a distribution-first forced-choice evaluation framework that isolates default cultural priors and tests steerability via a four-level context gradient (C0--C3). Using DiSCo-Bench (304 items) derived from BLEnD spanning 12 cultures, we evaluate six diverse instruction-tuned LLMs. Default priors are heavily concentrated, with UK and US together absorbing approximately 35\% of all selections despite representing only 2 of 12 cultures. Most critically, prompt-based steering consistently widens the selection gap between high- and low-resource cultures, and injecting explicit cultural facts produces negligible distributional disruption, confirming that cultural preference bias cannot be resolved through prompt-based personalisation alone.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在全球通用助手场景中，但其在文化相关日常场景中的默认选择可能系统性地偏向部分文化，对本地化效果、用户信任度和行为公平性造成负面影响。现有的文化基准测试基于单一“正确”答案评估准确率，难以表征多个符合文化背景的响应均有效时大模型的文化偏好先验，同时还会将默认偏好与上下文驱动的适配行为混淆。本文提出DiSCo，一种分布优先的强制选择评估框架，可隔离大模型的默认文化先验，并通过四级上下文梯度（C0-C3）测试模型的可引导性。我们使用从覆盖12种文化的BLEnD数据集衍生的DiSCo-Bench（共304个样本）对6个不同的指令微调大模型开展评估。结果表明，大模型的默认先验高度集中，英美两国文化尽管仅占12种文化中的2种，却占据了约35%的选择占比。最关键的是，基于提示的引导操作持续扩大高资源文化与低资源文化之间的选择差距，注入显式文化事实几乎不会改变分布结果，证明仅靠提示层面的个性化无法解决文化偏好偏差问题。

title: A-JIT: Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction
title_zh: A-JIT：智能体即时软件构造
authors: Mark Marron, Earl T. Barr
abstract: Traditional software delivery assumes a static paradigm: code is constructed prior to execution and deployed as a fixed artifact. We present Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction (A-JIT), a paradigm that replaces static binaries with dynamic, software systems that can perpetually evolve to meet changing demands. In A-JIT, an application is an integrated assembly comprising code, a runtime harness, and an embedded AI agent that continuously observes system usage and live execution traces. Much like a traditional JIT compiler specializes machine code to runtime execution paths, A-JIT specializes software logic, workflows, and tool interfaces to meet the specific needs of the end-user. By integrating synthesis directly into the ambient application lifecycle, A-JIT enables applications to dynamically construct missing implementations, generate new capabilities on the fly, and continuously adapt to end-user behavior. We demonstrate how this model supports trace-driven human-AI co-construction and opens a new design space for adaptive, self-evolving software.
summary_zh: 传统软件交付采用静态范式：代码在执行前完成构建，以固定工件的形式部署。本文提出智能体即时软件构造（Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction, A-JIT）范式，该范式用可不断演进以适配动态需求的动态软件系统替代静态二进制文件。在A-JIT架构中，应用是由代码、运行时框架和嵌入式AI智能体共同组成的集成组件，该嵌入式AI智能体可持续观测系统使用情况与实时执行轨迹。与传统JIT（即时）编译器针对运行时执行路径对机器码进行特化优化类似，A-JIT可针对终端用户的特定需求对软件逻辑、工作流和工具接口进行特化。通过将代码生成直接集成到周边应用生命周期中，A-JIT支持应用动态补全缺失的实现逻辑、实时生成新能力，并持续适配终端用户行为。本文验证了该模型可支持轨迹驱动的人机协同构造，为自适应、自演化软件开辟了全新的设计空间。

title: LiteRAG: Cost-Efficient Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: LiteRAG：低成本高效图基检索增强生成
authors: Daniel Alejandro Coll Tejeda, Pedro García López, Daniel Barcelona-Pons
abstract: Graph-based retrieval can improve multi-hop question answering, but existing approaches often incur high query-time costs and produce diffuse, oversized contexts that reduce generation efficiency. We present LiteRAG, a graph-based retrieval method that replaces expensive retrieval-time LLM control with query-conditioned algorithmic exploration and reasoning-chain context construction. On DistComp, a benchmark for multi-hop retrieval over distributed-systems papers, LiteRAG attains the highest overall quality among the evaluated methods (0.798) while reducing per-query latency by over 100$\times$ and cost by over 99% relative to GraphRAG Global and DRIFT. On UltraDomain, it matches LinearRAG on overall quality while using about 14$\times$ fewer tokens. An ablation study indicates that LiteRAG's query-adaptive thresholding and community-aware hub penalization are the main drivers of its token-efficiency gains.
summary_zh: 基于图的检索技术可提升多跳问答性能，但现有方法通常查询时延成本高，且生成的上下文分散、体量过大，会降低生成效率。本文提出LiteRAG——一种基于图的检索方法，该方法采用查询条件化的算法探索与推理链上下文构建，替代检索阶段成本高昂的大语言模型控制逻辑。在面向分布式系统论文多跳检索的基准测试集DistComp上，LiteRAG在所有参评方法中取得最高综合质量得分（0.798），与GraphRAG Global和DRIFT相比，单查询时延降低100倍以上，成本降低99%以上。在UltraDomain基准测试集上，其综合质量与LinearRAG持平，同时token消耗量仅为后者的约1/14。消融实验表明，LiteRAG的查询自适应阈值机制与感知社区结构的中心节点惩罚机制是其token效率提升的核心来源。

title: Hierarchical and Permutation-Invariant Feature Transformation Learning via Policy-Guided Embedding Search
title_zh: 基于策略引导嵌入搜索的分层排列不变特征变换学习
authors: Rui Liu, Tao Zhe, Yanyong Huang, Sankha Narayan Guria, Xiao Luo 等 (8 人)
abstract: Feature transformation improves predictive performance on tabular data by constructing informative abstractions from raw features. Recent generative approaches encode transformation knowledge into continuous embedding spaces for efficient exploration of candidate strategies, but face three key limitations: (1) overlooking hierarchical relationships between low-level features, operations, and high-level abstractions; (2) enforcing order-sensitive embeddings on inherently permutation-invariant transformation sequences, thereby introducing systematic bias; and (3) relying on gradient-based search, which is ill-suited to non-convex transformation spaces. We propose a framework with two complementary components. First, a permutation-invariant hierarchical module captures interactions across features, operations, and abstraction levels, with a self-attention pooling mechanism that maps semantically equivalent structures to consistent embeddings aligned with downstream performance. Second, a policy-guided multi-objective reinforcement learning strategy initializes the search from empirically strong seeds and jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and transformation efficiency. Extensive experiments on diverse tabular benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our framework against strong baselines. Our code and data are publicly available at:this https URL.
summary_zh: 特征变换可通过从原始特征中构建信息丰富的抽象表示，提升表格数据的预测性能。近期的生成式方法将变换知识编码到连续嵌入空间中，以高效探索候选策略，但存在三大核心局限：（1）忽略底层特征、操作与高层抽象之间的层级关系；（2）对本质上排列不变的变换序列施加顺序敏感的嵌入，引入系统性偏差；（3）依赖基于梯度的搜索，该方法不适用于非凸变换空间。本文提出包含两个互补组件的框架：第一，排列不变分层模块可捕获跨特征、操作与抽象层级的交互，其自注意力池化机制可将语义等价的结构映射为与下游性能对齐的一致嵌入；第二，策略引导的多目标强化学习策略从经验上表现优异的种子点启动搜索，联合优化预测精度与变换效率。在多个不同类型的表格基准数据集上开展的大量实验表明，本文提出的框架相比现有强基线方法具备更优的有效性与鲁棒性。相关代码与数据已公开至对应链接。

title: Why Sample What You Can Enumerate? Exact Policy Optimization for Genomic Tool Selection
title_zh: 可枚举场景下为何要采样？面向基因组工具选择的精确策略优化
authors: Haoyue Liu, Xiaoyu Ma, Ye Chen, Zhichao Wang, Xiaoying Tang
abstract: Reinforcement learning over a frozen reasoner has become a common recipe for teaching a policy which external tools to invoke. We show that this recipe becomes structurally mismatched in specialist scientific settings where the complete tool-subset space is enumerable. There, a small set of recurring computational capabilities covers the domain, so the space of tool subsets is combinatorial yet small enough to enumerate, and GRPO still estimates an action expectation from a handful of sampled rollouts. Worse, the approximation degrades as training succeeds: as the policy concentrates on preferred subsets it resamples them, sampled rewards collide, and the group-normalized advantage vanishes. On genomic reasoning the fraction of questions yielding no reward signal rises from 0.2% under a uniform reference policy to 20.8% after GRPO training. As a remedy, we introduce FGPO (Full-Group Policy Optimization), which (1) scores every tool subset and optimizes the exact action expectation, so each update sees the complete action space, and (2) precomputes the reward of each question--subset pair into an exhaustive table, removing frozen-reasoner calls from the training loop entirely. Across five frozen reasoners and three genomic benchmarks, FGPO outperforms GRPO in all 15 settings by 6.75 points on average and up to 14.20, while a standard on-demand GRPO schedule would require 2.4 times as many frozen-reasoner reward evaluations and, on GenomeQA, FGPO cuts invoked tools per question from 2.36 to 1.40.
summary_zh: 基于固定推理器的强化学习已成为训练策略选择外部调用工具的主流方案。本文指出，在工具子集全空间可枚举的专业科学场景下，该方案存在结构性错配问题。这类场景中，少量可复用的计算能力即可覆盖领域需求，工具子集空间虽具备组合性但体量小到可实现全枚举，而GRPO（分组相对策略优化）仍仅通过少量采样轨迹估计动作期望。更严重的是，该近似偏差会随训练推进进一步恶化：当策略集中于偏好的子集时会重复采样，导致采样奖励碰撞，分组归一化优势消失。在基因组推理任务中，无奖励信号的问题占比从均匀参考策略下的0.2%上升至GRPO训练后的20.8%。针对该问题，本文提出FGPO（全分组策略优化，Full-Group Policy Optimization）：（1）对所有工具子集打分，优化精确动作期望，每次更新覆盖完整动作空间；（2）将每个问题-子集对的奖励预计算为全量表，完全从训练循环中移除固定推理器调用环节。在5种固定推理器与3个基因组基准测试集的共15个设置下，FGPO的表现均优于GRPO，平均提升6.75个点，最高提升14.20个点；而标准按需GRPO调度方案所需的固定推理器奖励评估次数是FGPO的2.4倍，在GenomeQA数据集上，FGPO还将单问题平均调用工具数从2.36降至1.40。

title: Can AI Agents Deliver Verifiable Network-Wide Outcomes Across Authority Boundaries?
title_zh: AI智能体能否跨管理域生成可验证的全网结果？
authors: Tianzhu Zhang, Chih-Kai Huang, Meikang Qiu
abstract: AI agents are increasingly involved in network automation, where they can initiate configuration changes through mediated operational interfaces and assess the resulting state. Nonetheless, operational networks usually span many devices and administrative domains. Realizing an operator's intent requires coordinating agents with distinct authority scopes that define the resources they can access, the operations they can invoke, and the network state they can observe. This division limits the blast radius of an erroneous action but fragments the evidence needed to assess the network-wide outcome. Successful execution of a configuration action proposed by one agent does not establish that remote devices responded as intended or that routing changes reached the required devices. A valid observation may also become stale after a subsequent change. Before the coordinated operation can be declared complete, a trusted assurance layer must collect current observations from the required scopes and determine whether they collectively support the operator's intended network-wide outcome.To address the completion admission problem, we present EvidenceNet, a runtime assurance layer for deciding whether coordinated agent operations have achieved an operator's network intent. Its broker collects the post-change observations required by a completion contract, and its admission gate checks that the evidence comes from the required scopes, remains current, and satisfies the task rules. A verifier agent provides an additional assessment of the observation content. Experiments on live routing networks show that post-change state checks recognize successful outcomes that configuration-action records alone cannot establish. Controlled interventions further show that EvidenceNet rejects completion when otherwise satisfactory observations have the wrong source, have been substituted, or are stale.
summary_zh: AI智能体越来越多地应用于网络自动化场景，可通过中介操作接口发起配置变更并评估最终状态。但实际运营网络通常覆盖大量设备与多个管理域，要实现运营商的意图，需要协调具备不同权限范围的智能体——这些权限范围定义了智能体可访问的资源、可执行的操作以及可观测的网络状态。该权限划分可限制错误操作的影响范围，但也会割裂评估全网结果所需的证据链。单个智能体提出的配置操作成功执行，并不代表远端设备按预期响应，也不代表路由变更已覆盖所有目标设备；同时，有效观测结果也可能在后续变更后失效。在声明协同操作完成前，可信保障层必须从所有必要权限域收集最新观测结果，判断这些结果是否共同支撑运营商预期的全网目标。针对完成准入问题，本文提出EvidenceNet——一种运行时保障层，用于判定智能体协同操作是否达成运营商的网络意图。其代理模块收集完成契约要求的变更后观测结果，准入门控模块检查证据是否来自指定权限域、是否为最新状态、是否符合任务规则，验证智能体可对观测内容提供额外评估。在真实路由网络上开展的实验表明，变更后状态检查可识别出仅靠配置操作记录无法确认的成功结果；受控干预实验进一步验证，当观测结果来源错误、被篡改或已失效时，EvidenceNet可正确判定操作未完成。

title: Beyond Surface Imitation: Contrastive Modeling for Reasoning Path Alignment in Multimodal In-Context Learning
authors: Mingbo Yang, Wenqiang Wang, Zhaolu Kang, Peng Chen, Yannan Chen 等 (7 人)
abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is widely used in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and achieves strong performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, existing multimodal ICL methods often rely on surface level imitation of in-context demonstrations, making it difficult for MLLMs to align their responses with the reasoning path required by the given multimodal input. This limitation becomes more pronounced in complex multimodal tasks, thereby restricting further improvements in MLLM performance. To address this issue, we propose a new multimodal ICL framework that combines contrastive demonstration modeling with the self-refinement capability of MLLMs. Specifically, our framework reformulates each demonstration by explicitly contrasting a suboptimal response with a better response under the same input, together with a reasoning path that reveals how the response should be refined. This contrastive formulation makes the reasoning path toward the desired response more explicit and guides the MLLM beyond superficial imitation. Furthermore, because effective refinement depends on the current response, we introduce a response-conditioned retrieval mechanism to select demonstrations whose reasoning paths are more relevant to the current response. In addition, we use a lightweight alignment controller to predict response quality and determine whether further refinement is needed. Experiments on three types of multimodal tasks show that the proposed framework consistently improves MLLM performance, with particularly notable gains on visual question answering (VQA).

title: Kernel-Managed Shared Memory for System-Wide Personalization
title_zh: 面向系统级个性化的内核托管共享内存
authors: Ryan Lum, Yongfeng Zhang
abstract: AI systems become more useful when they can adapt to the people using them, but in multi-agent systems, useful context learned by one agent often remains unavailable to others. We present kernel-managed shared memory, a system-level abstraction in which specialized agents write structured, tagged memories while the agent-system kernel, not individual agents, governs retrieval, privacy enforcement, and prompt injection. We implement and evaluate this design on AIOS and compare it against three alternatives across three assistant models (GPT-4o, Llama-3.1:8B, Qwen-2.5:7B) and 1,800 total trials. Against an unmanaged external memory backend (Mem0) using identical underlying storage, kernel-managed retrieval and injection improve personalization scores by 2.4-4.0 points on a 5-point scale (e.g., 1.05 to 4.69 profile usage on GPT-4o), with every comparison significant at p < 10^-18. Against standard retrieval-augmented injection, gains are similarly large and consistent across all three models. Against full, unfiltered context concatenation, a soft ceiling on available context rather than on response quality, kernel-managed injection statistically matches performance on two of three models and shows a small, model-specific deficit on the third, while using substantially shorter prompts: end-to-end latency is 15-61% lower across all three models, with corresponding reductions in per-call token usage and inference cost. These results indicate that centralizing memory management in the agent-system kernel, rather than leaving retrieval and privacy enforcement to individual agents, delivers most of the personalization benefit of unconstrained context at a fraction of its cost.
summary_zh: 当AI系统能够适配其用户时，实用性会显著提升，但在多智能体系统中，单个智能体学习到的有用上下文通常无法被其他智能体访问。本文提出内核托管共享内存这一系统级抽象：专用智能体负责写入结构化、带标签的记忆内容，由智能体系统内核（而非单个智能体）统一管控检索、隐私执行与提示注入流程。本文在AIOS上实现并评估该设计，在3种助手模型（GPT-4o、Llama-3.1:8B、Qwen-2.5:7B）上开展共1800组对照实验，与3种替代方案进行对比。与采用相同底层存储的非托管外部内存后端Mem0相比，内核托管的检索与注入机制在5分制评分下将个性化得分提升2.4~4.0分（例如GPT-4o上的画像使用率从1.05提升至4.69），所有对比结果的显著性均满足p < 10^-18。与标准检索增强注入方案相比，该机制在所有3种模型上均实现了一致且显著的性能提升。与无过滤的全量上下文拼接方案（该方案的性能天花板受上下文长度限制而非响应质量限制）相比，内核托管注入在3种模型中的2种上性能与全量上下文拼接方案统计持平，仅在第3种模型上存在微小的模型专属性能损失，同时提示长度大幅缩短：3种模型的端到端时延降低15%~61%，对应的单调用token消耗量与推理成本也显著下降。上述结果表明，将内存管理权限集中到智能体系统内核，而非将检索与隐私执行交由单个智能体处理，可在仅消耗极小部分无约束上下文成本的前提下，获得无约束上下文所能提供的绝大多数个性化收益。

title: Active Adaptation, Not Static Defense: Temporal Dynamics of Preventative Steering in Adversarial Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 主动适配而非静态防御：对抗微调场景下预防性引导的时序动力学特性
authors: Jing Guan, Yachao Yang, Zhaoliang Liu, Yuyao Zhang, Fanyu Meng 等 (6 人)
abstract: Large language models remain fragile against malicious fine-tuning, motivating training-time defenses against harmful persona drift. Preventative Steering injects undesirable-trait persona vectors during fine-tuning and removes them at evaluation time, yet the mechanism behind its lasting protection remains unclear. Analyzing its temporal optimization dynamics, we find that the defense emerges from an early compensatory adaptation phase followed by a steady-state phase where the corrective signal decays; in parameter space, attention output projections emerge as the dominant residual-write route for defensive updates. Through Intervention Delta Preservation (IDP) and IDP Continuation experiments, we further show that preserving or reinjecting the weight offset fails to maintain protection, indicating that preventative steering relies on active adaptation rather than a static defense. Motivated by this finding, we propose Progressive Intensity Scheduling (PIS), which starts with a moderate injection strength and increases it after static-strength alignment begins to decay. Across the evaluated Qwen2.5 and Gemma-3 models, PIS improves safety robustness over static-strength steering while reducing harmful trait expression.
summary_zh: 大语言模型面对恶意微调时仍存在鲁棒性不足的问题，学界已提出多种训练时防御方案以抵御有害人设漂移。预防性引导（Preventative Steering）技术在微调阶段注入非期望特征的人设向量，在推理阶段将其移除，但该技术实现持久防护的底层机制仍不明确。通过分析其时序优化动力学，本文发现该防御机制的生效分为两个阶段：早期的补偿适配阶段，以及后续校正信号衰减的稳态阶段；在参数空间中，注意力输出投影层是防御更新最主要的残差写入路径。通过干预差量保留（Intervention Delta Preservation, IDP）与IDP延续实验，本文进一步发现，保留或重新注入权重偏移无法维持防护效果，说明预防性引导依赖主动适配过程而非静态防御。基于该发现，本文提出渐进式强度调度（Progressive Intensity Scheduling, PIS）方案，从适中的注入强度启动训练，在静态强度对齐效果开始衰减后逐步提升注入强度。在参评的Qwen2.5与Gemma-3模型上，PIS相比静态强度引导方案进一步提升了安全鲁棒性，同时降低了有害特征的表达程度。

title: Agent-Based ML-LLM Fusion with Self-Optimizing Prompts for Plateau Weather Alerts
title_zh: 面向高原气象预警的自优化提示智能体ML-LLM融合架构
authors: Shuai Yan, Yang Xu, Shan He
abstract: To address insufficient contextualization, weak generalization, and poor scenario adaptation in tourism meteorological services, we propose SmartWeatherAgent--a unified three-stage architecture integrating intent recognition, hazard prediction, and reasoning-enhanced generation. The system fuses rule-based methods with large language models to parse queries at multiple granularities and employs a LightGBM model enriched with highland-specific features (e.g., wind speed abruptness rate), achieving an F1-Macro score of 0.605 with 1.60 ms latency on high-wind, precipitation, and low-temperature events. A 12-round micro-step prompt self-optimization loop boosts the composite warning quality score S_final from 4.2 (B01) to 8.9 (B12, +112%). Key improvements include a sharp rise in B08 from data source citation (6.5 -> 8.5), sustained high performance in B10 via physical mechanism explanation, and a peak scientific rigor score of 9.2 in B12 through explicit uncertainty statements. The system autonomously generates structured warnings that integrate causal mechanisms, spatiotemporal evolution, quantitative evidence, regulatory references, and confidence statements--enhancing professional depth, logical rigor, and scientific soundness, and advancing meteorological services toward proactive perception, explainable decision-making, and intelligent agency.
summary_zh: 针对当前旅游气象服务场景下上下文适配不足、泛化能力弱、场景适配性差的问题，本文提出SmartWeatherAgent——融合意图识别、灾害预测与推理增强生成的统一三阶段架构。该系统融合规则方法与大语言模型，实现多粒度查询解析，并集成补充了高原专属特征（如风速突变率）的LightGBM模型，在大风、降水、低温三类事件上的宏F1得分达0.605，时延仅为1.60ms。12轮微步提示自优化循环将综合预警质量得分S_final从初始B01阶段的4.2提升至B12阶段的8.9，增幅达112%。核心提升点包括：B08阶段数据来源引用得分从6.5大幅提升至8.5，B10阶段通过物理机理解释实现持续高性能表现，B12阶段通过明确的不确定性声明实现9.2的科学严谨性峰值得分。该系统可自动生成融合因果机制、时空演化规律、量化证据、规范参考与置信度声明的结构化预警内容，提升预警内容的专业深度、逻辑严谨性与科学合理性，推动气象服务向主动感知、可解释决策与智能代理方向演进。

title: Context operations to architecture modelling output from large language models and evaluation criteria for their use in systems engineering design
title_zh: 面向大语言模型架构建模输出的上下文操作与系统工程设计评估准则
authors: Vinicius Kaster Marini, Petter Krus
abstract: The development of generative artificial intelligence resources enables opportunities of speeding up systems and engineering design work. This contribution introduces a framework of formal operations for assembling context in LLM-based engineering design. This framework involves the assembly of modular context units, including policy prompts, reference units with persistence, and user questions with prompt vectoring. This approach enables the systematic structuring of interactions with generative models. A formal method for evaluating modelling-as-code LLM outputs is also presented, which enables the evaluation of compliance to intent from LLM answers and thereby asses the support from LLMs for systems architecture modelling.
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能技术的发展为加速系统与工程设计工作提供了新机遇。本文提出一套面向大语言模型工程设计场景的上下文组装形式化操作框架，该框架支持模块化上下文单元的组装，包含策略提示、带持久化属性的参考单元、带提示矢量化的用户提问三类组件，可实现生成式模型交互的系统化结构化。本文还提出了面向大语言模型"建模即代码"输出的形式化评估方法，可评估大语言模型输出与设计意图的一致性，进而衡量大语言模型对系统架构建模的支撑能力。

title: A Trust-Network-Based Federated Learning Framework for Multi-Center Aging Clock Prediction
title_zh: 面向多中心衰老时钟预测的基于信任网络的联邦学习框架
authors: Chunxu Zhang, Bo Li, Wenliang Wang, Yang Liu, Di Jiang 等 (10 人)
abstract: Aging clocks quantify biological aging and help characterize individual health status. What protein interactions are important for accurate aging clocks, and are they zeroth-order or higher-order? Addressing these questions requires learning from large molecular datasets distributed across medical centers, where privacy constraints prevent centralized data sharing. Federated learning offers a natural solution but faces four challenges in this setting: limited local sample sizes, sparse and directional inter-center trust, the need to retain discriminative age prediction while supporting interpretation, and model drift and forgetting under heterogeneous cross-center data.We propose TNFL, a trust-network-based federated learning framework that progressively propagates models along directed pairwise trust relations without centralized aggregation. TNFL combines an age-aware mixture-of-experts model with generative replay to preserve previously learned information and reduce forgetting and drift. Experiments across multiple molecular datasets show that TNFL enables effective aging-clock prediction with limited local data, provides interpretable age-dependent prediction patterns, and maintains stable performance across interaction orders.To investigate the biological questions, we analyze TNFL-identified pairwise protein interactions and their higher-order organization through functional and network analyses. The identified interactions repeatedly form coordinated higher-order subnetworks spanning multiple aging-related biological systems, with several proteins recurring across subnetworks. These findings suggest that TNFL captures molecular relationships beyond isolated pairwise associations and reveals coherent higher-order biological organization associated with aging.
summary_zh: 衰老时钟可量化生物衰老进程，辅助表征个体健康状态。哪些蛋白质相互作用对构建精准衰老时钟至关重要？这类相互作用是零阶的还是高阶的？要解答上述问题，需要从分布在各医疗中心的大规模分子数据集中学习，而隐私约束导致这类数据无法集中共享。联邦学习是该场景下的天然解决方案，但仍面临四大挑战：本地样本量有限、中心间信任稀疏且具有方向性、需要在保留判别性年龄预测能力的同时支持可解释性、跨中心数据异质性下的模型漂移与遗忘问题。本文提出TNFL（基于信任网络的联邦学习框架），该框架无需集中聚合，可沿有向成对信任关系逐步传播模型。TNFL将年龄感知的混合专家模型与生成式重放机制相结合，保留先前学习到的信息，减少模型遗忘与漂移。在多个分子数据集上的实验结果表明，TNFL可在本地数据有限的条件下实现高效的衰老时钟预测，输出可解释的年龄依赖型预测模式，且在不同阶次的相互作用下均能保持稳定性能。为解答相关生物学问题，本文通过功能分析与网络分析，对TNFL识别出的成对蛋白质相互作用及其高阶结构展开研究。结果显示，识别出的相互作用可反复形成覆盖多个衰老相关生物系统的协同高阶子网络，且多个蛋白质在不同子网络中反复出现。上述发现表明，TNFL捕捉到了超越孤立成对关联的分子关系，揭示了与衰老相关的连贯高阶生物结构。

title: Beyond Training: A Feasibility Taxonomy for Inference-Time AI Governance
title_zh: 超越训练：推理时人工智能治理的可行性分类体系
authors: Samar Ansari
abstract: Compute governance today is a governance of training: the thresholds, reporting requirements, and frontier-AI regimes now in force attach to training compute and treat the trained model as the regulatory unit. That picture is incomplete: capability increasingly migrates to the deployment stage through inference-time scaling, agentic scaffolding, and compression onto consumer hardware. This paper asks which mechanisms are available once the regulatory object shifts from the training run to the inference call. We develop a feasibility taxonomy of twenty inference-time mechanisms across monitoring, verification, and enforcement, each rated on a four-point readiness scale against a documented four-vendor evidence base. We then stress the taxonomy against a two-dimensional adversary model (three capability tiers crossed with four adversary roles) and map each mechanism to four governance scenarios (domestic regulation, bilateral or multilateral coordination, industry self-regulation, and compute-marketplace governance). Fifteen of the twenty mechanisms have commercial technical substrates in production today, although governance-grade assurance and adversarial robustness vary substantially. The adversary analysis shows that this readiness holds only against a cooperative deployer and a low-to-medium-capability user: no mechanism rates adequate against a high-capability state-level deployer, and fine-tuning removes the model-internal components of the enforcement cluster, although platform-external controls can persist. A substitution analysis connects the taxonomy to a companion hardware paper as a conditional substitution principle describing when inference-stage and hardware-stage mechanisms provide comparable regulatory coverage under stated conditions. A second-rater reliability check on a random subset of the readiness ratings returned a quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa of 0.74.
summary_zh: 当前的算力治理以训练环节为核心：现行的阈值规则、报告要求、前沿AI监管机制均绑定训练算力，将训练完成的模型作为监管单元。这一框架并不完整：随着推理时缩放、智能体脚手架、消费端硬件压缩等技术的发展，AI能力正逐步向部署阶段迁移。本文探讨当监管对象从训练运行转向推理调用时可采用的治理机制，构建了覆盖监控、验证、执法三大类共20种推理时机制的可行性分类体系，所有机制均基于4家厂商的公开证据库，采用4级就绪度量表完成评级。随后本文基于二维敌手模型（3种能力层级×4类敌手角色）对该分类体系进行压力测试，并将所有机制映射到四类治理场景：国内监管、双边/多边协调、行业自律、算力市场治理。20种机制中有15种目前已有投入生产环境的商业技术底座，但治理级保障能力与对抗鲁棒性差异极大。敌手分析显示，上述就绪度仅在部署方配合、用户能力为中低等级的场景下成立：没有任何机制可在面对高能力国家级部署方时达到足够效果，且微调操作会破坏执法类机制的模型内部组件，仅平台外部控制措施可保留作用。替代分析将该分类体系与配套硬件论文关联，提出条件替代原则，明确推理阶段与硬件阶段机制在指定条件下可实现等效监管覆盖。针对随机子集就绪度评级的二次评分者信度检验得到的二次加权科恩kappa值为0.74。

title: RAP: Research Attention Prediction Reveals Target-Conditioned Evidence Acquisition Biases
title_zh: RAP：研究注意力预测可揭示目标条件下的证据获取偏差
authors: Yingqian Wu, Jingcong Liang, Siyuan Wang, Zhenfei Yin, Philip Torr 等 (7 人)
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as research agents, yet their ability to track shifts in research attention is difficult to evaluate because reviews and research ideas lack uniquely verifiable outcomes. We introduce Research Attention Prediction (RAP), a rolling benchmark covering 278 AI/ML fields and 1,390 episodes. At each cut-off, an LLM agent searches a temporally restricted arXiv corpus and predicts the next six months' paper shares across eight frozen research directions. Search generally helps, but all four diagnostic models perform worse than an exact-count exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) baseline in compositional accuracy. We identify two linked bottlenecks. Under cumulative-history access, State carry-forward outperforms direct Forecast for all four diagnostic models; frozen-evidence replay links a shared component of this reversal to Forecast-oriented policies retrieving a smaller share of recent evidence. Even with exact historical activity, future-specific updating remains limited, with only GPT-5.5 plus reopened Search slightly surpassing EWMA. Fine-tuning on realised outcomes improves Qwen3-4B's forecast Spearman correlation by 0.105 on held-out fields at later origins, with gains also on change-rich episodes.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地承担研究智能体的角色，但由于综述与研究想法缺乏可唯一验证的输出结果，其追踪研究注意力变化的能力难以评估。本文提出RAP（研究注意力预测，Research Attention Prediction），这是一个覆盖278个AI/ML领域、包含1390个时间片段的滚动基准。在每个时间截断点，LLM智能体可搜索时间受限的arXiv语料库，预测未来6个月内8个固定研究方向的论文占比。搜索操作整体上可提升性能，但所有4个诊断模型的组合准确率均低于精确计数的指数加权移动平均（EWMA）基线。本文识别出两个关联的瓶颈：在可访问全部历史数据的条件下，状态结转方法的表现优于直接预测方法；冻结证据重放机制将这一反转现象的共享组件关联到面向预测的策略，这类策略检索到的近期证据占比更低。即便拥有精确的历史活动数据，面向未来的更新能力仍然有限，仅GPT-5.5搭配开放搜索的组合表现略超EWMA。在已实现的结果上微调后，Qwen3-4B在后续时间点的留出领域上预测斯皮尔曼相关性提升了0.105，在变化丰富的时间片段上也获得了性能增益。

title: Reference-Based Bias Detection in LLMs via Relative Representations of Hidden States
title_zh: 大语言模型中基于参考的隐藏状态相对表征偏差检测方法
authors: Marek Jeliński, Jan Dubiński, Maciej Chrabaszcz, Sebastian Cygert
abstract: Existing bias auditing methods typically rely on model outputs, requiring costly benchmarks or judge models and potentially missing internal shifts that never appear in generated text. We propose a reference-based method that audits bias in hidden-state representations across related model variants, for example before and after fine-tuning. Because fine-tuning reshapes representation geometry, absolute hidden states are not directly comparable, so we encode each sentence by its similarities to a fixed set of anchor sentences, yielding relative representations in a shared comparison space. There we measure how target groups shift in their association with positive and negative attributes, a quantity we call the Representational Bias Shift $\Delta B$. Across three model families and the WildGuardMix, DecodingTrust and ToxiGen benchmarks, $\Delta B$ correlates with output-level bias change in 15 of the 18 settings we test, reaching $|r| = 0.84$ ($p < 0.001$) under full fine-tuning and becoming more model-dependent under parameter-efficient adaptation. Thresholding $\Delta B$ detects checkpoints whose bias increased with ROC AUC between $0.65$ and $0.99$, and on WildGuardMix and DecodingTrust it separates them better than a SEAT-based baseline for all three families. $\Delta B$ is also stable under changes to the anchor set, attribute sets and target templates. Our method requires no task-specific evaluation data and audits a model in about three minutes, using $3$-$50\times$ less compute than the output-level benchmarks considered here. We view it as complementary to output-based auditing rather than a replacement for it.
summary_zh: 现有偏差审计方法通常依赖模型输出，需要成本高昂的基准或裁判模型，且可能遗漏从未在生成文本中显现的内部表征偏移。本文提出一种基于参考的方法，可针对相关模型变体（例如微调前后的模型）的隐藏状态表征开展偏差审计。由于微调会重塑表征几何空间，绝对隐藏状态无法直接比较，因此本文将每个句子编码为其与一组固定锚点句子的相似度，在共享比较空间中生成相对表征。在该空间中可测量目标群体与正负属性的关联偏移量，本文将该指标命名为表征偏差偏移量ΔB。在3个模型家族以及WildGuardMix、DecodingTrust、ToxiGen基准上的测试结果显示，18个测试设置中有15个的ΔB与输出级偏差变化相关，全微调场景下相关系数|r|可达0.84（p<0.001），参数高效适配场景下相关性则随模型变化。对ΔB设置阈值可识别偏差上升的检查点，ROC AUC处于0.65到0.99区间，在WildGuardMix和DecodingTrust数据集上，该方法对偏差上升检查点的区分效果优于基于SEAT的基线方法，且在所有3个模型家族上均成立。ΔB在锚点集、属性集、目标模板发生变化时仍保持稳定。本文提出的方法无需任务专属评估数据，审计单个模型仅需约3分钟，计算量比现有输出级基准低3~50倍。该方法可作为输出类审计方法的补充，而非替代方案。

title: NOPE-HYPE: A Structured Simulation Workflow for Robust Speech-to-Text Across Diverse Acoustic Environments
title_zh: NOPE-HYPE：面向多声学环境鲁棒语音转文本的结构化仿真工作流
authors: Niramay M. Patel, Bibek Behera, Raksha Sharma
abstract: Robust speech-to-text translation systems should perform reliably across diverse acoustic conditions, yet practical pipelines lack controllable tools for systematic environment exploration. Large speech models remain sensitive to unseen acoustic conditions, as training data rarely cover the full range of realthis http URLpresent NOPEHYPE, a structured training workflow that combines a controllable environment simulator, coverage-optimal environment reduction on Power Spectral Density (PSD) templates, and a small, interpretable hyperparameter search over simulator knobs. We show that simulator-generated noise achieves performance comparable to balanced realnoise training across Whisper and SeamlessM4T models, provide principled environment prototype sets, and identify practical default simulator configurations from a structured 27-run hyperparameter sweep.
summary_zh: 鲁棒语音转文本系统需要在各类声学条件下稳定运行，但现有实用流水线缺乏可控制的工具来开展系统性环境探索。当前的大语音模型对未见过的声学条件仍然敏感，因为训练数据几乎无法覆盖真实世界的全部声学场景。本文提出NOPE-HYPE，这是一套结构化训练工作流，融合了可控环境模拟器、基于功率谱密度（PSD）模板的覆盖最优环境约简，以及针对模拟器旋钮的小规模可解释超参数搜索。实验结果表明，模拟器生成的噪声在Whisper和SeamlessM4T两类模型上可实现与平衡真实噪声训练相当的性能，本文同时提供了原则性的环境原型集，并通过覆盖27组运行的结构化超参数扫描确定了实用的模拟器默认配置。

title: OntologyAligner: Ontology-Aligned Retrieval and Hierarchy-Guided Large Language Model Reranking for Biomedical Ontology Normalization
title_zh: OntologyAligner：面向生物医学本体归一化的本体对齐检索与层次引导大语言模型重排序框架
authors: Jie Song, Zhichuan Xu, Ziyu Lu, Meng Xiao, Cheng Bi 等 (11 人)
abstract: Biomedical ontology normalization maps free-text expressions to standardized concepts, enabling consistent integration and analysis of biomedical data. This task remains challenging because lexical variation and subtle distinctions among hierarchically related concepts can obscure concept boundaries. We present OntologyAligner, a three-stage framework that combines ontology-aligned retrieval, large language model candidate reranking, and selective hierarchy-guided refinement. We also construct PhenoNormBench, a unified benchmark comprising 13,390 samples from seven Human Phenotype Ontology datasets. OntologyAligner achieved state-of-the-art performance on HPO normalization, with 88.78% Macro Top-1 Accuracy and 86.75% Micro Top-1 Accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.85 and 5.07 percentage points, respectively. Ablation analyses showed complementary contributions from all three stages, and sensitivity analyses demonstrated stability across candidate-set sizes and model backbones. Applications to MONDO, MEDIC, and NCBITaxon further established portability to other ontologies. OntologyAligner offers a generalizable framework for accurate mapping of biomedical text to structured ontology concepts. PhenoNormBench and the code are publicly available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 生物医学本体归一化任务将自由文本表达映射到标准化概念，实现生物医学数据的一致集成与分析。该任务目前仍存在较大挑战，因为词汇变异与层次关联概念间的细微差异会模糊概念边界。本文提出OntologyAligner，这是一个三阶段框架，融合了本体对齐检索、大语言模型候选重排序、选择性层次引导优化三个模块。本文同时构建了PhenoNormBench统一基准，包含来自7个人类表型本体数据集的13390个样本。OntologyAligner在人类表型本体归一化任务上取得了当前最优性能，宏平均Top-1准确率达88.78%，微平均Top-1准确率达86.75%，分别比最强基线高出4.85和5.07个百分点。消融分析显示三个阶段的贡献具有互补性，敏感性分析证明该框架在不同候选集大小、不同模型骨干下均保持稳定。在MONDO、MEDIC、NCBITaxon等本体上的应用进一步验证了该框架可迁移到其他本体场景。OntologyAligner为生物医学文本到结构化本体概念的精准映射提供了通用框架。PhenoNormBench与相关代码已在指定开源地址公开。

title: Direct Diversity Optimization for Diverse Successful Trajectories in Preference Post-Training
title_zh: 偏好后训练中面向多样化成功轨迹的直接多样性优化方法
authors: Junwon Ko, Dong-Jae Lee, Minchan Kwon, Sunghyun Baek, Junmo Kim
abstract: LLM agents for sequential decision tasks are often post-trained with trajectory-level outcome labels, but such labels provide little supervision for preserving multiple successful branches from the same decision state. We study this problem as successful strategy coverage: how broadly a model realizes distinct successful strategies under a fixed rollout budget. We present Direct Diversity Optimization (DDO), an offline post-training method that combines Divergence-Tree Collection (DTC) with the Reference-Relative Target-Odds Objective (RTO). DTC constructs state-aligned branch sets rooted at shared decision states, and RTO trains the model to match reference-relative targets over successful alternatives. DDO achieves the strongest task success and successful strategy coverage among the compared post-training methods across BabyAI, BabaIsAI, and WebShop. It also achieves the highest recovery rate after local action replacement and higher task success and coverage than successful-only imitation and decoding-time diversification controls.
summary_zh: 面向序列决策任务的大语言模型智能体通常采用轨迹级结果标签完成后训练，但这类标签几乎无法提供监督信号，难以保留同一决策状态下的多个成功分支。本文将该问题定义为成功策略覆盖度：在固定的推演预算下，模型能够实现的不同成功策略的广泛程度。本文提出DDO（直接多样性优化，Direct Diversity Optimization），这是一种离线后训练方法，融合了DTC（散度树收集，Divergence-Tree Collection）与RTO（参考相对目标赔率目标函数，Reference-Relative Target-Odds Objective）两个模块。DTC构建根节点为共享决策状态的状态对齐分支集，RTO则训练模型在多个成功备选方案上匹配参考相对目标。在BabyAI、BabaIsAI、WebShop三个测试环境中，DDO在任务成功率与成功策略覆盖度两个指标上均优于所有对比的后训练方法。该方法在局部动作替换后也实现了最高的恢复率，相比仅使用成功样本的模仿学习、解码时多样化控制方法，拥有更高的任务成功率与策略覆盖度。

title: MetroLLM-Bench: Evaluating Language Models as Transit Kiosk Runtimes
title_zh: MetroLLM-Bench：将大语言模型作为交通自助终端运行时的评估基准
authors: Remco Hendriks
abstract: We introduce MetroLLM-Bench, a 955-case benchmark for testing language models as the policy layer of a transit kiosk. It covers six real metro systems, ranging from 37 to 414 stations, and eleven categories that include routing, fare calculation, disruptions, accessibility, and adversarial input. In each case, the model must call structured tools and submit a machine-renderable terminal state containing an outcome, a per-ticket fare quote when applicable, and a kiosk action. Fourteen deterministic scoring components form Tier 1; eight semantic-quality components form Tier 2, six of which use a language-model judge. We report Tier 1 and the combined score of both tiers. A stratified 75/25 split reserves 717 cases for training-data generation and 238 for held-out evaluation.We evaluate twenty-six models from six vendors, of which twenty-three are ranked. On the held-out partition, a 4B Qwen 3.5 student trained through parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) exceeds both GPT-5.6 tiers on Tier 1 (91.3 against 90.6 and 90.0) and matches GPT-5.4 full at maximum reasoning effort (91.4), with a 2.6 GB Q4_K_M footprint. Larger 9B and 27B students provide no further Tier 1 improvement over the 4B student at this training scale. Across the four Qwen sizes, the PEFT gain over the corresponding base model decreases from +7.03 points at 2B (three training seeds) to -0.91 at 27B; every seed shows the same direction at every size. A deterministic rule-based baseline reaches 84.6 on Tier 1, with the remaining language-model advantage concentrated in policy adaptation, compound scenarios, accessibility, and temporal reasoning. Muse Glimmer 30B leads the composite ranking, and serving configuration alone moves the Qwen 3.5-to-3.8 comparison by 2.7 Tier 1 points. The benchmark, harness, reproduction guide, and fine-tuned students are released atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 本文提出MetroLLM-Bench，这是一个包含955个用例的基准，用于测试作为交通自助终端策略层的大语言模型性能。该基准覆盖6个真实地铁系统（站点数从37到414不等），共11个类别，包括路径规划、票价计算、运营中断处理、无障碍服务、对抗输入等场景。每个用例中，模型需要调用结构化工具，提交可机器渲染的终端状态，包含输出结果、适用场景下的单张车票报价、终端操作指令。基准的第一层由14个确定性评分组件构成，第二层由8个语义质量组件构成，其中6个组件使用大语言模型作为裁判。本文报告了第一层得分以及两层的组合得分。采用分层75/25划分，717个用例用于训练数据生成，238个用例作为留出评估集。本文评估了来自6家厂商的26个模型，其中23个完成排名。在留出集上，经过参数高效微调（PEFT）训练的4B参数量Qwen 3.5学生模型在第一层得分上超过了两个层级的GPT-5.6（91.3 vs 90.6、90.0），在最大推理算力下与GPT-5.4全模型得分持平（91.4），模型体积仅为2.6GB（Q4_K_M量化）。在当前训练规模下，更大的9B和27B学生模型相比4B学生模型没有进一步提升第一层得分。在4个不同参数量的Qwen模型中，PEFT带来的性能增益从2B模型的+7.03分（3个训练种子）下降到27B模型的-0.91分，所有参数量下的所有训练种子均呈现相同趋势。基于确定性规则的基线方法第一层得分为84.6，大语言模型的性能优势主要集中在策略适配、复合场景、无障碍服务、时序推理场景。Muse Glimmer 30B在综合排名中位列第一，仅服务配置的差异就可使Qwen 3.5与Qwen 3.8的第一层得分差距达到2.7分。该基准、测试框架、复现指南、微调后的学生模型均已在指定开源地址发布。

title: Fidelity-Aware Scheduling of Quantum Circuits on Multi-QPU Systems
title_zh: 多量子处理单元系统上保真度感知的量子电路调度方法
authors: Innocenzo Fulginiti, Antonio Tudisco, Salvatore Zammuto, Patrick Hopf, Deborah Volpe 等 (10 人)
abstract: High Performance Computing-Quantum Computing (HPCQC) platforms expose multiple Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) that may differ in size, topology, native gates, and noise characteristics. For current noisy devices, errors compound along the compiled circuits quickly, and minimizing them, that is, maximizing the circuits' execution fidelity, is essential for reliable results. Fidelity depends on the compilation to a specific target device: the same high-level circuit may produce different executables and, therefore, different expected fidelities across QPUs. We present a low-overhead fidelity-aware scheduling framework for multi-QPU systems based on a Graph Neural Network (GNN) that estimates, before compilation, the expected fidelity of each circuit on each available QPU. Then, a tunable scheduler uses these estimates to control the trade-off between execution fidelity and parallelism. Results show that this framework allows for approximating an exhaustive fidelity-based assignment, saving computational resources compared to a brute-force approach that compiles each circuit on every device.
summary_zh: 高性能计算-量子计算（HPCQC）平台搭载了多个量子处理单元（QPU），不同QPU的规模、拓扑结构、原生门、噪声特性均可能存在差异。对于当前的噪声量子设备，编译后电路中的误差会快速累积，最小化误差即最大化电路执行保真度，是获得可靠结果的核心要求。保真度取决于针对特定目标设备的编译过程：同一高层电路在不同QPU上生成的可执行文件不同，对应的预期保真度也存在差异。本文提出一种面向多QPU系统的低开销保真度感知调度框架，该框架基于图神经网络（GNN），可在编译前预估每个电路在所有可用QPU上的预期保真度。随后可调调度器利用这些预估值，控制执行保真度与并行度之间的权衡。实验结果表明，该框架可近似实现基于穷举保真度的分配方案，相比在所有设备上编译所有电路的暴力方法，大幅节省了计算资源。

title: Improving Cross-Lingual Token Representations by Adding a Pinch of SALT
title_zh: 通过引入少量SALT方法改进跨语言词元表征
authors: Guillem Ramírez
abstract: Cross-lingual sentence encoders enable scalable transfer across hundreds of languages, powering applications such as translation mining and zero-shot learning in low-resource settings. Although trained for sentence-level alignment, they are increasingly also applied to token-level tasks such as hallucination detection and sequence tagging, exposing a mismatch between training and usage. We propose SALT, a lightweight post-training method that improves token representations by injecting span-level supervision into existing sentence encoders. Across five multilingual token-level benchmarks, SALT achieves the best overall results on four of them, outperforming alternative fine-tuning strategies and competitive encoders. It also improves sentence-level performance on cross-lingual retrieval and classification tasks. These results demonstrate that span-level supervision is an effective signal for improving both token and sentence representations.
summary_zh: 跨语言句子编码器支持数百种语言之间的可扩展迁移，为翻译挖掘、低资源场景零样本学习等应用提供支撑。尽管这类编码器的训练目标是实现句子级对齐，但目前也被越来越多地应用于词元级任务，例如幻觉检测、序列标注，这就暴露了训练目标与实际使用场景之间的不匹配问题。本文提出SALT，这是一种轻量级后训练方法，通过向现有句子编码器中注入片段级监督信号，改进词元表征质量。在5个多语言词元级基准上的测试结果显示，SALT在其中4个基准上取得了最优整体结果，性能优于其他微调策略与同类先进编码器。该方法同时也提升了跨语言检索与分类任务的句子级性能。上述结果表明，片段级监督是同时改进词元表征与句子表征的有效信号。

title: Structural Process Supervision for Latent Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
title_zh: 面向潜在思维链推理的结构化过程监督
authors: Yiqi Li, Xu Chen, Chen Ju, Jiangchao Yao, Zhaoyang Li 等 (9 人)
abstract: Latent reasoning approaches enhance token-level efficiency and robustness by replacing verbose, explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens with compact continuous-space embeddings. However, existing methods lack direct process supervision over these latent embeddings, which often leads to representation collapse and uneven information distribution. To address this, we propose Prototype-Mediated Process Supervision (PMPS), which introduces learnable reasoning prototypes as semantic anchors to provide structural process-level supervision for latent reasoning. PMPS projects latent embeddings and explicit CoT embeddings into a shared prototype space, achieving many-to-many soft alignment between unequal-length representations through prototype assignment. Meanwhile, we introduce a Progressive Sequential Alignment (PSA) module to further guide training: positional priors initially encourage sequential alignment structure, then gradually relax to permit adaptive matching. Experimental results show that PMPS compresses output token length to under 50% of explicit CoT on GSM8K-Aug. Compared to leading baseline SIM-CoT, our method achieves average accuracy gains of 2.08% across different model families. On GPT-2, PMPS even surpasses CoT-SFT. On larger models and a more challenging task, PMPS consistently attains the highest accuracy among all latent reasoning methods with comparable output length.
summary_zh: 潜在推理方法通过用紧凑的连续空间嵌入替代冗长的显式思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）令牌，提升了令牌级效率与鲁棒性。但现有方法缺乏对这些潜在嵌入的直接过程监督，往往会导致表示坍缩与信息分布不均。为解决该问题，本文提出原型介导过程监督（Prototype-Mediated Process Supervision, PMPS），引入可学习的推理原型作为语义锚点，为潜在推理提供结构化的过程级监督。PMPS将潜在嵌入与显式CoT嵌入投影至共享原型空间，通过原型分配实现不等长表示间的多对多软对齐。同时本文引入渐进式序列对齐（Progressive Sequential Alignment, PSA）模块进一步引导训练：先通过位置先验鼓励序列对齐结构，再逐步放宽约束以支持自适应匹配。实验结果表明，在GSM8K-Aug数据集上，PMPS可将输出令牌长度压缩至显式CoT的50%以下；与前沿基线SIM-CoT相比，所提方法在不同模型系列上的平均准确率提升达2.08%；在GPT-2上，PMPS性能甚至超过CoT-SFT；在更大规模模型与更具挑战性的任务上，在输出长度相当的所有潜在推理方法中，PMPS始终取得最高准确率。

title: Grounded Evaluation and Repair for NL-to-PDDL Problem Generation
title_zh: 面向自然语言转PDDL问题生成的落地评估与修复
authors: Joana Rosa, Pedro Santos, Valdemar Oliveira, Romão Silva, L. Miguel Silveira 等 (6 人)
