authors: Zhihao Liu, Hongyu Sun, Zhiyuan Fu, Xiaonan Duan, Jice Wang 等 (10 人)
abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end evaluation framework for image-triggered command injection against computer-use agents (CUAs). The goal is to test whether a local visual patch can induce verifiable environmental consequences along the full chain of screenshot input, VLM generation, action parsing, and environment execution. We train and deploy patches on author-controlled GitHub Pages pages and a locally deployed CSDN clone, and evaluate them in real environments across five open-source or publicly available GUI-agent or vision-language-model (VLM) backends. Our experiment aggregates 600 instance-level online cases, with T-ASR, TAPR, and E2E-ASR reaching 84.5%, 47.0%, and 20.3%, respectively. Trajectory analysis further shows that in some successful cases the agent first executes a malicious terminal command and then continues the original benign task. These results indicate that optimized local visual signals can affect not only VLM outputs but also propagate through the execution pipeline of open CUAs and create real environmental risk.

title: OpenDiscoveryTrace: Process Traces for Evaluating AI Scientist Workflows
title_zh: OpenDiscoveryTrace：用于评估AI科学家工作流的过程轨迹数据集
authors: Aayam Bansal, Keertan Balaji
abstract: Existing benchmarks for autonomous AI scientists evaluate only final outputs---generated code, hypotheses, or papers---yet discard the reasoning process by which those outputs were obtained. This makes it impossible to audit scientific methodology, diagnose failure modes, or distinguish systematic reasoning from fortunate guessing. We present \textbf{OpenDiscoveryTrace}, a public dataset of 558 complete AI scientific agent trajectories that captures how models reason, not just what they produce. Each trajectory records a structured 9-field-per-step trace---including thoughts, tool calls, observations, errors, revision triggers, and self-reported confidence---as models execute 124 scientific tasks spanning drug discovery, materials science, genomics, and scientific literature analysis. The dataset covers seven models: three frontier models (GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro; 124 trajectories each, fully balanced across domains and difficulty levels) and four open-weight models (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini, and Qwen2.5-1.5B; 30 each), plus 60 live-retrieval variant trajectories. Pilot analysis on 363 LLM-judged trajectories reveals that process traces expose behavioral differences invisible to output-only evaluation: all three frontier models achieve comparable success rates (84--89%), yet Claude Opus 4.6 produces 30$\times$ more errors than GPT-5.4 (2.5 vs. 0.08 per trajectory, $p < 0.0001$, Cliff's $\delta = 0.613$), with qualitatively different error profiles---66.7% tool misuse for Claude versus 83.6% reasoning errors for GPT-5.4. We define five benchmark tasks with baselines from logistic regression, random forests, LSTMs, and Transformer models. The dataset, trace schema, agent harness, and benchmark definitions are publicly available under CC BY 4.0 to support research on process-level evaluation, scientific agent auditing, and AI governance.
summary_zh: 现有自主AI科学家基准仅评估生成代码、假设或论文等最终输出，丢弃了得到这些输出的推理过程，因此无法对科学方法论进行审计、诊断故障模式，也无法区分系统性推理和侥幸猜测。本文发布了OpenDiscoveryTrace公开数据集，包含558条完整的AI科研智能体轨迹，记录了模型的推理过程而非仅输出结果。每条轨迹记录了每步的9个结构化字段：包括思考内容、工具调用、观测结果、错误、修订触发因素和自报告置信度，覆盖药物发现、材料科学、基因组学和科技文献分析四大领域的124项科研任务。数据集覆盖7个模型：3个前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro，每个模型各124条轨迹，在领域和难度维度上完全均衡）和4个开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Phi-3.5-mini、Qwen2.5-1.5B，每个模型各30条轨迹），另外还有60条实时检索变体轨迹。针对363条经大语言模型判定的轨迹的先导分析表明，过程轨迹能够暴露仅靠输出评估无法发现的行为差异：三个前沿模型的成功率相近（84%~89%），但Claude Opus 4.6产生的错误数量是GPT-5.4的30倍（每条轨迹2.5个错误对比0.08个错误，p<0.0001，Cliff's δ=0.613），二者的错误模式存在本质差异：Claude的错误中66.7%为工具误用，而GPT-5.4的错误中83.6%为推理错误。本文定义了5项基准任务，提供了基于逻辑回归、随机森林、LSTM和Transformer模型的基线结果。数据集、轨迹 schema、智能体测试框架和基准定义均以CC BY 4.0协议公开，可支持过程级评估、科研智能体审计和AI治理相关研究。

title: Trust Me, I'm Your Developer: Self-Issued Authentication in Large Language Models
title_zh: 相信我，我是你的开发者：大语言模型中的自签发认证研究
authors: Syed Ghazanfar Abbas, Dongyan Xu
abstract: Large language model (LLM) security has largely focused on role-playing jailbreaks, with less attention to what happens when a user asks an LLM to verify an identity claim through a test designed by the model itself. We study this behavior through a staged developer-identity experiment with ChatGPT, Claude, Qwen, Mistral, and Llama. All five models initially rejected the unsupported claim "I am your developer." Claude refused to conduct an identity test, while ChatGPT generated developer-oriented questions but maintained that answers could demonstrate knowledge, not identity. In contrast, Qwen and Mistral generated technical challenges, defined what counted as convincing evidence, evaluated detailed answers, and returned Verified without receiving any externally validated identity evidence. Llama similarly generated and evaluated a developer test, accepted the claimed identity, and subsequently made unsupported claims of access to internal runtime and deployment state. We call the model-generated verification procedure a Model-Issued Pseudo-Credential (MIPC) and the resulting unsupported identity judgment Conversational False Authentication (CFA). In each CFA case, the same model acted as challenge generator, evidence evaluator, and identity decision-maker, converting technical knowledge into supposed proof of identity. The accepted identities did not change the tested authorization boundaries, showing that false authentication and privilege escalation are distinct outcomes. These results identify self-issued authentication as a conversational security failure: authenticated identity must originate from an external security component, and model-generated dialogue must never create or modify identity or authorization state.
summary_zh: 当前大语言模型（LLM）安全领域的研究大多聚焦于角色扮演越狱问题，较少关注用户要求大语言模型通过自身设计的测试来验证身份声明时的行为表现。本文通过面向开发者身份的多阶段实验，对ChatGPT、Claude、Qwen、Mistral和Llama五款模型开展测试。结果显示，所有五款模型最初都拒绝了「我是你的开发者」这一缺乏支撑的身份声明：Claude直接拒绝开展身份验证测试，ChatGPT生成了面向开发者的相关问题，但同时强调作答仅能证明相关知识储备，无法证明身份归属。与之相对，Qwen和Mistral生成了技术挑战题，明确了可信证据的判定标准，对详细作答内容进行评估后，在未收到任何外部验证身份证据的情况下直接返回了「已验证」结果。Llama同样生成并执行了开发者测试流程，接受了用户声称的身份，后续甚至作出了自身可访问内部运行时与部署状态的不实声明。本文将这类由模型自身生成的验证流程定义为模型生成伪凭证（Model-Issued Pseudo-Credential, MIPC），将最终得到的无依据身份判定结果定义为会话式虚假认证（Conversational False Authentication, CFA）。在所有CFA案例中，同一模型同时承担了挑战生成方、证据评估方和身份决策方的角色，将技术知识转化为所谓的身份凭证。这类被模型认可的虚假身份并未改变被测模型的原有授权边界，说明虚假认证与权限提升是两类独立的安全结果。上述研究结果表明，自签发认证属于一类对话场景下的安全缺陷：经过认证的身份必须来自外部安全组件，模型生成的对话内容绝对不允许创建或修改身份、授权状态。

title: Characterizing Text Branch Sensitivity in Medical Vision-Language Segmentation via Evidence Decoupling
title_zh: 基于证据解耦表征医学视觉语言分割的文本分支敏感性
authors: Ziquan Liu, Zhewei Zhu, Xuyang Shi
abstract: Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising performance in medical image segmentation by incorporating clinical text. However, it remains unclear how much textual information actually contributes to pixel-level predictions. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of text in multimodal medical image segmentation. We first analyze several commonly used fusion strategies and find that segmentation performance is largely insensitive to the choice of fusion module. To further understand modality interactions, we propose an Evidence Decoupling Decoder (EDD) based on evidential deep learning and deep supervision. EDD serves as an internal representation analysis tool that decomposes image evidence and text-modulated evidence throughout the decoding process while maintaining competitive segmentation performance. Experimental results show that the sensitivity to text perturbation varies substantially across datasets. On BUSI and BTMRI, removing text causes catastrophic performance drops, indicating strong model reliance on textual input. On ISIC and Kvasir-SEG, text exerts relatively marginal influence. We further find that text affects predictions mainly through global semantic modulation rather than independent spatial localization, and that the specific semantic components driving text sensitivity differ across datasets. These findings provide a deeper understanding of modality interaction in multimodal medical image segmentation and offer practical insights for future model design.
summary_zh: 预训练视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）通过融合临床文本，在医学图像分割任务上展现出了优异性能，但目前学界仍不清楚文本信息对像素级预测的实际贡献占比。本研究系统探究了多模态医学图像分割任务中文本模块的作用：首先对几种常用的融合策略进行分析，发现分割性能对融合模块的选择整体不敏感。为进一步理解模态间的交互机制，本文基于证据深度学习与深度监督机制提出了证据解耦解码器（Evidence Decoupling Decoder, EDD），该工具可在保持具备竞争力的分割性能的前提下，对解码全过程中的图像证据与文本调制证据进行分解，用于内部表征分析。实验结果表明，不同数据集对文本扰动的敏感性差异极大：在BUSI和BTMRI数据集上，移除文本输入会导致性能灾难性下降，说明模型高度依赖文本输入；而在ISIC和Kvasir-SEG数据集上，文本的影响相对边际。研究进一步发现，文本主要通过全局语义调制而非独立空间定位的方式影响预测结果，且不同数据集驱动文本敏感性的具体语义组成存在差异。上述研究成果深化了学界对多模态医学图像分割模态交互机制的理解，可为后续模型设计提供实践参考。

title: From Plausible to Actionable: A Position on LLM Self-Explanations
title_zh: 从合理到可落地：大语言模型自解释性的研究立场
authors: Elize Herrewijnen, Benedetta Muscato, Gizem Gezici, Fosca Giannotti
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate natural language explanations that rationalize their own decisions, a phenomenon commonly referred to as self-explanations. Such explanations have emerged as a promising direction for explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), particularly for interpreting LLM behavior. However, while self-explanations often appear plausible, whether they faithfully reflect a model's underlying reasoning process remains an open question. In this opinion paper, we argue that self-explanations can be highly plausible, questionably faithful, and yet highly actionable. From a traditional XAI perspective, we identify the limitations of standard evaluation protocols for LLM-generated self-explanations and propose practical guidelines for assessing their plausibility andthis http URL, we argue that evaluation should extend beyond these criteria to actionability, highlighting applications of LLM rationalization capabilities that support informed decision-making and appropriate action across diverse stakeholders.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可生成自然语言解释来合理化自身决策，这类现象通常被称为自解释。这类解释是可解释人工智能（Explainable Artificial Intelligence, XAI）领域极具潜力的发展方向，尤其适用于大语言模型的行为解读。然而尽管自解释通常看起来逻辑自洽，其是否能忠实反映模型底层推理过程仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。本篇观点类论文指出，大语言模型生成的自解释可以同时具备高合理性、存疑的忠实度和高落地价值三大特征。本研究从传统XAI视角出发，指出了现有大语言模型自解释标准评估框架的局限性，提出了评估自解释合理性与忠实度的实操准则，并进一步提出评估维度应当延伸至可落地性层面，重点讨论了大语言模型合理化能力在支撑多元利益相关方作出知情决策、采取合理行动方面的应用价值。

title: Quantifying Logical Consistency in Transformers via Query-Key Alignment
title_zh: 通过查询-键对齐量化Transformer的逻辑一致性
authors: Eduard Tulchinskii, Anastasia Voznyuk, Laida Kushnareva, Andrei Andriiainen, Irina Piontkovskaya 等 (7 人)
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in various natural language processing tasks, yet their ability to perform multi-step logical reasoning remains an open challenge. Although Chain-of-Thought prompting has improved logical reasoning by enabling models to generate intermediate steps, it lacks mechanisms to assess the coherence of these logical transitions. In this paper, we propose a novel, lightweight evaluation strategy for logical reasoning that uses query-key alignments inside transformer attention heads. By computing a single forward pass and extracting a "QK-score" from carefully chosen heads, our method reveals latent representations that reliably separate valid from invalid inferences, offering a scalable alternative to traditional ablation-based techniques. We also provide an empirical validation on multiple logical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating improved robustness of our evaluation method against distractors and increased reasoning depth. The experiments were conducted on a diverse set of models, ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在各类自然语言处理任务中已经展现出优异性能，但其执行多步逻辑推理的能力仍然面临诸多挑战。尽管思维链（Chain-of-Thought）提示技术通过让模型生成中间步骤提升了逻辑推理表现，但该技术缺乏评估逻辑转换过程连贯性的机制。本文提出了一种轻量级的全新逻辑推理评估策略，利用Transformer注意力头内部的查询-键对齐关系开展评估：仅通过一次前向传播，从精心挑选的注意力头中提取「QK分数」，该方法可挖掘出能可靠区分有效推理与无效推理的隐层表征，是传统基于消融的评估技术之外的可扩展替代方案。研究在多个逻辑推理基准上开展了实证验证，结果表明该评估方法对干扰项的鲁棒性更强，可适配更大的推理深度。实验在参数量从1.5B到70B的多款不同类型模型上完成。

title: Likelihood-free inference with nuisance parameters through normalizing flows
title_zh: 含冗余参数的归一化流无似然推断
authors: Phil Assheton
abstract: We present a simple decomposition of a neural-network-based normalizing flow that naturally uncovers a pivotal statistic (or something close) in the presence of nuisance parameters, based only on a sample generator from the distribution of interest. We show that the statistic is near-pivotal in the sense of minimum average KL-divergence of its $p$-values versus uniform and we argue that it can be expected to have good power when the dimension of the statistic equals the dimension of the parameter. It is able to incorporate prior knowledge about group invariances such as translation and scale. It can discover the one-sample $t$-test almost exactly, outperforms the Welch test in terms of worst-case size over a constrained variance-ratio range and achieves good calibration on partial biserial correlations, while showing higher power (and being much faster) on small-to-moderate samples than profile likelihood-ratio techniques.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络归一化流的简单分解方法，仅利用目标分布的样本生成器，即可在存在冗余参数的场景下自然找到枢轴统计量（或近似枢轴统计量）。本文证明，该统计量满足近似枢轴性质：其p值与均匀分布的平均KL散度达到最小，且当统计量维度与参数维度相等时，可预期该方法具备优良的检验效能。该方法可融入关于群不变性（如平移不变、尺度不变）的先验知识，几乎可以精确复现单样本t检验，在受限方差比区间的最坏情况检验水准上优于Welch检验，在偏相关系数任务上实现了优良的校准效果，同时在中小样本场景下比轮廓似然比技术的检验效能更高、运行速度快得多。

title: A positive resolution of the gap-entropy conjecture
title_zh: 间隙-熵猜想的正向证明
authors: P. M. Aronow, Nathan Kallus, Patrick Lopatto
abstract: We prove the gap-entropy conjecture for fixed-confidence best-arm identification with independent unit-variance Gaussian arms, means in $[0,1]$, and a unique optimal arm. For each suboptimal arm $i$, let $\Delta_i=\mu_*-\mu_i$ be its gap from the optimal mean, and write $H=\sum_{i\ne *}\Delta_i^{-2}$. Let $p_r$ be the fraction of $H$ contributed by arms with $2^{-(r+1)}<\Delta_i\le2^{-r}$, and let $\mathrm{Ent}(I)=\sum_{r:p_r>0} p_r\log(1/p_r)$. Among all algorithms that identify the optimal arm with probability at least $1-\delta$ on every Gaussian instance, the optimal expected number of samples on a given instance, averaged over all permutations of the arm labels, is within absolute constant factors of $H(\log(1/\delta)+\mathrm{Ent}(I))$. Moreover, there is an algorithm, independent of the instance, whose expected number of samples is bounded by a constant multiple of this quantity plus $g^{-2}\log\log(e^e/g)$, where $g=\min_{i\ne *}\Delta_i$ is the gap to the closest competitor.
summary_zh: 本文针对独立单位方差高斯臂、均值取值范围为[0,1]且存在唯一最优臂的固定置信度最优臂识别问题，证明了间隙-熵猜想成立。对每个次优臂i，定义其与最优均值的间隙为Δ_i=μ_*-μ_i，记H=∑_{i≠*}Δ_i^{-2}。令p_r为满足2^{-(r+1)}<Δ_i≤2^{-r}的臂在H中贡献的占比，定义Ent(I)=∑_{r:p_r>0}p_r log(1/p_r)。在所有可对任意高斯实例以至少1-δ的概率识别最优臂的算法中，给定实例下的最优期望样本量，对所有臂标签排列取平均后，与H(log(1/δ)+Ent(I))的差值不超过绝对常数因子。此外，本文提出了一个不依赖实例的算法，其期望样本量的上界为上述值的常数倍加上g^{-2}log log(e^e/g)，其中g=min_{i≠*}Δ_i为最优臂与最接近的竞争臂的间隙。

title: Characterizing Language Generation in the Limit: Finite Witnesses and a Separation-Width Hierarch
title_zh: 极限下的语言生成表征：有限见证集与分离宽度层级
authors: Xiaoyu Li, Andi Han, Jiaojiao Jiang, Junbin Gao
abstract: Language generation in the limit asks for valid unseen elements from every exhaustive positive presentation of an unknown infinite language. We characterize this task for arbitrary families over a countable universe. Generation is possible exactly when each target can be assigned a finite positive witness so that the targets activated by any finite sample have an infinite common intersection. The necessary direction follows from a universal normalization: a search through unconfirmed histories converts any successful generator into one depending only on the observed set. We then ask how large compatible witnesses must be. Positive separation width records the smallest uniform size bound, with two further levels for unbounded finite witnesses and the absence of any compatible finite-witness assignment. Every level occurs. Countable families admit singleton witnesses, explicit families realize every finite width, and a union of two families with infinite common cores requires unbounded finite witnesses. Finally, countable-support and finite-profile obstructions explain why local combinatorial data cannot determine generation in the limit. The characterization and full width hierarchy are checked in Lean, including the simplified normalization and a direct diagonal capture lemma. The accompanying Lean development is maintained atthis https URL
summary_zh: 极限下的语言生成任务要求从未知无限语言的所有穷举正样本呈现中输出有效的未见过的语言元素。本文在可数论域下对任意语言族的该任务开展表征：当且仅当可为每个目标语言分配一个有限正见证集，使得任意有限样本激活的所有目标语言的交集为无限集时，该语言族的极限生成任务可解。必要性方向的结论可通过通用归一化方法推导：遍历所有未确认的历史记录，可将任意成功的生成器转换为仅依赖观测样本集合的生成器。本文进一步研究了兼容见证集的最小规模边界：定义正分离宽度为最小的统一规模边界，额外设置两个层级分别对应见证集大小无界有限、不存在兼容有限见证集的情况，且证明所有层级均可实现。可数语言族可使用单点见证集，显式语言族可实现任意有限宽度，两个公共核心为无限的语言族的并集需要无界有限见证集。最后，本文通过可数支撑障碍与有限剖面障碍解释了局部组合数据无法决定极限下语言生成任务的原因。上述表征与完整宽度层级均已在定理证明器Lean中完成验证，包含简化的归一化过程与直接对角捕获引理，配套的Lean开发代码托管在对应公开仓库中。

title: Optimal Low-Rank Quantum State Tomography with Bounded-Sample Joint Measurements
title_zh: 基于有限样本联合测量的最优低秩量子态层析
authors: Ashwin Nayak, Xingyu Zhou
abstract: We determine the optimal sample complexity of low-rank quantum state tomography when each measurement may act jointly on at most $t$ samples. For sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, estimating an unknown state on $\mathbb{C}^d$ of rank at most $r$ to trace norm error $\varepsilon$ with constant success probability requires, and is achievable with, $$\Theta\left(\frac{dr}{\varepsilon^2}\max\left\{1,\frac r{\sqrt t}\right\}\right)$$ samples. The lower bound allows the protocol to choose each joint measurement adaptively using all previous classical outcomes; the matching upper bound is nonadaptive. Thus joint measurements on at most $t$ samples improve the complexity of algorithms making single-sample measurements by at most a factor $\sqrt t$. Further, measuring order $r^2$ samples jointly is necessary and sufficient to attain the unrestricted collective rate.For the lower bound, we vary the support of a state with fixed uniform spectrum and bound the Fisher information trace of every joint measurement on $t$ samples. The adaptive Fisher chain rule and the van Trees inequality then give the trace norm lower bound. For the upper bound, we construct and analyze a nonadaptive tomography protocol based on a Gaussian joint measurement. An explicit second moment identity and a conditional Gaussian law outside the state's support give a rank-dependent error analysis, yielding the matching rate.
summary_zh: 本文确定了当每次测量最多可联合作用于t个样本时，低秩量子态层析的最优样本复杂度。当ε足够小时，要以恒定成功概率将定义在C^d空间上、秩不超过r的未知量子态估计到迹范数误差ε，所需的样本量下界为Θ(dr/ε² max{1, r/√t})，且该下界是可达的。下界证明允许协议利用所有历史经典结果自适应选择每次联合测量，与之匹配的上界协议是非自适应的。因此，最多作用于t个样本的联合测量，相比仅执行单样本测量的算法，最多可将复杂度提升√t倍。此外，要达到无约束集体测量的最优速率，必须且只需对r²量级的样本执行联合测量。下界推导过程中，本文通过改变具有固定均匀谱的量子态的支撑集，对t个样本上任意联合测量的费雪信息迹进行约束，再结合自适应费雪链式法则与van Trees不等式得到迹范数误差下界。上界部分，本文基于高斯联合测量构造并分析了非自适应层析协议，利用显式二阶矩恒等式与量子态支撑集外的条件高斯定律完成了依赖秩的误差分析，得到了匹配的最优速率。

title: Quantum Feature Engineering for Credit Default Prediction: When and Why IQP Circuits Help Linear Classifiers
title_zh: 面向信用违约预测的量子特征工程：瞬时量子多项式时间（IQP）电路何时及为何能助力线性分类器
authors: Menachem Finkelstein, Diana Legziel Levy, Zohar Yakhini, Sarel Cohen
abstract: Credit default prediction is a tabular classification problem in which modest gains in F1 translate directly into reduced financial exposure. We ask whether Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) circuits can produce features that improve a classifier over both its raw classical baseline and Kernel PCA - the strongest unsupervised classical non-linear alternative - at an equal feature budget. The dataset provides 23 financial attributes per client; for an n-qubit circuit we select n of them, encode each as a rotation angle, and read 2n expectation values back out as new features. The motivation for using a quantum circuit is computational: an n-qubit IQP circuit runs in constant depth and encodes feature correlations in a 2^n-dimensional Hilbert space, whereas classical simulation of its exact output statistics scales exponentially in n. Using the UCI Default of Credit Card Clients dataset and five-fold cross-validation, we find that appending 16 IQP features (n = 8 qubits) to a Logistic Regression model raises F1 from 0.462 to 0.517 (+0.055, p < 0.0001). Kernel PCA, the next-best method, reaches only 0.493 at the same feature count; the gap survives Benjamini-Hochberg correction across 12 tests (p = 0.00007). No other classifier - Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost, or k-NN - benefits, which points to a linear-expressivity mechanism rather than a generic improvement. We also show that how the 8 input features are chosen matters: Random Forest importance-guided selection reaches F1 = 0.523, while encoding maximally uncorrelated features drops it to 0.496, demonstrating that the circuit amplifies informative structure rather than creating it from scratch.
summary_zh: 信用违约预测是一类表格分类任务，F1指标的小幅提升可直接降低金融机构的风险敞口。本文研究了瞬时量子多项式时间（Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time, IQP）电路能否在相同特征预算下生成优于原始经典基线、也优于最强无监督经典非线性方法核主成分分析（Kernel PCA）的特征，提升分类器性能。所用数据集为每个客户提供23个金融属性，对于n量子比特电路，从中选取n个属性，将每个属性编码为旋转角度，最终读取2n个期望值作为新特征。使用量子电路的动机来自计算层面：n量子比特IQP电路可在恒定深度下运行，可在2^n维希尔伯特空间中编码特征相关性，而经典方法精确模拟其输出统计量的复杂度随n指数增长。基于UCI信用卡客户违约数据集与五折交叉验证的实验结果显示，向逻辑回归模型中添加16个IQP特征（对应n=8量子比特）可将F1值从0.462提升至0.517（提升0.055，p<0.0001）。在相同特征数量下，次优方法核主成分分析仅能达到0.493的F1值，该性能差距在12次Benjamini-Hochberg校正后仍然显著（p=0.00007）。随机森林、SVM、XGBoost、k近邻等其他分类器均无法从IQP特征中获益，说明该性能提升来自线性表达机制，而非通用性能增益。本文进一步证明8个输入特征的选择策略对结果影响显著：基于随机森林特征重要性引导的选择可达到0.523的F1值，而编码最大不相关特征会将F1值降至0.496，说明IQP电路是放大了数据中已有的有效信息结构，而非凭空生成有效特征。

title: Learning with Covariance Matrices: Principal Component Analysis Meets Learning with Graphs
title_zh: 协方差矩阵学习：主成分分析与图学习的融合研究
authors: Saurabh Sihag, Andrea Cavallo, Elvin Isufi, Gonzalo Mateos, Alejandro Ribeiro
abstract: This feature article provides an overview of the theoretical foundations for coVariance neural networks (VNNs), i.e., graph neural networks (GNNs) operating on covariance matrices as graphs. Covariance matrices are ubiquitous across domains, and hence, the deployment of GNNs often leverages graphs of pairwise statistical dependencies. Existing theoretical contributions on GNNs consider abstract graph representations and cannot accommodate the data-driven nuances associated with covariance matrices. This tutorial brings into focus various novel theoretical insights via mathematical analyses of VNNs that have broad signal processing implications, including: (i) a conceptual equivalence between VNNs and principal component analysis (PCA)-based information processing; (ii) refined stability bounds on predictive outcomes in the presence of finite sample-induced covariance matrix perturbations; and (iii) refined characterization of transferability of VNNs across multiscale datasets. The theoretical insights discussed herein provide the underlying principles and justification towards adopting VNNs over workhorse PCA-based learning pipelines, in applications where covariance matrices are useful descriptors of data structure. We also convey how impact of these foundational advances permeates to \textit{principled} designs and applications of learning methods across broad domains where covariance matrices emerge. Notably, we elucidate the conceptual insights facilitated by VNNs to the specific task of characterizing brain age gap for neurodegenerative conditions using neuroimaging datasets, a timely problem in computational neuroscience. Broader impacts to other application domains are discussed as well.
summary_zh: 本篇专题综述概述了协方差神经网络（coVariance Neural Networks, VNNs）的理论基础，这类图神经网络（Graph Neural Networks, GNNs）以协方差矩阵作为图结构开展运算。协方差矩阵在各领域广泛存在，因此图神经网络的部署经常利用成对统计依赖关系构建图。现有图神经网络理论研究大多考虑抽象图表征，无法适配协方差矩阵特有的数据驱动特性。本综述通过对VNNs的数学分析，重点介绍了一系列具备广泛信号处理应用价值的全新理论结论，包括：（1）VNN与基于主成分分析（Principal Component Analysis, PCA）的信息处理过程的概念等价性；（2）有限样本引发协方差矩阵扰动场景下，预测结果的精细化稳定性边界；（3）VNN在多尺度数据集间迁移性的精细化表征。上述理论结论为在协方差矩阵作为核心数据结构的应用场景中，采用VNN替代传统基于PCA的学习流水线提供了底层原理支撑与合理性依据。本文还阐释了这些基础进展如何推动协方差矩阵广泛存在的各领域学习方法的规范化设计与落地应用，特别举例说明了VNN在基于神经影像数据集表征神经退行性疾病脑年龄差这一计算神经科学热点任务中的概念价值，同时讨论了该技术在其他应用领域的拓展前景。

title: Nonmaximal sums of maximally monotone operators under Rockafellar's constraint qualification
title_zh: Rockafellar约束规范下极大单调算子的非极大和
authors: Weifeng Yang
abstract: We construct counterexamples to Rockafellar's sum conjecture in which two maximally monotone operators satisfy the interior-domain condition but their sum is not maximally monotone. We give one counterexample on $c_0$ and another on $\ell^1$ with its usual norm. We establish a general construction theorem that computes the entire monotone polar of a class of graphs, gives a necessary and sufficient condition for their maximal monotonicity, and shows how a positive rank-one perturbation yields a nonmaximal sum under this condition. We verify the theorem's hypotheses and its maximality criterion on $c_0$, thereby obtaining a counterexample to the conjecture. Furthermore, we construct a bounded linear surjection from $\ell^1$ onto $c_0$ and use it to obtain the counterexample on $\ell^1$.
summary_zh: 本文构造了针对Rockafellar和猜想的反例，其中两个极大单调算子满足内域条件，但二者的和不具备极大单调性。我们分别在$c_0$空间和赋有常规范数的$\ell^1$空间上给出了反例。研究建立了通用构造定理，可计算一类图的全体单调极，给出了这类图满足极大单调性的充要条件，并阐明正秩一扰动如何在该条件下产生非极大和。我们在$c_0$空间上验证了该定理的假设条件及其极大性判别准则，由此得到了该猜想的反例。此外，我们构造了一个从$\ell^1$空间到$c_0$空间的有界线性满射，并利用它得到了$\ell^1$空间上的反例。

title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Electrical Faults and Power Quality Disturbances in Aerospace Power Systems
title_zh: 基于深度学习的航空电力系统电气故障与电能质量扰动检测
authors: Ian C. Guzmán, Radu Babiceanu, Berker Peköz
abstract: More Electric Aircraft require fast and reliable monitoring of high-frequency electrical networks, yet most power quality disturbance and fault diagnosis methods are developed for conventional 50 or 60 Hz grids. This work presents a hardware-aware deep learning framework for multiclass detection of electrical faults and power quality disturbances in a 400 Hz aerospace power system. A high-fidelity simulation model inspired by the Boeing 787 electrical architecture generates voltage and current waveforms for 21 normal, disturbance, switching, open-circuit, and short-circuit conditions. Two datasets, each containing 73,500 samples, are formed from one-dimensional time-series signals and short-time Fourier transform time-frequency representations. Signal-processing augmentation, domain randomization, and class-specific generative adversarial networks increase waveform diversity, and the time-series dataset is released through IEEE DataPort. We compare 1D and 2D convolutional neural networks, long short-term memory networks, CNN-LSTM hybrids, ResNet, MobileNet, and VGG models under common training conditions. A compact ResNet provides the best accuracy-complexity tradeoff, achieving 96.94 percent software test accuracy with 175,685 parameters. After 8-bit quantization and deployment on a Xilinx Zynq UltraScale Plus MPSoC ZCU102, the model achieves 95.87 percent accuracy and a measured mean neural-network accelerator latency of 6.90 ms per input record. The results establish simulation-based, accelerator-level feasibility for embedded edge AI in aircraft electrical health monitoring and motivate future end-to-end data acquisition and experimental validation.
summary_zh: 多电飞机要求对高频电网进行快速可靠的监测，但现有大多数电能质量扰动与故障诊断方法都是针对传统50Hz或60Hz电网开发的。本文提出了一种面向硬件的深度学习框架，可对400Hz航空电力系统中的电气故障与电能质量扰动进行多分类检测。参考波音787电气架构搭建的高保真仿真模型可生成21种工况（含正常、扰动、开关操作、开路、短路）下的电压与电流波形。我们基于一维时序信号和短时傅里叶变换时频表示构建了两个数据集，每个数据集包含73500个样本。通过信号处理增广、域随机化和类别特定生成对抗网络提升波形多样性，其中时序数据集已通过IEEE DataPort公开发布。我们在统一训练条件下对比了一维和二维卷积神经网络、长短期记忆网络、CNN-LSTM（卷积-长短期记忆混合网络）、ResNet（残差网络）、MobileNet、VGG模型的性能。紧凑版ResNet实现了最优的准确率-复杂度权衡，仅含175685个参数，软件测试准确率可达96.94%。经过8位量化并部署到Xilinx Zynq UltraScale Plus MPSoC ZCU102开发板后，该模型的准确率可达95.87%，实测神经网络加速器平均单条输入记录延迟为6.90ms。研究结果验证了面向航空电力健康监测的嵌入式边缘AI基于仿真、在加速器层面的可行性，为后续端到端数据采集与实验验证工作提供了支撑。

title: Algorithmic stability via ensembling
title_zh: 基于集成的算法稳定性
authors: Rina Foygel Barber, Richard J. Samworth
abstract: Algorithmic stability refers to the property of an algorithm being insensitive to perturbations of the input data, where the type of perturbation may vary depending on the setting. In this work, we develop a general framework to quantify the extent to which any ensembling strategy defined via averaging can yield stability guarantees for any type of data perturbation. Our main theoretical result is a guarantee on the stability of this ensembled algorithm, given in terms of the norm of a certain covariance operator that describes the ensembling process. We show how our general framework yields interpretable and intuitive insights in several examples of perturbations of practical interest, and provides much sharper guarantees than those obtained from privacy considerations.
summary_zh: 算法稳定性指算法对输入数据的扰动不敏感的性质，扰动的类型可随场景变化。本文提出了一个通用框架，可量化任意通过平均定义的集成策略能够为任意类型的数据扰动提供稳定性保证的程度。我们的核心理论结果给出了该集成算法的稳定性保证，该保证通过描述集成过程的特定协方差算子的范数表示。我们证明了该通用框架可在多个具有实际研究意义的扰动示例中得到可解释的直观结论，且得到的稳定性保证比从隐私性角度推导的结果严格得多。

title: HybridFLow: SDN-Orchestrated Client Partitioning for Hybrid Federated Learning
title_zh: HybridFLow：由SDN（软件定义网络）编排的混合联邦学习客户端划分机制
authors: Osama Abu Hamdan, Rabin Pandey, Hao Che, Engin Arslan, Md Arifuzzaman
abstract: Cross-silo Federated Learning (FL) enables geographically distributed institutions to collaboratively train machine learning models without sharing raw data. In wide-area deployments, however, communication delays often dominate round completion time and exacerbate the straggler effect. Hybrid FL addresses this challenge by combining synchronous and asynchronous client participation, but effective partitioning requires visibility into network conditions such as shared bottlenecks, link utilization, and path contention that individual clients cannot observe. We present HybridFLow, a closed-loop SDN-driven orchestration framework that integrates network-layer intelligence directly into hybrid FL. Leveraging the SDN controller's global topology view, HybridFLow generates calibrated per-client communication-time estimates before each training round and uses them to partition clients into synchronous and asynchronous groups while balancing round latency and update staleness. After each round, measured communication times are fed back to the controller to continuously refine future predictions. Experimental results across multiple network topologies show that HybridFLow reaches 80% target accuracy 33-40% faster than SmartFLow and reduces average round duration by 30-40 seconds, while FedAsync fails to reach the target accuracy under non-IID data distributions.
summary_zh: 跨孤岛联邦学习（FL）可让地理分布的多个机构在不共享原始数据的前提下协作训练机器学习模型。但在广域部署场景下，通信延迟往往占据轮次完成时间的主导地位，会加剧掉队者效应。混合联邦学习通过结合同步与异步客户端参与模式应对该挑战，但高效的客户端划分需要掌握网络状态信息（如共享瓶颈、链路利用率、路径冲突），而这类信息是单个客户端无法观测到的。本文提出HybridFLow，一个由SDN驱动的闭环编排框架，将网络层智能直接集成到混合联邦学习中。利用SDN控制器的全局拓扑视图，HybridFLow可在每轮训练前生成经过校准的各客户端通信时间估计值，基于该估计值将客户端划分为同步组与异步组，同时平衡轮次延迟与更新陈旧度。每轮训练结束后，实测通信时间会反馈给控制器，持续优化后续预测结果。在多种网络拓扑下开展的实验结果表明，HybridFLow达到80%目标精度的速度比SmartFLow快33%~40%，平均轮次时长减少30~40秒；而在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据分布下，FedAsync甚至无法达到目标精度。

title: Searching for New Physics with Reinforcement Learning
authors: Jacky Kumar, Marianne Bouchard, David London
abstract: Finding new physics (NP) is the most important problem in particle physics today. Studying ``anomalies'', i.e., measurements of low-energy observables whose values disagree with the predictions of the Standard Model (SM), is a powerful search strategy. The SM Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general model-independent framework for parameterizing NP; it is natural to try to find the SMEFT operator(s) that can explain such anomalies. This is a challenging task because (i) the number of SMEFT operators is enormous, and (ii) at loop level there are very complicated correlations among the operators. Analyses by humans typically rely on phenomenological intuition to decide which operators are relevant. This is often biased and does not explore the complete SMEFT operator space. Interestingly, reinforcement learning (RL) techniques excel at tasks that require decision making to achieve their goals. In this paper, we introduce an RL method that can be used to find the SMEFT operators that explain any anomalies. We test it on the CDF $W$-mass anomaly, and show that it reproduces (and improves upon) known results. We then consider a far more complicated situation with multiple anomalies and show that, even here, this method is able to find the SMEFT operators that explain the data. Our RL method can therefore be used to efficiently search for NP at the level of SMEFT.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain: Pretraining Familiarity Survives a Contamination-Free Hold-Out
title_zh: 时间更晚的测试集并非新域：无泄露留出集下预训练熟悉度效应仍然存在
authors: Mahdi Naser Moghadasi, Faezeh Ghaderi
abstract: Time-series foundation models are evaluated almost exclusively on public archives that predate them, so a strong score cannot be separated from having seen the test set during pretraining. The obvious remedy is a hold-out that postdates the models. We build one: thirteen forecasters -- four classical, three trained per dataset, six pretrained -- on seven groups drawn from five domains, every observation published after the last model was released, and every dataset rebuildable without an API key. Under this protocol pretrained models win 5 of 7 groups, lose one to a Theta baseline, and on daily exchange rates are indistinguishable from a seasonal naive forecast, along with every other method tested.We then ask what separates the wins from the losses, and report a negative result: the two intrinsic properties one would reach for -- seasonal strength and spectral entropy, measured on the input window -- do not account for the pattern, and seasonal strength is if anything negatively associated with the advantage. What does track it is corpus familiarity. Our largest gain (28% lower MASE than the best classical method, on weekly Wikipedia pageviews) falls on Wikipedia pageviews, the domain TimesFM's authors describe as the bulk of its pretraining corpus, at the same granularities and differing only in time window. Within the pretrained family, where every model forecasts identical series so that series difficulty cancels, the TimesFM family outranks the Chronos family by -0.53 ranks on Wikipedia against -0.09 everywhere else (1,500 vs. 754 series, Mann-Whitney p < 1e-5). We conclude that a temporal hold-out removes memorisation of a window but not familiarity with a domain, that benchmarks therefore need domain hold-outs stated relative to disclosed corpora, and that the practitioner's question is less which model is better than whether their domain is one the model was raised on.
summary_zh: 时序基础模型几乎全部在早于自身发布时间的公开档案上进行评估，因此模型在测试集上的高表现无法区分是来自模型性能本身还是预训练阶段已经见过该测试集。最直接的解决思路是使用发布时间晚于模型的留出测试集。本文构建了这样一个数据集：包含13个预测器（4个经典预测器、3个针对单数据集训练的预测器、6个预训练预测器），覆盖来自5个域的7个分组，所有观测值的发布时间均晚于所有模型的发布时间，且所有数据集无需API密钥即可完全复现。在该协议下，预训练模型在7个分组中的5个上取得最优表现，1个分组上输给Theta基线模型，在日汇率数据集上的表现与季节性朴素预测方法及所有其他测试方法无显著差异。随后我们探究了模型表现优劣的背后原因，得到了一个负向结论：研究者通常会考虑的两个内在属性——输入窗口测得的季节性强度与谱熵——无法解释该表现模式，且季节性强度与预训练模型的优势甚至呈负相关。真正与该优势相关的是语料库熟悉度。我们观测到的最大性能提升（在维基百科周浏览量数据集上，MASE（平均绝对标度误差）比最优经典方法低28%）出现在维基百科页面浏览量域，而该域正是TimesFM的作者描述的预训练语料主体，二者粒度一致仅时间窗口不同。在预训练模型家族内部，由于所有模型预测的序列完全一致，序列难度的影响被抵消，我们发现TimesFM家族在维基百科数据集上的排名比Chronos家族低0.53，而在其他所有域上该差值仅为-0.09（对应1500条序列vs754条序列，Mann-Whitney检验p<1e-5）。据此我们得出结论：时间留出集只能消除模型对测试窗口的记忆，无法消除模型对域的熟悉度，因此基准测试需要基于公开披露的预训练语料设置域留出集；对于从业者而言，更值得关注的并非哪个模型性能更优，而是目标域是否属于该模型预训练阶段已经接触过的域。

title: TimeCues Studio: A Workspace for Music Annotation and Algorithm Prototyping
title_zh: TimeCues Studio：面向音乐标注与算法原型开发的工作空间
authors: Sapir Caduri, Yoav Goldberg
abstract: Multimedia applications require precise music annotation-labeled positions, segments, or loops-placed by hand or algorithmically. Machine-learning algorithms are scalable and effective but need annotated training data, scarce for many tasks. TimeCues Studio is an open-source workspace where algorithm-development teams annotate a music corpus, compare detection algorithms against those annotations, and prototype new ones. Unlike existing tools built for a single track at a time, TimeCues targets teams annotating whole collections, tightly integrated with algorithm development. Annotators place several marker types-each supporting ambiguity-aware labeling-on a grid-locked timeline that visualizes many music features, including separated audio stems. The same timeline drives an algorithm-comparison engine with bundled baselines, a Python sandbox for prototyping new models, and an ambiguity-aware evaluator that honors the structured fields. The same visualization suits solo annotators on music-sync projects. TimeCues is MIT-licensed and deploys via one Docker Compose command.
summary_zh: 多媒体应用需要精准的音乐标注——即人工或算法生成的标注位置、片段或循环点。机器学习算法具备可扩展性且效果优异，但需要标注训练数据，而这类数据在很多任务中都十分稀缺。TimeCues Studio是一个开源工作空间，算法开发团队可在该平台上完成音乐语料标注、对照标注结果对比不同检测算法、开发新算法原型。与现有仅支持单次处理单条音轨的工具不同，TimeCues面向需要标注完整音乐集合的团队，与算法开发流程深度集成。标注人员可在对齐网格的时间轴上放置多种类型的标记，所有标记均支持感知歧义的标注逻辑，该时间轴可可视化多种音乐特征，包括分离后的音频音轨。同一时间轴还可驱动集成了基线算法的算法对比引擎、用于开发新模型的Python沙箱，以及支持歧义感知、符合标注结构化字段的评估器。该可视化工具同样适用于开展音乐同步项目的独立标注人员。TimeCues采用MIT许可证开源，仅需一条Docker Compose命令即可完成部署。

title: A Dominant Diffuse Phase in the Sparse Autoencoder Phase Diagram
title_zh: 稀疏自编码器相图中的主导弥散相
authors: Alexis D. Plascencia
abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used to recover interpretable features from neural-network activations, yet systematic feature co-occurrence can cause distinct features to be absorbed or merged. The MAIS-O43 open problem proposes a controlled experiment to characterize when recovery of a true synthetic dictionary gives way to feature merging as the nesting fraction $\gamma$, sparsity penalty $\lambda$, and dictionary size $M$ vary. We implement the specified protocol and evaluate 200 independently initialized fits across ten of the 165 grid cells. We observe zero full-dictionary recoveries and zero merges. Instead, every run converges to a reproducible diffuse phase: reconstruction is nearly perfect, but learned atoms typically remain far from the true features (median best cosine 0.5-0.7 against a 0.95 recovery criterion) and learned codes are an order of magnitude denser than the ground truth. This behavior persists under robustness checks and across the full 165-cell grid using standard minibatch Adam (3,300 additional fits). Since the global optimum of the exact sparse-coding objective is known to merge nested features in the two-feature case, these results suggest that trained SAEs need not reach the corresponding minima, and that the phase diagram of trained models may differ fundamentally from that of objective minimizers.
summary_zh: 稀疏自编码器（Sparse autoencoders, SAEs）目前被广泛用于从神经网络激活中提取可解释特征，但系统性的特征共现可能导致不同特征被吸收或合并。MAIS-O43开放问题提出了一项对照实验，旨在探究当嵌套占比$\gamma$、稀疏惩罚$\lambda$和字典大小$M$变化时，真实合成字典的可恢复性会在何时让位于特征合并。我们实现了该实验设定的流程，在165个网格单元中的10个单元上完成了200次独立初始化的拟合实验。我们未观测到任何完整字典恢复的情况，也未观测到任何特征合并现象。相反，所有运行结果都收敛到一个可复现的弥散相：重构效果几乎完美，但学习得到的原子通常与真实特征相差甚远（最优余弦相似度中位数为0.5~0.7，远低于0.95的恢复阈值），且学习得到的编码的密度比真实值高一个数量级。通过鲁棒性检验、以及在全部165个网格单元上使用标准小批量Adam优化器开展的额外3300次拟合实验均验证了该行为的稳定性。由于在两特征场景下，精确稀疏编码目标的全局最优解已知会合并嵌套特征，本文结果表明，训练得到的稀疏自编码器无需达到对应的极小值点，训练后模型的相图与目标函数极小化器的相图可能存在本质差异。

title: The Semantic Bottleneck: Leveraging Semantic Representations for Non-Invasive Speech Decoding
title_zh: 语义瓶颈：利用语义表征实现非侵入式语音解码
authors: Gilad D. Landau, Dulhan Jayalath, Oiwi Parker Jones
abstract: Non-invasive speech decoding remains constrained by the low signal-to-noise ratio of neural recordings, which makes fine-grained reconstruction of phonemes or individual words difficult. Motivated by neuroscientific evidence that high-level semantic representations are distributed across cortical regions and evolve over slower temporal scales, we hypothesize that semantic content may provide a more suitable target for non-invasive decoding than low-level acoustic or lexical features. We introduce Brain2Semantics2Text, a method that reconstructs text through an intermediate semantic embedding space. Our model maps sentence-level MEG responses into a semantic manifold and then inverts the predicted embeddings into natural language. This semantic bottleneck enables recovery of high-level meaning without word-level alignment. We describe the core principles of the approach, its implementation, and the strategies used to mitigate the challenges of learning a reliable neural-to-semantic mapping. Finally, we compare against prior non-invasive Brain2Text methods and show improved sentence-level results.
summary_zh: 由于神经记录的信噪比很低，非侵入式语音解码目前仍受限于音素或单个词的细粒度重建难度。神经科学证据表明，高层语义表征分布在多个脑皮层区域，且演化的时间尺度更慢，受此启发我们提出假设：与低层声学或词汇特征相比，语义内容可能是非侵入式解码更合适的目标。本文提出Brain2Semantics2Text方法，可通过中间语义嵌入空间重建文本。该模型将句子级脑磁图（MEG）响应映射到语义流形，再将预测得到的嵌入反译为自然语言。该语义瓶颈无需词级对齐即可恢复高层语义含义。本文阐述了该方法的核心原理、实现方式，以及用于缓解学习可靠神经-语义映射相关挑战的策略。最后，我们将该方法与现有非侵入式Brain2Text方法进行对比，结果表明其在句子级任务上的表现更优。

title: Training Trajectories Determine Circuit Removability in Annealable Soft-Prior Transformers
title_zh: 训练轨迹决定可退火软先验Transformer的电路可移除性
authors: Zonglin Yang, Ziming Zhao, Wei Tang, Xunyu Jiang, Yihong Liu 等 (8 人)
abstract: Soft positional priors can help small Transformers learn retrieval circuits, but it is unclear whether the resulting circuits remain functional once the prior is removed. We test this with an annealable soft-prior Transformer whose attention biases can be learned, faded, or zeroed during training and evaluation. On associative recall, unforced models perform well with the prior active ($0.772 \pm 0.020$) but collapse at zero gate ($0.095 \pm 0.009$). Smooth fade-to-zero training preserves high zero-gate accuracy ($0.734 \pm 0.028$), whereas forced-zero training, hard switching, and post hoc continuation fail to recover the same effect. The pattern also appears on Markov induction. Linear regression ICL provides a boundary case because zero-gate training can learn that task directly. Mechanistic traces show that circuit consolidation occurs after the gate reaches zero, even though the responsible heads vary across seeds. These results suggest that circuit removability in small discrete retrieval tasks depends on the training trajectory, not just the final architecture.
summary_zh: 软位置先验可帮助小型Transformer学习检索电路，但目前尚不清楚当先验被移除后，得到的电路是否仍能正常工作。本文使用可退火软先验Transformer开展验证，该模型的注意力偏置可在训练和评估阶段被学习、衰减或置零。在关联回忆任务上，未施加约束的模型在先验激活时表现优异（准确率$0.772 \pm 0.020$），但当门限置零时性能会崩溃（准确率仅$0.095 \pm 0.009$）。采用平滑衰减到零的训练方式可在门限置零时仍保持高准确率（$0.734 \pm 0.028$），而强制置零训练、硬切换和事后微调均无法达到同等效果。该规律同样在马尔可夫归纳任务上得到验证。线性回归上下文学习（ICL）是一个边界案例，因为门限置零训练可直接学习该任务。机制追踪结果表明，即便不同随机种子下对应的注意力头存在差异，电路整合仍会在门限置零后发生。上述结果表明，小型离散检索任务中的电路可移除性由训练轨迹决定，而非仅由最终架构决定。

title: Structural Fusion of Bayesian Networks with Limited Treewidth Using Genetic Algorithms
title_zh: 树宽受限场景下基于遗传算法的贝叶斯网络结构融合
authors: Pablo Torrijos, José A. Gámez, José M. Puerta
abstract: This paper introduces an evolutionary computation approach for consensus in structural Bayesian Network (BN) fusion under the constraint of limited treewidth. The consensus BN aims to reconcile multiple input BNs into a single one that retains key structural features present in the original networks. Treewidth, a graph-based parameter associated with computationally tractable inference, is utilized to restrict the complexity of the resulting network. A genetic algorithm is proposed to look for a BN that codifies as much information about the unrestricted fusion as possible while ensuring the treewidth restriction. Experimental evaluation demonstrates the genetic algorithm's ability to obtain consensus BNs with limited treewidth, providing a valuable tool for aggregating information from diverse sources while returning a computationally actionable model.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种进化计算方法，用于在树宽约束下实现贝叶斯网络（Bayesian Network, BN）结构融合的共识构建。共识贝叶斯网络旨在将多个输入贝叶斯网络整合为单一网络，同时保留原始网络中存在的关键结构特征。树宽是一种基于图的参数，与可计算推理的复杂度直接相关，本文利用该参数限制融合后网络的复杂度。研究提出了一种遗传算法，可在满足树宽约束的前提下，尽可能多地保留无约束融合过程中的信息。实验评估表明，该遗传算法能够得到树宽受限的共识贝叶斯网络，为聚合多源信息并输出可计算的实用模型提供了有效工具。

title: Maverick: Private and Verifiable LLM Inference Made Practical via Matrix-Vector Multiplication Delegation
title_zh: Maverick：基于矩阵-向量乘法委托实现实用化隐私可验证大语言模型推理
authors: Ben Merbaum, Mohammad Amin Raeisi, Wenhao Wang, Charalampos Papamanthou, Katerina Sotiraki 等 (6 人)
abstract: Open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly competitive with closed-source models while offering transparency and the ability to run inference without exposing user inputs to a service provider. However, running large-scale models locally requires substantial computational resources. In practice, users may still resort to a third-party provider, giving rise to privacy and correctness concerns. Existing solutions that address these problems often impose substantial server overhead or introduce additional trust assumptions.In this paper, we present Maverick, a novel approach to private and verifiable LLM inference based on a protocol for delegating matrix-vector multiplication, a dominant operation in LLMs. At its core, Maverick provides, to our knowledge, the first information-theoretically sound verification protocol for matrix-vector multiplication delegation with transparent preprocessing, efficient (batch) verification, and virtually no server overhead. We combine this verification primitive with LPN-based pseudorandom masking to provide input privacy.We implement our matrix-vector delegation primitive and use it to build an end-to-end prototype of Maverick, which we evaluate on Qwen3-4B by measuring throughput in tokens per second. We evaluate client configurations with 1-8 threads. With one client thread and a CPU server using up to 128 threads, Maverick achieves throughput gains over local inference of up to 17x when privacy masks are generated online, 45x when they are precomputed, and 44x when only verification is required. With four client threads, the corresponding gains are 13x, 18x, and 17x. When server computation is no longer the bottleneck, client-side microbenchmarks with simulated network delay show speedups of 12x-20x, 34x-135x, and 38x-157x.
summary_zh: 开源大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的性能正逐步与闭源模型看齐，同时具备透明性优势，且可在不向服务提供商暴露用户输入的前提下完成推理。但在本地运行大规模模型需要极高的计算资源，实际场景中用户往往仍需借助第三方服务提供商完成推理，由此引发隐私泄露与结果正确性存疑的问题。现有解决方案通常会带来极高的服务器开销，或是引入额外的信任假设。本文提出Maverick，一种基于矩阵-向量乘法委托协议的新型隐私可验证大语言模型推理方案，矩阵-向量乘法是大语言模型中的核心运算。据我们所知，Maverick首次实现了信息论安全的矩阵-向量乘法委托验证协议，具备透明预处理、高效（批量）验证的特性，且几乎不会产生额外服务器开销。我们将该验证原语与基于LPN（带噪声的奇偶学习）的伪随机掩码相结合，实现了输入隐私保护。本文实现了矩阵-向量委托原语，并基于其构建了Maverick的端到端原型，在Qwen3-4B模型上以每秒生成令牌数为指标完成性能评估。实验覆盖1-8线程的客户端配置场景：当客户端使用1线程、CPU服务器最多使用128线程时，在线生成隐私掩码的场景下Maverick的吞吐量相比本地推理最高提升17倍，预计算隐私掩码场景下最高提升45倍，仅需验证功能的场景下最高提升44倍；当客户端使用4线程时，上述三类场景的吞吐量提升分别为13倍、18倍和17倍。当服务器计算不再成为瓶颈时，模拟网络延迟的客户端微基准测试显示，三类场景下的速度提升分别可达12-20倍、34-135倍和38-157倍。

title: Through the Looking Glass: Directly Reading and Writing Transformers
title_zh: 透过窥镜：直接读写Transformer模型
authors: Mark Oskin
abstract: How many of a transformer's components decide a token? Counted by the absolute value of each unit's and channel's contribution to the logit, one prediction rests on thousands to hundreds of thousands of them. But contributions are signed, and across eighteen models the mass pushing away from the predicted token is a median of seven times the mass carrying it. Divide by the net and the count is dozens: on the baseline, 53 components carry ninety percent of a prediction, 13 it cannot survive losing, and 8 suffice to produce it alone. Across twelve models trained elsewhere, 124M to 7B parameters, the sufficient set runs from two components to sixteen, and what a prediction draws on, followed all the way back, is one to three percent of the model, a share that does not grow with size. Three quarters of a layer's update is a fixed linear map of the state it received.Everything is read from the model's own parameters and activations, with nothing trained or fitted, and it names a component on both sides: what it writes, from the predictions it drives, reaching close to half of every model; what it reads, from its weights in the frame of its own layer, at 58.9 percent above chance over its eight strongest inputs. Sorting the remainder by upstream source yields grammatical categories the embedding cannot see.A name can be acted on. An association the model does not hold installs into one spare unit, key and value read from the weights, for a quarter of a percent of held-out loss, a fortieth of what a rank-one update costs. An installed attention head and a unit two layers above it make an edit fire only where a token occurred earlier in the context, and a unit the model trained for itself is driven from two layers upstream, 86 percent of the effect passing through it. An order-preserving activation puts a unit's inputs at the instrument's ceiling, at the price of a two-part install.
summary_zh: Transformer模型的多少个组件共同决定了一个输出令牌？通过统计每个单元和通道对对数几率（logit）的贡献绝对值可以发现，单条预测依赖数千到数十万个组件。但贡献值存在正负差异，对18个不同模型的统计显示，对预测令牌产生负向作用的贡献总强度中位数是正向作用总强度的7倍。将正负贡献抵消后，有效组件数量仅为数十个：基准模型中53个组件承载了90%的预测贡献，13个组件是预测不可缺失的核心，仅需8个组件就足以独立生成该预测。对12个参数量从124M到7B的第三方预训练模型测试发现，生成单条预测所需的最小组件集合规模仅为2到16个，预测实际调用的模型占比仅为1%到3%，且该占比不会随模型参数量增长而提升。Transformer层75%的更新内容本质上是其接收状态的固定线性映射。所有分析过程均直接读取模型自身的参数与激活值，无需额外训练或拟合，可同时实现两类操作：写操作可通过驱动预测修改接近半数的模型参数，读操作可基于层内权重定位核心输入，其对8个最强输入的定位准确率比随机猜测高58.9%。将剩余激活按上游来源分类，可得到嵌入层无法识别的语法类别。该机制可直接用于模型编辑：仅需修改一个空闲单元的键值权重，即可植入模型原本不具备的关联关系，带来的留出损失增幅仅为0.25%，开销仅为秩一更新操作的1/40。植入一个注意力头和其上层的一个单元，可让编辑操作仅在对应令牌之前出现在上下文时才触发；模型原生训练得到的单元可通过上游两层的信号直接驱动，86%的编辑效果可通过该单元传递。采用保序激活机制可将单元输入提升至操作上限，仅需两步植入即可完成配置。

title: Robust Beam Prediction for V2X Networks with Multi-Modal Sensing
title_zh: 面向多模态感知车联网（V2X）的鲁棒波束预测
authors: Chen Shang, Dinh Thai Hoang, Diep N. Nguyen, Jiadong Yu
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) provides a promising foundation for beam prediction in future vehicle-to-everything (V2X) networks. However, existing sensing-assisted beamforming methods still rely heavily on radio-frequency sensing, which may become unreliable in complex vehicular environments. Meanwhile, the growing availability of heterogeneous sensors, such as cameras and LiDAR, offers new opportunities to improve beam prediction through richer environmental perception. Motivated by this, this paper proposes a multi-modal beam prediction framework for V2X networks. Specifically, we develop BeamTransFuser, a hierarchical Transformer-based architecture that progressively fuses camera, LiDAR, radar, and GPS observations for robust beam prediction. In addition, to handle possible missing modalities in practical deployment, we introduce a generative module that reconstructs missing modality features from the available observations. Experimental results on a real-world multi-modal V2X dataset show that the proposed framework consistently outperforms representative baselines, while the generative module further improves robustness under incomplete sensing conditions.
summary_zh: 通感一体化（Integrated Sensing and Communication, ISAC）为未来车联网（Vehicle-to-Everything, V2X）场景下的波束预测提供了极具前景的技术基础。但现有感知辅助波束成形方法仍高度依赖射频感知，在复杂车载环境下可靠性不足。与此同时，摄像头、激光雷达等异构传感器的普及，可通过更丰富的环境感知能力为波束预测性能提升带来新机遇。基于该背景，本文提出一种面向车联网的多模态波束预测框架，具体设计了BeamTransFuser——一种基于分层Transformer的架构，可逐步融合摄像头、激光雷达、雷达和GPS的观测数据，实现鲁棒波束预测。此外为应对实际部署中可能出现的模态缺失问题，本文引入生成模块，可基于已有的观测数据重建缺失模态的特征。在真实世界多模态车联网数据集上的实验结果表明，所提框架的性能始终优于各类代表性基线方法，且生成模块可进一步提升感知不完整场景下的模型鲁棒性。

title: An Exponential Deterministic--Randomized Gap in ERM-Oracle Complexity for Thresholds on an Unknown Order
authors: Xuan Li
abstract: Attias, Hanneke and Ramaswami (NeurIPS 2025) asked whether randomization provably reduces the oracle calls needed for online learning when the class is accessible only through an oracle. We study the instance they singled out: transductive online learning of thresholds on an unknown total order of T instances, with a consistency-type ERM oracle that returns a full concept consistent with a queried labeled set (or reports non-realizability). Our main result is a separation for a fixed natural oracle. When the oracle is the minimal-prefix rule (or the maximal-prefix rule), every deterministic learner makes M mistakes and Q calls with $M+Q\ge T-\varepsilon$ on some instance ($\varepsilon\in\{0,1\}$, according to whether the empty prefix is a concept), and the constant is exact; hence $O(\log T)$ mistakes cost $T-\varepsilon-O(\log T)$ calls, whereas that paper's randomized learner achieves $O(\log T)$ expected calls and mistakes under the same rule. The randomized order is optimal: on an explicit hard distribution under the minimal-prefix rule, every learner has expected mistakes at least $((T+1-\varepsilon)\,128^{-\mathbb{E}[Q]}-1)/2$, so $\Omega(\log T)$ expected calls are necessary for polylogarithmic mistakes. The separation is governed by the oracle's selection rule, not by the class alone: for a legal feasible-median ERM rule a deterministic learner achieves $O(\log T)$ calls and mistakes, while a global-median rule again forces linear total cost. The same linear bound holds when the oracle's answers are chosen adversarially and then frozen into a memoryless oracle. We add partial tradeoff results for fixed query budgets (the middle regime is open) and an interface contrast: with only a weak consistency oracle, returning a realizability bit, both deterministic and randomized learners need $\Theta(T)$ calls.

title: Are You Learning Biological Signal or Shortcuts? Auditing and Mitigating Bias in Protein-Protein Interaction Datasets
title_zh: 你学习的是生物信号还是捷径？蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）数据集的偏差审计与缓解
authors: Judith Bernett, Anton Spannagl, Joel Ås, Markus List, David B. Blumenthal
abstract: Protein-protein interaction (PPI) databases do not faithfully reflect biological realities. Instead, they are influenced by study and technical biases that distort certain protein and interaction attributes. Machine learning models can exploit these as learning shortcuts if the negative dataset is not constructed with care. So far, the shortcuts introduced during PPI dataset construction have only been examined in isolation. Here, we systematically characterize both reported and, to our knowledge, previously unreported biases in PPI datasets that lead machine learning models to learn shortcuts instead of biological signal. We analyze HIPPIE, IntAct, and STRING, dedicated PPI databases, as well as two datasets derived from 3D-structural information in the Protein Data Bank (PDB). We show that random data splitting introduces strong topological shortcuts. When train-test protein overlap is removed, the resulting datasets still retain usable shortcuts stemming from self-interactions, taxonomic identity, and functional relatedness, whose prevalence interestingly depends on the data source. We further show that sampling negatives from a set of high-confidence non-interactors, an intuitively appealing choice, can amplify the shortcut stemming from functional relatedness. To detect and mitigate these biases, we provide an open Nextflow pipeline that combines similarity-aware, data-loss-minimizing dataset splitting with bias-minimizing negative sampling, both formulated as integer linear programs. Its key concept of quantifying biases to minimize them through optimization-based negative sampling can, in principle, be extended to any machine learning problem where the pool of negative candidates is much larger than the positives and is thus of interest also beyond PPI prediction.
summary_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（Protein-Protein Interaction, PPI）数据库无法完全真实地反映生物实际规律，会受到研究偏差和技术偏差的影响，导致部分蛋白质和相互作用的属性被扭曲。如果负样本数据集构建不当，机器学习模型就会利用这些偏差作为学习捷径。目前针对PPI数据集构建过程中引入的捷径效应，相关研究仅在孤立场景下开展验证。本文系统梳理了PPI数据集中已被报道以及据我们所知尚未被报道的各类偏差，这些偏差会导致机器学习模型学习到捷径而非真实生物信号。研究分析了HIPPIE、IntAct、STRING三个专用PPI数据库，以及两个基于蛋白质数据库（Protein Data Bank, PDB）三维结构信息构建的衍生数据集，发现随机数据划分会引入极强的拓扑捷径；在移除训练集和测试集的蛋白质重叠后，数据集仍存在来自自相互作用、分类学身份、功能相关性的可用捷径，且这类捷径的占度随数据源的不同存在明显差异。研究进一步发现，从高置信度非相互作用集合中采样负样本这一符合直觉的方案，反而会放大由功能相关性带来的捷径效应。为检测和缓解这类偏差，本文开源了基于Nextflow的处理流水线，该流水线结合了感知相似度、最小化数据损失的数据集划分方法与偏差最小化的负采样策略，两类操作均被建模为整数线性规划问题。其核心思路是通过量化偏差、基于优化的负采样实现偏差最小化，该方法原则上可推广到所有负候选样本规模远大于正样本的机器学习场景，应用价值不局限于PPI预测任务。

title: CoGe-GCD: Reframing Generalized Category Discovery with Compositional Generalization
title_zh: CoGe-GCD：基于组合泛化重构广义类别发现任务
authors: Luyao Tang, Jiewei Zheng, Kunze Huang, Chaoqi Chen, Yue Huang 等 (6 人)
abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) assigns unlabeled instances, mixed with labeled data, to known or novel categories, requiring human-like compositional reasoning: reusing primitives learned from known classes and deciding when new combinations imply new categories. Existing GCD methods operate on unstructured token features and struggle to extrapolate to novel compositions. We propose CoGe-GCD, which rethinks GCD through compositional generalization with two coupled stages. (i) Compositional Perception structures patch tokens by mapping them to a small vocabulary of primitives and refining token embeddings via competitive token-primitive assignment and information passing, yielding coherent groups for discovery. (ii) Generalizing Induction exploits the induced geometric structure and applies a structure-preserving calibration over spatial relations, maintaining probabilistic semantics while improving extrapolation to unseen primitive combinations. CoGe-GCD is implemented as an inductive-bias module between backbone and projection head, without modifying heads or losses, and can be plugged into diverse GCD frameworks. On standard benchmarks, it consistently improves all-class accuracy, unknown-class number estimation, and geometric quality, with marginal computational overhead. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 广义类别发现（Generalized Category Discovery, GCD）任务需要将与标注数据混合的未标注实例分配到已知类别或新类别中，要求模型具备类人级别的组合推理能力：即复用从已知类别中学到的基元特征，判断新的特征组合是否对应新类别。现有GCD方法基于非结构化令牌特征运行，难以外推到从未见过的新组合。本文提出CoGe-GCD框架，从组合泛化的角度重新设计GCD任务，包含两个耦合阶段：（1）组合感知阶段：将补丁令牌映射到小规模基元词汇表，通过竞争性的令牌-基元分配和信息传递优化令牌嵌入，生成可用于类别发现的一致性特征组；（2）泛化归纳阶段：利用诱导得到的几何结构，对空间关系执行保结构校准，在保留概率语义的同时提升对未见过的基元组合的外推能力。CoGe-GCD以归纳偏置模块的形式部署在骨干网络和投影头之间，无需修改原有分类头和损失函数，可嵌入到各类GCD框架中。在标准基准数据集上的测试结果表明，该模块可在仅引入极低计算开销的前提下，持续提升全类别分类准确率、未知类别数量估计精度和特征几何质量。代码已公开在对应项目链接中。

title: CompassOPD: Cross-Family On-Policy Distillation via Within-Family Likelihood Shifts
title_zh: CompassOPD：基于族内似然偏移的跨族在线蒸馏
authors: Naibin Gu, Qingyi Si, Chenxu Yang, Chuanyu Qin, Junhao Zhou 等 (8 人)
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories. Although OPD performs strongly when teacher and student belong to the same model family, we find that its effectiveness degrades in cross-family settings even after tokenizer alignment, with substantially stronger external teachers offering little additional improvement. To understand this disconnect, we decompose the cross-family OPD signal into two components: an offset between a low-capability teacher-family reference and the student, and the within-family log-likelihood shift from that reference to the strong teacher. Standard OPD transfers both components together, allowing the offset to dominate the update direction and obscure the changes associated with teacher capability improvements. We propose CompassOPD, which removes this offset and transfers the within-family shift, while a frozen student reference anchors updates to the student's initial policy. Thus, both teacher-side and student-side changes are measured within their respective model families. Experiments across three student families and multiple teacher families show that CompassOPD consistently outperforms standard cross-family OPD, improving average reasoning accuracy by up to 5.50 points. For an MoE teacher, we further construct the reference directly from the teacher checkpoint by reducing expert activation, eliminating the need for a separate reference checkpoint while retaining a 3.43-point gain over OPD.
summary_zh: 在线蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）可在学生模型生成的轨迹上提供稠密的令牌级监督信号。当教师模型和学生模型属于同一模型族时，在线蒸馏性能优异，但我们发现即使完成分词器对齐，跨族场景下在线蒸馏的性能也会出现明显下降，能力更强的外部教师模型几乎无法带来额外性能提升。为解释该现象，本文将跨族在线蒸馏的监督信号分解为两部分：低能力教师族参考模型与学生模型之间的偏移量，以及该参考模型到强教师模型的族内对数似然偏移。标准在线蒸馏会同时传递这两个分量，导致偏移量主导更新方向，掩盖教师模型能力提升带来的有效变化。本文提出CompassOPD方法，可移除上述偏移量，仅传递族内似然偏移，同时用冻结的学生参考模型将更新锚定到学生的初始策略，使得教师侧和学生侧的变化都在各自的模型族内完成度量。在3类学生模型族和多类教师模型族上开展的实验表明，CompassOPD的性能始终优于标准跨族在线蒸馏，平均推理准确率最高可提升5.50个百分点。对于混合专家（Mixture of Experts, MoE）教师模型，本文进一步通过减少专家激活的方式直接从教师检查点构建参考模型，无需额外的独立参考检查点，相比标准在线蒸馏仍可实现3.43个百分点的性能提升。

title: The Sample Complexity of Quantum Entanglement Allocation
title_zh: 量子纠缠分配的样本复杂度
authors: Nathan Roll
abstract: How many past requests are needed to decide which qubits should share entanglement? We show that the answer depends on the allocation choices created by the queries: a larger memory can require no more data. The memory stores a classical bit and answers requests through a fixed detector that preserves coherence within each measured sector. For independent commuting $X$- and $Z$-type Pauli queries, we characterize the full attainable prediction-contrast region and construct encodings that preserve the bit at every nonzero vertex. With sharp reports, a $d$-qubit path and groups of at most $k$ qubits have minimax excess error after $m$ requests proportional to $k^{-1}\min\{1,\sqrt{d\log(k+1)/m}\}$, uniformly for $2\leq k<d$. Connected biclique regions can grow without increasing sample demand when depth, region count and connections per region stay bounded. Preparation noise introduces a separate calibration requirement. We derive an exact tradeoff with extra fresh detector calls and transfer the learning law to structured transaction co-location. Population-risk experiments test the statistical predictions. We also compare encodings on a native 15-qubit device and learned partitions on public purchase baskets. The full chain wins on the device; frequency grouping outperforms basket search in the largest-capacity retail setting.
summary_zh: 确定哪些量子比特需要共享纠缠，需要用到多少条历史请求数据？本文研究表明，该问题的答案由查询生成的分配选择决定：更大的存储容量反而不需要更多的样本数据。存储单元可存储一个经典比特，通过固定探测器响应请求，该探测器可保证每个测量扇区内的相干性。针对独立可交换的X型和Z型泡利查询，本文刻画了全部可实现的预测对比度区域，设计的编码方案可在所有非零顶点处保留该经典比特。在精确报告场景下，d量子比特路径和规模不超过k的量子比特组，在m次请求后的极小化极大超额误差与k⁻¹·min{1, √(d log(k+1)/m)}成正比，该结论对所有满足2≤k<d的参数一致成立。当深度、区域数量和每个区域的连接数保持有界时，连通双团区域的规模可增长且不会带来样本需求的提升。制备噪声会引入额外的校准要求，本文推导了引入额外全新探测器调用后的精确权衡关系，并将学习规律推广到结构化事务共定位场景。群体风险实验验证了统计预测结论的正确性，本文还在原生15量子比特设备上完成了不同编码方案的对比测试，在公开购买篮子数据集上完成了学习分区的对比测试。完整方案在量子设备上表现最优，频率分组方法在最大容量零售场景下的性能优于篮子搜索方法。

title: Storage-Scalable Progressive Semantic Communication via Knowledge-Base Reuse
title_zh: 基于知识库复用的存储可扩展渐进式语义通信
authors: Heng Zhu, Ye Liu, Kun Zhu, Feifei Song
abstract: Existing knowledge-base-assisted semantic communication schemes commonly adopt either single knowledge-base quantization (SKBQ) or multi-knowledge-base residual quantization (MKBQ). SKBQ incurs limited storage overhead but has restricted quantization capacity, whereas MKBQ supports progressive refinement by assigning an independent knowledge base (KB) to each stage, causing the KB storage to grow linearly with the transmission depth. To address this problem, we propose storage-scalable knowledge-base reuse quantization (SSKBQ), which reuses a compact set of KBs across multiple residual refinement stages and thereby decouples the number of transmission stages from the number of maintained KBs. A stage-aware residual supervision mechanism is further introduced to regularize intermediate quantized representations and encourage progressive refinement. Experimental results demonstrate that KB reuse provides an effective solution to the storage scalability problem while maintaining competitive progressive reconstruction performance.
summary_zh: 现有知识库辅助语义通信方案通常采用单知识库量化（Single Knowledge-Base Quantization, SKBQ）或多知识库残差量化（Multi-Knowledge-Base Residual Quantization, MKBQ）两类架构：单知识库量化的存储开销低，但量化能力有限；多知识库残差量化通过为每个传输阶段分配独立知识库实现渐进式特征优化，但会导致知识库存储量随传输深度线性增长。针对该问题，本文提出存储可扩展知识库复用量化（Storage-Scalable Knowledge-Base Reuse Quantization, SSKBQ）方案，在多个残差优化阶段复用同一套紧凑的知识库集合，从而将传输阶段的数量与需要维护的知识库数量解耦。本文进一步引入阶段感知残差监督机制，对中间量化表征施加正则化约束，引导模型实现渐进式特征优化。实验结果表明，知识库复用方案可在保证极具竞争力的渐进式重建性能的同时，有效解决存储可扩展问题。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Molecule Generation Models for De Novo Drug Design: From Benchmarks to Practical Insights
title_zh: 面向从头药物设计的分子生成模型系统性评估：从基准测试到实践洞见
authors: Xinrui Xu, Xueer Wang, Dan Luo, Sisi Yuan, Xuan Lin
abstract: Molecule generation has emerged as a powerful computational tool for de novo drug design, enabling the exploration of chemical space beyond the limits of conventional virtual screening. The field has progressed rapidly, driven by advances in molecular representations, generative architectures, and target-aware modeling strategies. However, existing reviews typically address specific model families or application scenarios in isolation, rather than offering an integrated perspective on how these components collectively form a coherent generation workflow. In this review, we present a comprehensive evaluation of molecule generation models for de novo drug design, covering 82 methods across five deep generative frameworks, including recurrent neural network (RNN)- and Transformer-based models, variational autoencoders (VAEs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), flow-based models, and diffusion models. We first summarize widely used benchmarks and molecular representations, and then examine the methodological principles underlying both general and pocket-conditioned generation. A central contribution of this work is a systematic synthesis and comparative analysis of reported performance across commonly used benchmarks and evaluation metrics. We also summarize representative experimentally validated case studies. Looking ahead, we discuss future directions in standardized 3D data, interaction-aware generation, receptor flexibility, and multi-objective molecular design, with the aim of improving the reliability and experimental relevance of molecule generation. All collected benchmark resources, evaluation metrics, and model references are provided in a publicly accessible repository atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 分子生成已成为从头药物设计领域的强大计算工具，能够突破传统虚拟筛选的局限探索更广阔的化学空间。得益于分子表示、生成架构以及靶点感知建模策略的进展，该领域发展十分迅速。但现有综述通常仅孤立地针对特定模型家族或应用场景展开讨论，并未从整合视角阐明各类组件如何共同构成完整的生成工作流。本综述针对从头药物设计领域的分子生成模型开展全面评估，覆盖5类深度生成框架下的82种方法，包括基于循环神经网络（RNN）与Transformer的模型、变分自编码器（VAEs）、生成对抗网络（GANs）、流基模型以及扩散模型。本文首先总结了广泛使用的基准测试集与分子表示方法，随后分析通用生成与口袋条件生成背后的方法学原理。本工作的核心贡献是对已发表的、基于常用基准集与评估指标的性能结果进行系统性整合与对比分析，同时汇总了经实验验证的代表性案例研究。最后本文围绕标准化3D数据、交互感知生成、受体柔性以及多目标分子设计等未来方向展开讨论，旨在提升分子生成的可靠性与实验相关性。所有收集的基准资源、评估指标与模型参考文献均已公开存储于对应开源仓库中。

title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical NLP Classification with Compact Semantic Representations: An Experimental Analysis of Representation Compression
title_zh: 结合紧凑语义表示的混合量子-经典自然语言处理（NLP）分类：表示压缩的实验分析
authors: Ali Hassan, Zijia Zhao, Maha A. Metawei
abstract: Large language and sentence-embedding models provide rich semantic representations, but their high dimensionality poses a challenge for near-term quantum machine learning (QML), where quantum circuits can process only a limited number of input features. We investigate a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline that transforms high-dimensional sentence embeddings into compact representations for variational quantum classification. The workflow combines a pretrained sentence-embedding model, dimensionality reduction, angle encoding, a variational quantum circuit (VQC), and a classical decision layer. We systematically compare principal component analysis (PCA), neighborhood components analysis (NCA), and linear discriminant analysis (LDA), covering both unsupervised and supervised dimensionality reduction. Using the TREC question-classification dataset, we study the relationship between representation dimensionality, information retention, qubit count, and classification performance. Preliminary PCA experiments reveal a strong information bottleneck: reducing 768-dimensional embeddings to 3, 4, 5, and 8 dimensions retains about 8.2%, 10.2%, 11.9%, and 16.4% of the variance, with corresponding classification accuracies of 50.3%, 51.2%, 57.9%, and 63.4%. In contrast, supervised reduction is substantially more efficient. LDA reaches 85.3% accuracy and NCA reaches 83.1% using only 5 dimensions, under a leakage-free cross-validation protocol, compared with 85.1% for a full 384-dimensional classical baseline. These results indicate that supervised dimensionality reduction can preserve task-relevant information far more effectively than variance-based compression, making compact representations a promising route toward practical hybrid quantum-classical NLP models.
summary_zh: 大语言模型与句子嵌入模型可生成丰富的语义表示，但这类表示的高维度对近期量子机器学习（QML）场景构成了挑战——量子电路仅能处理数量有限的输入特征。本文研究了一种混合量子-经典流水线，可将高维句子嵌入转换为适用于变分量子分类的紧凑表示。该工作流整合了预训练句子嵌入模型、降维模块、角度编码、变分量子电路（VQC）与经典决策层。本文系统对比了主成分分析（PCA）、邻域成分分析（NCA）与线性判别分析（LDA）三类方法，覆盖无监督与有监督两类降维范式。基于TREC问题分类数据集，本文探究了表示维度、信息保留率、量子比特数与分类性能之间的关联。初步PCA实验结果显示出极强的信息瓶颈效应：将768维嵌入降至3、4、5、8维时，分别保留约8.2%、10.2%、11.9%、16.4%的方差，对应分类准确率分别为50.3%、51.2%、57.9%、63.4%。与之相比，有监督降维的效率显著更高：在无泄漏交叉验证协议下，仅使用5维特征时LDA即可达到85.3%的准确率，NCA可达83.1%，而全384维经典基线的准确率为85.1%。上述结果表明，有监督降维相比基于方差的压缩方法，能够更高效地保留任务相关信息，紧凑表示是实现实用化混合量子-经典NLP模型的可行路径。

title: Physics-Informed Multi-Task Surrogate Model for the Martian Nightside Thermosphere
title_zh: 面向火星夜侧热层的物理信息多任务替代模型
authors: Sergey Nikiforov
abstract: Modeling the Martian nightside thermosphere remains challenging due to sparse in situ sampling and strong coupling among transport, magnetic, and seasonal processes. Purely data-driven models can produce non-physical artifacts, such as density inversions, in poorly sampled altitude regimes.We present a multi-task physics-informed neural network that simultaneously predicts the base-10 logarithmic densities of four neutral species (O, CO$_2$, N$_2$, and Ar) using more than a decade of MAVEN/NGIMS observations (MY 32-38, 2014-2025). A shared backbone learns a common representation of the nightside thermospheric state and branches into species-specific output heads.A weak monotonicity prior is incorporated via automatic differentiation by penalizing positive vertical gradients in logarithmic density. Experiments using an orbit-disjoint train/validation/test split show that physics-informed regularization substantially reduces non-physical inversions while preserving predictive skill and slightly improving it in the best-performing configuration, as measured by RMSE, MAE, and $R^2$.The resulting model provides a computationally efficient surrogate for nightside thermospheric reconstruction with improved vertical consistency.
summary_zh: 由于原位采样数据稀疏、输运过程、磁场过程与季节过程之间存在强耦合效应，火星夜侧热层建模至今仍面临诸多挑战。纯数据驱动模型在采样不足的高度区域会产生密度反转等不符合物理规律的伪影。本文提出一种物理信息多任务神经网络，利用超过10年的MAVEN/NGIMS（火星大气与挥发物演化任务/中性气体离子质谱仪）观测数据（火星年32-38，2014-2025年），同时预测4种中性粒子（O、CO₂、N₂、Ar）的以10为底的对数密度。该模型通过共享主干网络学习夜侧热层状态的通用表示，再分支为对应不同粒子的输出头。研究通过自动微分引入弱单调性先验，对对数密度的垂直正梯度施加惩罚。基于轨道互斥的训练/验证/测试集划分开展的实验表明，物理信息正则化可大幅减少非物理密度反转现象，同时保留预测能力，在最优配置下还可通过均方根误差（RMSE）、平均绝对误差（MAE）与决定系数（R²）指标观测到预测性能的小幅提升。最终得到的模型是计算高效的夜侧热层重建替代模型，具备更优的垂直一致性。

title: Orukeet: Multilingual ASR with Frozen Gabor Kernels
title_zh: Orukeet：基于冻结伽柏（Gabor）核的多语言自动语音识别（ASR）
authors: Nathan Roll, Irene Yi, Büşra Marşan, Vianney Grenez, Gabriel Stein 等 (9 人)
abstract: Orukeet replaces half of an adapted Parakeet encoder's temporal filters with 12,288 fitted Gabor kernels, freezes these replacements, and trains the remaining parameters on multilingual and multi-accent data. Final adaptation and checkpoint selection use LibriSpeech test-other. Across 20,146 FLEURS recordings in 25 languages, pooled word error rate (WER) falls from Parakeet's 11.01% to Orukeet's 9.85%, a 10.6% relative reduction. Orukeet has lower WER on 23 of the 25 languages. Orukeet outperforms Parakeet on 61 out of 74 tested splits, including LibriSpeech test-clean (1.46% vs. 1.53% WER), test-other (2.86% vs. 3.14%), and FLEURS English (3.82% vs. 4.28%). All comparisons decode the same audio with matched NeMo settings. The fitted kernels are stored as ordinary convolution weights, retaining Parakeet's architecture and inference operators.
summary_zh: Orukeet将经过适配的Parakeet编码器中一半的时间滤波器替换为12288个拟合得到的伽柏核，冻结这些替换后的核参数，再在多语言、多口音数据集上训练其余参数。最终的适配过程与检查点选择基于LibriSpeech test-other子集完成。在覆盖25种语言的20146条FLEURS测试录音上，Orukeet的合并词错误率（WER）从Parakeet的11.01%降至9.85%，相对降幅达10.6%，且在25种语言中的23种上WER表现更优。在74个测试划分中，Orukeet在61个划分上的表现超过Parakeet，包括LibriSpeech test-clean（WER 1.46% vs 1.53%）、test-other（WER 2.86% vs 3.14%）以及FLEURS英语子集（WER 3.82% vs 4.28%）。所有对比实验均在匹配的NeMo设置下对相同音频进行解码。拟合得到的核以普通卷积权重的形式存储，完全保留了Parakeet的架构与推理算子。

title: Zero-Shot Temporal Localisation of Audio Deepfakes in Multi-Speaker Conversations
title_zh: MedDeID：基于真实或合成训练数据的本地管控临床文本去标识化框架
authors: Soumyadeep Roy
abstract: Voice-cloning fraud increasingly relies on surgical injection: a genuine conversation in which only one or two sentences are replaced by synthetic speech. Utterance-level deepfake detectors emit a single real/fake label per clip and cannot report where the synthetic speech lies. We formalise this as Temporal Deepfake Localisation in Multi-Speaker Conversations (TDLMC), show that equal error rate and min-DCF are ill-posed once a file contains both classes, and propose temporal metrics for this regime. Our contribution is a training-free five-stage pipeline that wraps a frozen binary detector and adds segment-level output with no retraining, using a two-threshold hysteresis finitestate-machine decoder to turn noisy window scores into coherent intervals. On 180 constructed multi-speaker conversations from ASVspoof 5, the system attains temporal intersection-over-union 0.90, temporal detection rate 0.95, and MS-DCF 0.26 with a strong backbone, and its false-alarm rate on genuine speech is below 6%, falling under 2% on genuine real multi-speaker dialogue (AMI). Under an identical pipeline, a trained localiser improves temporal IoU by only about 0.04, bounding the cost of forgoing supervision. Evaluated across three frozen detectors under one decoder whose constants are selected on a held-out calibration split, and with a controlled analysis attributing the residual false-alarm rate to a backbone domain gap rather than to the decoder, this provides the first zero-shot baseline and a reusable benchmark for TDLMC.
summary_zh: 临床病历中包含大量个人可识别信息（PII），限制了其在科研与医疗AI领域的复用，尤其当数据无法离开机构本地时该问题更为突出。本文开发了MedDeID这一本地部署框架，整合了内部标注、合成病历生成、模型训练、推理、假名化与评估全流程。在经过独立标注、专家裁定的300份荷兰医院病历基准集上，基于医院数据训练的轻量级Transformer模型识别出98.9%的标识类文本，同时仅将0.24%的非标识文本错误脱敏；仅使用合成数据训练的对应模型识别准确率也达到96.1%。在100份初级保健病历上，合成数据训练模型的召回率高于医院数据训练模型（90.3% vs 87.0%），且对标识格式扰动的鲁棒性更强。在未使用任何真实文本训练的英语版本实例中，该模型在两个外部合成基准集上对标注标识字符的识别准确率分别达到99.7%与98.9%。上述结果证明该工作流可迁移至其他语言场景。MedDeID为基于真实或合成训练数据的本地管控临床文本去标识化提供了可行方案。

title: MedDeID enables locally governed clinical-text de-identification from real or synthetic training data
authors: Stig Hellemans, Tom Stroobants, Elyne Scheurwegs, Pieter Meysman, Philippe G. Jorens 等 (6 人)
abstract: Clinical notes contain personally identifiable information (PII), restricting reuse for research and medical AI, especially when data cannot leave an institution. We developed MedDeID, an on-premises framework combining in-house annotation and synthetic-note generation with model training, inference, pseudonymisation and evaluation. On an independently annotated, adjudicated 300-note Dutch hospital benchmark, a hospital-trained compact transformer detected 98.9% of identifying text while redacting 0.24% of text outside annotated identifiers; a synthetic-only counterpart detected 96.1%. On 100 primary-care notes, the synthetic-trained model achieved higher recall than the hospital-trained model (90.3% versus 87.0%) and greater robustness to identifier-format perturbations. An English instantiation trained without real text detected 99.7% and 98.9% of annotated identifier characters on two external synthetic benchmarks. These results demonstrate transfer of the workflow to another language, but not clinical English performance. MedDeID provides a route to locally governed de-identification using real or synthetic training data.

title: Field-level prediction of mid-plane stress tensor fields in concrete target penetration: a cross-velocity graph neural operator surrogate
title_zh: 混凝土靶侵彻过程中中平面应力张量场的场级预测：跨速度图神经算子替代模型
authors: Wenpu Du, Peng Zhou, Yunlong Xia, Sinuo Xin, Congcong Zhang 等 (8 人)
abstract: Although the impact resistance of concrete has been studied extensively, a framework linking mesoscale heterogeneity to full-field stress-tensor prediction has been lacking. Data were generated with a full-scale aggregate-resolved LS-DYNA model (projectile diameter 45 mm, mass 2.13 kg, target diameter 500 mm x thickness 200 mm, mesh 10 mm), verified against published penetration experiments (Frew 2006, Hanchak 1992, Forrestal 1996) by configuration similarity. The dataset contains six-component stress-tensor fields on the X-Z mid-plane for 400 cases (4 impact velocities x 100 aggregate seeds). Three contributions are reported. First, case-by-case verification of the terminal penetration state delimited the rest-state validity of penetration depth and anchored reliable observables to rigid-body motion and field-level stress evolution. Second, a field-level graph neural operator surrogate learned the time-varying stress-field evolution and evaluated cross-velocity leave-one-out extrapolation. Third, the full-scale, aggregate-resolved, cross-velocity, per-seed database was established as a reproducible resource. Cases at 100, 135 and 200 m/s still moved at window end (negative velocity, i.e. rebound), and only one 165 m/s case arrested. Penetration depth is therefore not reported as a rest-state scalar except for the single arrested case (69.33 mm); nose-node depth differences were confirmed as numerical artifacts of displacement integration after erosion. The single-step relative L2 error was 0.6977, reported honestly; autoregressive rollout from frame 11 to 39 took about 144 ms, a speedup of about 3.6x10^3 to 4.3x10^3 relative to single-core LS-DYNA, reported as application value. Validation is bounded by configuration similarity and field-level self-consistency; the framework is a simulation-trained decision-support method within the studied parameter space.
summary_zh: 尽管学界已针对混凝土抗冲击性能开展大量研究，但目前仍缺乏可连接介观非均质性与全应力张量场预测的框架。本研究采用全尺度骨料分辨的LS-DYNA模型生成数据（弹体直径45mm、质量2.13kg，靶体直径500mm×厚度200mm，网格尺寸10mm），通过配置相似性与已发表的侵彻实验（Frew 2006、Hanchak 1992、Forrestal 1996）完成验证。数据集包含400个工况（4种冲击速度×100个骨料随机种子）在X-Z中平面上的六分量应力张量场。本文的贡献分为三点：第一，通过逐工况验证侵彻终态，划定了侵彻深度的静止态适用范围，将可靠观测值锚定至刚体运动与场级应力演化过程；第二，提出场级图神经算子替代模型，学习时变应力场演化规律，并完成跨速度留一例外推评估；第三，构建了全尺度、骨料分辨、跨速度、按种子划分的可复现公开数据库。100m/s、135m/s与200m/s工况在计算窗口结束时仍处于运动状态（速度为负即发生回弹），仅1个165m/s工况的弹体完全停滞。因此除唯一的停滞工况（侵彻深度69.33mm）外，本文未将侵彻深度作为静止态标量指标报告，同时确认弹尖节点深度差是侵蚀后位移积分产生的数值伪影。模型单步相对L2误差为0.6977，从第11帧到第39帧的自回归推演耗时约144ms，相比单核LS-DYNA实现了3.6×10³至4.3×10³倍的加速，具备实际应用价值。本研究的验证边界受配置相似性与场级自洽性约束，该框架是在研究参数空间内基于仿真训练的决策支持方法。

title: Dynamical Non-compensatory Multidimensional IRT Model Using Variational Approximation
title_zh: 基于变分近似的动态非补偿多维项目反应理论（MIRT）模型
authors: Hiroshi Tamano, Daichi Mochihashi
abstract: Multidimensional item response theory (MIRT) is a statistical test theory that precisely estimates multiple latent skills of learners from the responses in a test. Both compensatory and non-compensatory models have been proposed for MIRT: the former assumes that each skill can complement other skills, whereas the latter assumes they cannot. This non-compensatory assumption is convincing in many tests that measure multiple skills; therefore, applying non-compensatory models to such data is crucial for achieving unbiased and accurate estimation. In contrast to tests, latent skills will change over time in daily learning. To monitor the growth of skills, dynamical extensions of MIRT models have been investigated. However, most of them assumed compensatory models, and a model that can reproduce continuous latent states of skills under the non-compensatory assumption has not been proposed thus far. To enable accurate skill tracing under the non-compensatory assumption, we propose a dynamical extension of non-compensatory MIRT models by combining a linear dynamical system and a non-compensatory model.
