This results in a complicated posterior of skills, which we approximate with a Gaussian distribution by minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the approximated posterior and the true posterior. The learning algorithm for the model parameters is derived through Monte Carlo expectation maximization. Simulation studies verify that the proposed method is able to reproduce latent skills accurately, whereas the dynamical compensatory model suffers from significant underestimation errors. Furthermore, experiments on an actual data set demonstrate that our dynamical non-compensatory model can infer practical skill tracing and clarify differences in skill tracing between non-compensatory and compensatory models.
summary_zh: 多维项目反应理论（MIRT）是一类可根据测试作答结果精准估计学习者多项潜在技能的统计测试理论。目前学界已提出补偿型与非补偿型两类MIRT模型：前者假设各项技能之间可以相互补充，后者则不存在该互补关系。非补偿假设在多项测量多维度技能的测试场景中更符合实际，因此将非补偿模型应用于这类数据是实现无偏、精准估计的关键。与标准化测试场景不同，日常学习场景下学习者的潜在技能会随时间动态变化，为了监测技能增长，学界已开展MIRT模型动态扩展研究，但现有动态扩展大多基于补偿型假设，目前尚未有可在非补偿假设下复现技能连续潜在状态的模型。为了在非补偿假设下实现精准的技能追踪，本文将线性动态系统与非补偿MIRT模型结合，提出非补偿MIRT的动态扩展模型。针对该模型复杂的技能后验分布，本文通过最小化近似后验与真实后验之间的KL散度，采用高斯分布对其进行近似，并通过蒙特卡洛期望最大化算法推导得到模型参数的学习规则。仿真实验验证了所提方法可精准复现潜在技能，而动态补偿模型会出现显著的低估误差。在真实数据集上的实验进一步表明，本文提出的动态非补偿模型可实现实用化的技能追踪，能够清晰展示非补偿模型与补偿模型在技能追踪结果上的差异。

title: Beyond Contact Sensors: Deep learning with Pseudo-Labeling for remote Photoplethysmography
title_zh: 超越接触传感器：基于伪标签的深度学习远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）
authors: Bhargav Acharya, Barbara Hammer, Hanna Drimalla
abstract: Heart rate is a critical biomarker of health, and remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables its contactless estimation from video data for telemedicine applications. Recent advancements in deep learning based rPPG methods achieve state-of-the-art results, outperforming classical signal-processing methods in complex scenarios. However, deep learning methods depend on datasets with precise synchronization between videos and ground truth signals collected via contact sensors, whereas signal-processing-based methods do not. To address this dependence on labeled datasets, which are labor-intensive to collect, we investigate under which circumstances pseudo-labels extracted using unsupervised signal-processing methods can replace contact sensors labels for training deep learning methods. Our systematic evaluations found that for datasets with imperfect synchronization, the pseudo-label approach outperforms supervised training on contact sensors. For datasets with good synchronization, results are mixed: within-dataset evaluation shows no significant difference between training methods, while cross-dataset evaluation favors supervised training. However, removing a single outlier participant significantly improves the pseudo-label approach's cross-dataset performance, highlighting the importance of label quality. These results demonstrate that signal-processing methods can generate valid training signals for deep learning models, reducing dependency on labor-intensive dataset collection while maintaining competitive performance.
summary_zh: 心率是反映健康状态的核心生物标志物，远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）可从视频数据中实现非接触式心率估计，在远程医疗场景中具备应用价值。近年来基于深度学习的rPPG方法取得了当前最优性能，在复杂场景下表现优于传统信号处理方法，但深度学习方法依赖视频与接触传感器采集的真值信号严格同步的数据集，而这类数据集的采集过程十分耗费人力。为了解决该标签依赖问题，本文探究了在何种场景下，通过无监督信号处理方法提取的伪标签可替代接触传感器标签用于训练深度学习模型。系统性评估结果显示，对于同步质量不佳的数据集，伪标签方法的表现优于基于接触传感器标签的监督训练；对于同步质量良好的数据集，两类方法的表现各有优劣：数据集内评估显示两种训练方法的性能无显著差异，跨数据集评估则更支持监督训练方案。但移除单个离群受试者后，伪标签方法的跨数据集性能会得到显著提升，凸显了标签质量的重要性。上述结果表明，信号处理方法可为深度学习模型生成有效的训练信号，在保持有竞争力性能的同时降低对高成本数据集采集工作的依赖。

title: Deterministic Prompting for Speaker-Stable Low-Resource Greek TTS
title_zh: 面向说话人稳定的低资源希腊语文本转语音（TTS）的确定性提示方法
authors: Georgios Syllas, Efthymios Georgiou, Kosmas Kritsis, Alexandros Potamianos
abstract: Modern TTS systems approach human quality for high-resource languages but degrade when clean speech data is scarce. Modern Greek exemplifies this, lacking the curated corpora behind state-of-the-art synthesis. We propose a data curation recipe that transforms audiobook recordings into TTS-ready data via WhisperX alignment and filtering. Then we fine-tune Parler-TTS (880M), a prompt-based multilingual model whose pre-training encodes phonetic priors transferable to Greek. During development, we find that LLM-generated style prompts introduce speaker drift at inference. Replacing them with deterministic prompts resolves this, and a speaker-specific LoRA stage trained on 3.5 h of single-speaker data anchors identity while updating ~5% of parameters. Our system achieves WER 10.7% (2.9 above the ASR floor), MOS-I 4.00 (vs. 4.36 human speech), and near-human speaker consistency (MOS-C 4.24 vs. 4.30), showing that robust single-speaker Greek TTS is achievable with limited curated data.
summary_zh: 面向高资源语言的现代文本转语音（TTS）系统合成质量已接近真人水平，但在干净语音数据稀缺时性能会出现明显下降。现代希腊语就是典型案例，目前缺乏支撑当前最优合成效果的精心标注语料库。本文提出一种数据处理方案，通过WhisperX对齐与过滤将有声书录音转换为可直接用于TTS训练的数据集，随后对8.8亿参数的提示式多语言模型Parler-TTS进行微调，该模型的预训练过程学习到的语音先验知识可迁移至希腊语场景。开发过程中研究人员发现，由大语言模型生成的风格提示会在推理阶段引入说话人漂移问题，采用确定性提示可解决该问题；后续在3.5小时单说话人数据上训练的说话人专属LoRA（低秩适配）模块可在仅更新约5%参数的前提下锚定说话人身份。本文开发的系统词错误率（WER）为10.7%（比ASR基线高2.9%），自然度平均意见得分（MOS-I）为4.00（真人语音得分为4.36），说话人一致性平均意见得分（MOS-C）为4.24（真人语音得分为4.30），接近真人水平，证明仅使用有限的精心标注数据即可构建性能鲁棒的单说话人希腊语TTS系统。

title: Structure-Aware Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Spacecraft Telemetry with Adaptive EVT Thresholding
title_zh: 结合自适应EVT（极值理论）阈值处理的面向航天器遥测数据的结构感知无监督异常检测
authors: Óscar Alcarria, Rafael Sánchez, Javier Sempere, Pablo Torrijos, Juan C. Alfaro 等 (8 人)
abstract: Operational anomaly detection in spacecraft telemetry typically requires labeled historical anomalies or extended warm-up periods. These requirements are rarely met in practice. We propose an unsupervised, deployment-ready framework that produces predictions from the second month of operation without any labels, prior fault knowledge, or mission-specific tuning. The approach combines incremental monthly retraining, statistical model selection, and adaptive Extreme Value Theory (EVT) thresholding for false alarm control. On the ESA Anomalies Dataset (ESA-AD), it achieves $F_{0.5}=0.700$ on Mission~1 and $F_{0.5}=0.698$ on Mission~2 under strict chronological evaluation.
summary_zh: 航天器遥测数据的运行异常检测通常需要带标注的历史异常数据或较长的预热运行周期，这些要求在实际场景中往往难以满足。本文提出一种可直接部署的无监督框架，无需任何标注数据、先验故障知识或针对特定任务的调优，即可在航天器运行的第二个月起输出异常检测结果。该方法融合了月度增量重训练、统计模型选择与自适应EVT（极值理论）阈值机制以实现虚警控制。在欧空局异常数据集（ESA-AD）上，严格按时间顺序的评估结果显示，该方法在任务1上的F0.5值为0.700，在任务2上的F0.5值为0.698。

title: An Explainable Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Blood-Brain Barrier Permeability Using Molecular Descriptors
title_zh: 基于分子描述符预测血脑屏障通透性的可解释机器学习框架
authors: Fatemeh Mahmoudi
abstract: Blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability is a critical determinant in the development of central nervous system therapeutics because it directly influences the ability of drug candidates to reach their target sites within the brain. In this study, an explainable machine learning framework was developed to predict BBB permeability using molecular descriptors generated from the MoleculeNet BBBP dataset with the RDKit cheminformatics toolkit. Fifteen physicochemical descriptors extracted from 2,039 compounds were used to train four supervised machine learning algorithms, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). Hyperparameter optimization was performed using GridSearchCV, while model interpretability was investigated using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). Among the evaluated models, the optimized XGBoost classifier achieved the best predictive performance, with an accuracy of 88.97%, a precision of 88.92%, a recall of 97.76%, an F1-score of 93.13%, and a ROC-AUC of 0.9282. Stratified five-fold cross-validation further demonstrated the robustness of the proposed model, yielding a mean ROC-AUC of 0.8982 +/- 0.0130. Feature importance and SHAP analyses consistently identified TPSA, HBD, and LogP as the most influential molecular descriptors governing BBB permeability prediction. Overall, the proposed framework provides an accurate, interpretable, and computationally efficient approach for BBB permeability prediction and may serve as a valuable tool for the early-stage screening of CNS drug candidates.
summary_zh: 血脑屏障（BBB）通透性是中枢神经系统治疗药物开发的核心决定因素，直接影响候选药物抵达脑内靶位点的能力。本研究开发了一种可解释机器学习框架，基于RDKit化学信息学工具包从MoleculeNet BBBP数据集中生成的分子描述符预测血脑屏障通透性。研究提取了2039种化合物的15种理化描述符，用于训练4种监督机器学习算法：逻辑回归、支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林和极端梯度提升（XGBoost）。使用GridSearchCV完成超参数优化，采用SHapley加性解释（SHAP）方法探究模型可解释性。在所有评估模型中，优化后的XGBoost分类器取得了最优预测性能：准确率88.97%、精确率88.92%、召回率97.76%、F1值93.13%、ROC-AUC值0.9282。分层五折交叉验证进一步验证了所提模型的鲁棒性，平均ROC-AUC为0.8982±0.0130。特征重要性分析与SHAP分析一致表明，TPSA、HBD和LogP是影响血脑屏障通透性预测的最核心分子描述符。总体而言，该框架为血脑屏障通透性预测提供了准确、可解释且计算高效的实现路径，可作为中枢神经系统候选药物早期筛选的有效工具。

title: A Sharp Barrier for Consistent Submodular Maximization: Any Improvement over $2-\sqrt{2}$ Entails Exponential Queries or Linear Recourse
title_zh: 一致性子模最大化的严格下界：突破2-√2的任何改进都需要指数级查询或线性回溯
authors: Shi Fu, Qixin Zhang, Dacheng Tao
abstract: Consistent submodular maximization studies the tradeoff between solution quality and stability when elements arrive over time. For a monotone submodular objective, which models diminishing returns, an algorithm maintains a set of at most $k$ available elements and changes only $O(1)$ elements after each insertion. Dütting et al. [2025] established a tight $2/3$ approximation with unrestricted computation and a polynomial-time $0.51$ approximation. They left open at STOC 2025 whether efficient algorithms can match the offline $1-1/e$ guarantee. We resolve this problem by proving that the supremum approximation achievable with polynomially many value queries and worst-case constant recourse is \[ \beta=2-\sqrt2\approx0.5858<1-1/e. \] For every $\varepsilon>0$, our randomized algorithm attains $\beta-\varepsilon$ with $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ changes per insertion. Any fixed improvement requires exponentially many queries before one critical insertion or linear recourse of $\Omega(k)$ changes at that insertion, even with unlimited queries afterwards. This gap quantifies the cost of consistency: the current oracle hides which elements will be needed after an arrival. We also determine the exact curvature-dependent threshold $1-(\sqrt2-1)\vartheta$, attain $1-1/e-\varepsilon$ for weighted coverage with $O(\varepsilon^{-1})$ recourse, and separate the existence of universal future-price certificates from their efficient computation. Our algorithm has a bounded-bit polynomial-time implementation for polynomial-bit rational oracle answers; the lower bound uses only logarithmic-bit rational answers.
summary_zh: 一致性子模最大化研究元素随时间动态到达场景下的解质量与稳定性之间的权衡关系。针对用于建模边际收益递减特性的单调子模目标，算法最多维护包含k个可用元素的集合，且每次插入新元素后仅修改O(1)个元素。Dütting等人[2025]在不受计算资源限制的条件下得到了紧的2/3近似比，同时提出了多项式时间下0.51近似比的算法，并在STOC 2025上提出了开放问题：高效算法能否达到离线场景下1-1/e的理论保证？本文解决了该问题，证明在多项式次值查询和最坏情况常数回溯的条件下，可实现的最优近似比上确界为β=2-√2≈0.5858，小于1-1/e。对于任意ε>0，本文提出的随机算法可实现β-ε的近似比，每次插入操作仅需O(ε⁻²)次元素修改。任何超过该阈值的固定改进，要么需要在某一关键插入操作前执行指数级次查询，要么需要在该插入操作时执行Ω(k)次的线性规模回溯，即便后续允许无限次查询也无法规避该约束。该差值量化了一致性的代价：当前的预言机无法揭示后续到达后哪些元素是后续所需的。本文进一步推导了与曲率相关的精确阈值1-(√2-1)ϑ，针对加权覆盖问题以O(ε⁻¹)次回溯实现了1-1/e-ε的近似比，同时区分了通用未来价格证书的存在性与其高效计算的边界。本文提出的算法可在多项式比特有理数预言机输出的场景下实现有界比特的多项式时间运行，且下界证明仅依赖对数比特的有理数输出即可成立。

title: Optimal Value Inference for Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向强化学习的最优值推断方法
authors: Nan Lu, Ethan Lee, James M. Robins, David Simchi-Levi, Junwei Lu
abstract: We study offline inference for the optimal value in reinforcement learning. Two new nuisances are derived as fixed points of a self-induced Bellman equation, in which we approximate the maximum Bellman operator by its softmax correspondence. We propose a debiased estimator through the Neyman orthogonality and establish its asymptotic normality under diverging horizons even when the behavior policy changes with time, as long as the nuisances have the statistical rates that can be achieved by many machine learning methods. We provide a concrete estimating procedure for these nuisances and show they can lead to valid inference. Synthetic experiments validate the numerical performance of our inference method, and we implement it in real-life decision-making problems, including bike repositioning and AI agentic tool use.
summary_zh: 本文研究强化学习中最优值的离线推断问题。我们将两个新的干扰项推导为自诱导贝尔曼方程的不动点，通过软max对应关系近似最大贝尔曼算子。基于Neyman正交性提出了去偏估计器，即便行为策略随时间变化，只要干扰项可通过多种机器学习方法达到对应统计收敛速率，该估计器在视界发散的条件下仍满足渐近正态性。本文给出了针对上述干扰项的具体估计流程，证明其可实现有效推断。合成数据集实验验证了所提推断方法的数值性能，我们还将其部署到实际决策场景中，包括共享单车调度与AI智能体工具调用任务。

title: Deep Neural Networks for Learning Intent from sEMG Signals to Support Hardware Devices for Post-Stroke Neurorehabilitation
title_zh: 面向脑卒中后神经康复硬件设备、基于深度神经网络从sEMG（表面肌电信号）中识别运动意图的研究
authors: Zakariyya Brewster, Divy Wadhwani, Emily Yan, Aidan Wang, Karma Namgyal 等 (8 人)
abstract: Finger-specific motor intent is a clinically meaningful control signal for post-stroke neurorehabilitation, where residual muscle activity may remain measurable despite weak or incomplete movement. We study five-finger multilabel intent decoding from impaired-arm high-density surface electromyography (sEMG) in PhysioMio, a bilateral longitudinal dataset collected from stroke patients. A common processing protocol aligns movement labels, applies 20--450 Hz Butterworth filtering and Symlet-4 wavelet denoising, segments overlapping 200 ms windows, and extracts twelve time- and frequency-domain descriptors per channel. Direct LSTM, CNN, and GNN baselines reveal complementary behavior: the LSTM attains the highest subset accuracy (0.545), whereas the GNN attains the highest macro F1 (0.706) and macro AUPRC (0.776). Architecture search then identifies CNN-Large as the strongest single-split CNN, with 0.593 subset accuracy and 0.714 macro F1, while CNN-Micro provides a compact architecture for embedded inference. To match a four-sensor hardware design, we retrain CNN-Micro using channels associated with ECRB, ECRL, FDS, and FDP and exclude the ground electrode from model input. Across five seeds, cross-channel knowledge distillation improves the four-channel student over direct training, reaching $0.5219 \pm 0.0114$ subset accuracy, $0.7612 \pm 0.0038$ finger accuracy, and $0.6095 \pm 0.0058$ macro F1. The selected 123K-parameter model accepts nine windows of 48 features and has been exported to ONNX. These results establish a reproducible software path from post-stroke sEMG to compact five-finger intent prediction for subsequent hardware-in-the-loop evaluation.
summary_zh: 手指级运动意图是脑卒中后神经康复领域具有临床意义的控制信号，即便患者运动能力较弱或运动不完全，残留肌肉活动仍可被测量。本研究基于从脑卒中患者采集的双侧纵向数据集PhysioMio，开展患侧手臂高密度sEMG（表面肌电信号）的五指多标签意图解码研究。通用处理流程对齐运动标签，采用20~450Hz巴特沃斯滤波和Symlet-4小波去噪，对200ms的重叠窗口进行分段，每个通道提取12个时域和频域描述符。直接使用LSTM、CNN和GNN作为基线模型得到了互补的性能表现：LSTM取得最高的子集准确率（0.545），GNN取得最高的宏F1值（0.706）和宏AUPRC值（0.776）。架构搜索得到了性能最优的单分割CNN模型CNN-Large，子集准确率达0.593，宏F1值达0.714；同时得到了轻量化架构CNN-Micro，适用于嵌入式端推断。为适配四传感器硬件设计，我们使用与ECRB、ECRL、FDS、FDP相关的通道重新训练CNN-Micro，将接地电极排除在模型输入之外。在五组不同随机种子的实验中，跨通道知识蒸馏相比直接训练进一步提升了四通道学生模型的性能，达到0.5219±0.0114的子集准确率、0.7612±0.0038的手指准确率和0.6095±0.0058的宏F1值。最终选定的123K参数模型接收9个窗口共48个特征，已导出为ONNX格式。该结果构建了可复现的软件链路，可从脑卒中患者sEMG信号中输出轻量化的五指意图预测结果，为后续硬件在环评估提供支撑。

title: Adversarial Training for Tabular Credit Scoring: A Multi-Attack Robustness Evaluation in P2P Lending
title_zh: 面向表格数据信用评分的对抗训练：P2P（点对点）借贷场景下的多攻击鲁棒性评估
authors: Gijs A. F. Niewzwaag, Marijn G. S. Veth, Manuele Massei, Marcos R. Machado
abstract: Machine learning-based credit scoring is increasingly central to Peer-to-Peer (P2P) lending, yet its resilience to adversarial manipulation, where applicants strategically alter self-reported inputs to secure favourable decisions, remains poorly understood. Most adversarial-robustness evidence comes from image and text domains and evaluates a single attack against a matching defence, offering little guidance on how defences generalise across attack types in tabular credit data. We address this with a systematic train-test robustness benchmark on a large Lending Club subset, spanning three model families (logistic regression, a feed-forward neural network, and a transformer for tabular data) and four attacks confined to applicant-mutable features: Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM), Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), Salt-and-Pepper (S&P) noise, and DeepFool, plus a mixed-attack regime. Across a full grid evaluated with stratified cross-validation, adversarial training sharply improves robustness against the attack it is trained on and transfers well within the gradient-based family, but transfers weakly to non-gradient corruption, so single-attack defences overstate real-world resilience. Mixed training delivers the most balanced robustness across heterogeneous attacks while preserving clean-test performance, supporting multi-attack stress testing in credit-model governance.
summary_zh: 基于机器学习的信用评分在P2P（点对点）借贷场景中发挥着越来越核心的作用，但申请者通过策略性修改自报输入以获得有利决策的对抗操纵行为对模型鲁棒性的影响仍未得到充分研究。目前大多数对抗鲁棒性研究集中在图像和文本领域，仅评估单一攻击与对应防御的匹配效果，无法指导表格信用数据场景下防御方法对不同攻击类型的泛化能力。针对该问题，本文基于大规模Lending Club子集构建了系统化的训练-测试鲁棒性基准，覆盖三类模型（逻辑回归、前馈神经网络、表格数据Transformer）和四种仅允许修改申请者可调整特征的攻击方法：快速梯度符号法（FGSM）、投影梯度下降（PGD）、椒盐噪声攻击和DeepFool攻击，同时设置了混合攻击场景。基于分层交叉验证的全网格评估结果显示，对抗训练可显著提升模型对其训练所用攻击的鲁棒性，且在梯度类攻击内部迁移性良好，但对非梯度类扰动的迁移性较差，因此单攻击防御方法会高估模型的实际场景鲁棒性。混合训练可在保留干净测试集性能的前提下实现对异构攻击的最均衡鲁棒性，可为信用模型治理中的多攻击压力测试提供支撑。

title: Multi-Pass, Multi-View Blended Learning for High-Fidelity Volumetric CT Synthesis from Chest X-Rays
title_zh: 面向从胸部X光片生成高保真体CT（计算机断层扫描）的多遍多视图混合学习框架
authors: Ozer Can Devecioglu, Serkan Kiranyaz, Rashid Mazhar, Tahir Hamid, Muhammad Chowdhury 等 (6 人)
abstract: Reconstructing volumetric Computed Tomography (CT) from a single 2D chest radiograph (CXR) is an ill-posed inverse problem, further complicated by the scarcity of paired CXR-CT training data. Prior approaches address this by training on Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs (DRRs), which are synthetic projections derived from CT volumes. However, the domain gap between DRRs and real CXRs limits generalization, often resulting in coarse or anatomically inconsistent reconstructions when applied to clinical images. To address this challenging problem, this study introduces a Multi-Pass Multi-View Blended Learning framework for synthesizing high-fidelity volumetric CT directly from real chest X-ray (CXR) images. The proposed approach progressively decomposes the synthesis task into two distinct, complementary learning stages. Stage 1 is an unsupervised CXR-to-DRR Domain Adaptation, while Stage 2 includes three passes, namely, (a) supervised DRR-to-CT Transformation, (b) unsupervised Multi-View Slice Refinement, followed by (c) Progressive Transfer Learning (PTL). With such a blended learning paradigm, the proposed approach mitigates the synthetic-to-real domain gap while enhancing both the structural integrity and anatomical detail of the final output. On the LIDC-IDRI dataset, where paired DRR-CT ground truth is available for quantitative evaluation, the proposed method improves upon prior methods by up to 14% in PSNR and 7.6% in SSIM. The framework successfully generates structurally consistent and anatomically realistic high-fidelity CT volumes from real CXRs, marking a significant advancement toward clinical viability of CT reconstruction from standard radiographic images.
summary_zh: 从单张2D胸部X光片（CXR）重建体CT（计算机断层扫描）是一个不适定逆问题，CXR-CT配对训练数据的稀缺性进一步提升了该任务的难度。现有方法通常采用从CT体数据生成的数字重建放射影像（DRR）进行训练，但DRR与真实CXR之间的域差会限制模型泛化能力，应用于临床图像时往往生成结构粗糙或解剖结构不一致的重建结果。针对该难题，本研究提出一种多遍多视图混合学习框架，可直接从真实胸部X光图像合成高保真体CT。该方法将合成任务渐进分解为两个互补的学习阶段：第一阶段为无监督的CXR到DRR域自适应，第二阶段包含三个步骤：(a)有监督的DRR到CT变换、(b)无监督的多视图切片优化、(c)渐进式迁移学习（PTL）。该混合学习范式可缩小合成数据到真实数据的域差，同时提升最终输出结果的结构完整性与解剖细节精度。在具备配对DRR-CT真值的LIDC-IDRI数据集上的定量评估结果显示，所提方法相比现有方法的峰值信噪比（PSNR）最高提升14%，结构相似性（SSIM）最高提升7.6%。该框架可从真实CXR生成结构一致、解剖结构真实的高保真CT体数据，为基于常规放射影像的CT重建技术达到临床可用标准提供了重要进展。

title: Development and Validation of a Physics-Guided Machine Learning Extrapolation Framework Using a Classical Transient Diffusion Benchmark
title_zh: 基于经典瞬态扩散基准的物理引导机器学习外推框架开发与验证
authors: Ashutosh Yadav, Alok Dubey, Prodyut Ranjan Chakraborty, Harshal Akolekar
abstract: Machine learning models used in engineering are typically trained within limited operating ranges, yet reliable predictions are often required beyond these domains. Consequently, the primary challenge is extrapolation rather than interpolation. Rigorous validation is hindered by the scarcity of data outside the training range. To address this limitation, a novel extrapolation framework is integrated with established machine learning architectures to enable accurate and physically consistent predictions beyond the training domain. The framework is established by systematically evaluating two physics-guided architectures: a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network and a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN). A classical one-dimensional transient diffusion problem is adopted as a benchmark because its exact analytical solution provides unlimited, reliable data across the spatio-temporal domain, enabling rigorous quantitative validation. The problem is particularly challenging because the solution evolves from an initial singularity through a strongly nonlinear transient regime before approaching a steady-state linear profile. When training data are confined to an intermediate portion of this evolution, backward extrapolation toward the singularity becomes especially demanding. To improve reliability, physics-guided coordinate transformations, boundary-aware learning strategies, and stability-enhancing temporal marching are incorporated. Extrapolation is evaluated using a train-predict-validate-extend strategy, in which validated predictions are recursively added to the training set to progressively extend the prediction horizon. The results demonstrate accurate and physically consistent predictions beyond the training domain, highlighting the framework's potential for engineering applications where data availability is limited.
summary_zh: 工程领域使用的机器学习模型通常仅在有限运行范围内训练，但实际应用中往往需要在训练域之外输出可靠预测结果，因此核心挑战是外推而非插值。训练范围外的数据稀缺性导致难以开展严格的模型验证。针对该问题，本文将新型外推框架与成熟的机器学习架构相结合，实现训练域外的高精度、物理一致预测。该框架通过系统评估两种物理引导架构构建而成：双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）和物理信息神经网络（PINN）。本文采用经典一维瞬态扩散问题作为基准，该问题的精确解析解可提供时空域内无限量的可靠数据，支持严格的定量验证。该基准问题具备较高挑战性：解从初始奇点出发，经过强非线性瞬态阶段后逐渐趋近于稳态线性分布，当训练数据仅覆盖演化过程的中间区间时，向奇点方向的反向外推任务难度极高。为提升可靠性，框架引入了物理引导的坐标变换、边界感知学习策略和增强稳定性的时间步进机制。采用训练-预测-验证-扩展策略评估外推性能，将经过验证的预测结果递归加入训练集以逐步扩展预测视界。实验结果表明，该框架可在训练域外输出高精度且物理一致的预测结果，在数据稀缺的工程应用场景中具备较高应用潜力。

title: A Kernel-Based Modular Discriminant Analysis Framework for Small-Sample Learning
title_zh: 面向小样本学习的核模块化判别分析框架
authors: Lingxiao Qu, Yan Pei
abstract: The small-sample-size (SSS) problem remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning when labeled data are scarce due to cost, accessibility, or ethical constraints. While numerous approaches have been proposed, existing methods often struggle to maintain stable and discriminative representations under high-dimensional and limited-data conditions. Kernelized Linear Principal Component Discriminant Analysis (KLPCDA), a recently proposed modular framework, integrates variance preservation, inter-class separability, and intra-class compactness within a unified kernel space. Although its formulation has shown promising initial results, a systematic understanding of how its components interact across diverse SSS scenarios remains lacking. In this paper, we present a systematic cross-domain study of KLPCDA to characterize the interaction mechanisms among its core objectives. We analyze the behavior of its seven variants across multiple real-world SSS tasks, including hyperspectral image classification, mechanical fault diagnosis, medical diagnosis, and face recognition. Through extensive experiments and ablation studies, we investigate how different objective combinations influence performance under varying conditions such as noise, class imbalance, and high dimensionality. Our analysis reveals consistent patterns in the interaction of the three core objectives variance, between-class, and within-class terms, providing a unified and interpretable understanding of their roles in stabilizing representations and enhancing discrimination in SSS settings. Based on these findings, we further derive practical guidelines for selecting appropriate KLPCDA variants under different data characteristics. Experimental results demonstrate that KLPCDA achieves strong and robust performance across domains, while maintaining low computational complexity suitable for resource-constrained environments.
summary_zh: 由于标注数据获取成本高、存在访问限制或伦理约束，小样本（SSS）问题始终是机器学习领域的基础挑战。现有方法在高维小数据场景下往往难以维持稳定且具备强判别性的特征表示。核化线性主成分判别分析（KLPCDA）是近年提出的模块化框架，在统一核空间内融合了方差保留、类间可分性和类内紧凑性三类目标。尽管该方法的初步结果表现优异，但目前仍缺乏对其不同组件在各类小样本场景下交互机制的系统性研究。本文针对KLPCDA开展了跨领域系统性研究，刻画其核心目标之间的交互机制。我们在多个真实小样本任务（包括高光谱图像分类、机械故障诊断、医疗诊断和人脸识别）上测试了7种不同KLPCDA变体的性能表现。通过大量实验与消融研究，探究不同目标组合在噪声、类别不平衡、高维度等不同条件下对性能的影响规律。分析结果揭示了方差项、类间项和类内项三个核心目标交互的一致规律，为理解三者在小样本场景下稳定特征表示、增强判别性的作用提供了统一且可解释的视角。基于该结论，本文进一步给出了不同数据特征下选择最优KLPCDA变体的实践指南。实验结果表明，KLPCDA在多个领域均取得了优异的鲁棒性能，且计算复杂度较低，适用于资源受限环境。

title: Meta-LinEXP3: Online-within-Online Learning for Adversarial Linear Contextual Bandits
title_zh: Meta-LinEXP3：面向对抗线性上下文赌博机的在线内在线学习算法
authors: Hao Li, Jie Xu, Zheng Xie
abstract: Meta-learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for transferring knowledge across sequential bandit tasks. While substantial progress has been made for stochastic bandits and non-contextual adversarial bandits, meta-learning for adversarial linear contextual bandits (ALCBs) with random action sets remains largely unexplored. To address this problem, we propose Meta-LinEXP3, an online-within-online algorithm that constructs a predictable task-level prior from completed tasks to guide the inner LinEXP3 learner. For known context distributions, we develop a policy-centered estimator that achieves an intrinsic-dimension $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{n})$ per-task regret bound. For unknown distributions, we introduce a past-only regularized moment estimator with an $\mathcal{O}(n^{2/3})$ leading regret term and explicit finite-sample error. We further establish a direct connection between prior accuracy and transfer regret, showing that increasingly accurate priors yield sublinear transfer-dependent regret across tasks. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of Meta-LinEXP3, including its application to structured hyperspectral tensor sampling.
summary_zh: 元学习是一类可在序列赌博机任务间实现知识迁移的有效范式。目前针对随机赌博机和无上下文对抗赌博机的元学习研究已取得大量进展，但针对具备随机动作集的对抗线性上下文赌博机（ALCB）的元学习问题仍缺乏充分探索。针对该问题，本文提出Meta-LinEXP3，一种在线内在线学习算法，可从已完成任务中构建可预测的任务级先验，为内层LinEXP3学习器提供指导。针对上下文分布已知的场景，本文开发了策略中心估计器，实现了固有维度下O(√n)的单任务遗憾上界。针对分布未知的场景，本文提出了仅基于历史数据的正则化矩估计器，其主导遗憾项为O(n^(2/3))，并给出了显式的有限样本误差边界。本文进一步建立了先验精度与迁移遗憾之间的直接关联，证明先验精度越高，跨任务的迁移相关遗憾越容易达到次线性级别。实验结果验证了Meta-LinEXP3的有效性，本文还展示了其在结构化高光谱张量采样任务中的应用效果。

title: Beyond Conventional Federated Learning via High-Order Regularization
title_zh: 基于高阶正则化的超越传统联邦学习研究
authors: Alireza Kabgani, Masoud Ahookhosh
abstract: Federated clients that perform several local optimization steps can return parameter displacements with widely different magnitudes. The quadratic regularization of FedProx grows linearly with displacement and therefore offers limited control over the contrast between ordinary and unusually large client movements. We here introduce HiFedProx, which replaces the quadratic penalty with a scale-matched power-type regularizer indexed by $p\geq2$. All powers have the same regularization-gradient magnitude at a reference displacement $R$, while every $p>2$ gives a weaker response below $R$ and a stronger response above it. An exact affine reference calculation shows that increasing $p$ compresses relative displacement disparities, although very large powers approach fixed-radius behavior and increase local curvature. HiFedProx combines this geometry with finite-budget stochastic client optimization and same-minibatch Armijo backtracking. In paired five-seed experiments on a frozen 60-writer FEMNIST subset, a common-parameter study over $p\in\{2,3,4,5,6,7,8\}$ shows similar clean-training performance but substantial gains under composite stress. The lowest moderate- and severe-stress losses occur at $p=7$ and $p=6$, improving over $p=2$ by $11.44\%$ and $23.16\%$, respectively. Although displacement-tail ratios continue to decrease through $p=8$, predictive performance peaks in an intermediate range and Armijo trial cost increases with $p$. These results indicate that the exponent should be calibrated rather than maximized. In our experiments, $p=5$--$7$ provides the most useful range.
summary_zh: 执行多步局部优化的联邦客户端返回的参数偏移量往往存在极大的量级差异。FedProx（联邦近端算法）的二次正则项随偏移量线性增长，因此对普通客户端偏移与异常大偏移之间的差异控制能力十分有限。本文提出HiFedProx（高阶联邦近端算法），采用由参数p≥2索引的尺度匹配幂型正则器替换原有二次惩罚项。所有幂次正则器在参考偏移量R处的正则化梯度量级完全相同，而当p>2时，正则器在偏移量小于R时响应更弱，在偏移量大于R时响应更强。精确仿射参考计算结果表明，增大p值可压缩相对偏移差异，不过极高的幂次会趋近固定半径行为，提升局部曲率。HiFedProx将该几何特性与有限预算随机客户端优化、同小批量Armijo回溯机制相结合。在冻结的60位作者FEMNIST（联邦扩展手写数字）子集上开展的五组随机种子对照实验中，对p∈{2,3,4,5,6,7,8}的通用参数研究显示，不同p值的常规干净训练性能相近，但在复合压力场景下性能差异显著：中等压力和重度压力下的最低损失分别在p=7和p=6时取得，相比p=2的基准分别提升11.44%和23.16%。尽管偏移尾部占比随p增大持续降低，但预测性能在中间区间达到峰值，同时Armijo回溯的试验成本随p升高而增加。上述结果表明，幂次参数应当经过校准而非直接取最大值，在本文实验中p=5~7是性能最优的适用区间。

title: ProMeta: Few-shot PROTAC-targeted degradation prediction across E3 ligases
title_zh: ProMeta：跨E3连接酶的小样本PROTAC靶向降解预测
authors: Yuansheng Liu, Yufei Ye, Tao Tang, Jiawei Luo, Wen Tao 等 (6 人)
abstract: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) have emerged as a transformative therapeutic strategy that selectively degrades historically ''undruggable'' targets via the ubiquitin-proteasome system. Despite growing efforts to develop computational predictors of PROTAC degradation activity, existing supervised approaches remain severely challenged by data scarcity and imbalance across E3 ligases, limiting their ability to generalize beyond well-studied ligase contexts. In practice, labeled data are heavily concentrated on a few ligases (e.g., CRBN and VHL), while the majority of E3 ligases remain underexplored yet are critical for expanding the design space of targeted degraders. Developing methods that enable robust cross-ligase generalization with minimal labeled data is therefore essential for improving the practical utility of computational PROTAC discovery. We reformulate PROTAC degradation activity prediction across E3 ligases as a few-shot meta-learning problem and present ProMeta, a prototype-based graph neural network trained through episodic meta-learning on source-E3 tasks and evaluated on held-out target-E3 tasks through support-conditioned inference. ProMeta performs inference without updating the encoder by dynamically estimating class prototypes from minimal target-ligase support samples. On the CRBN-to-VHL benchmark, ProMeta achieves AUROC values of 0.796 under K=2, Q=3 and 0.883 under K=2, Q=5, improving by 19.9% and 6.8%, respectively, over the corresponding supervised GNN baseline. Reverse VHL-to-CRBN transfer under the same protocol yielded AUROC values of 0.702 (K=2, Q=3) and 0.821 (K=2, Q=5), confirming bidirectional applicability while revealing direction and data-regime dependence. Together, these results support ProMeta as a practical framework for cross-ligase few-shot prediction under the evaluated support/query protocols.
summary_zh: PROTAC（蛋白水解靶向嵌合体）是一类变革性治疗策略，可通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统选择性降解此前被认为“不可成药”的靶点。尽管学界已投入大量精力开发PROTAC降解活性的计算预测工具，但现有监督学习方法仍面临E3连接酶维度下数据稀缺与分布失衡的严峻挑战，泛化能力仅局限于少数研究充分的连接酶场景。实际场景中，标注数据高度集中在CRBN、VHL等少数连接酶上，绝大多数E3连接酶仍缺乏足够探索，而后者对于拓展靶向降解剂的设计空间至关重要。因此开发仅需极少量标注数据即可实现跨连接酶鲁棒泛化的方法，对提升PROTAC计算发现的实用价值具有重要意义。本文将跨E3连接酶的PROTAC降解活性预测问题重构为小样本元学习问题，提出ProMeta框架：这是一种基于原型的图神经网络，通过情景元学习在源E3任务上完成训练，通过支持集条件化推理在未参与训练的目标E3任务上完成评估。ProMeta无需更新编码器，仅通过极少量目标连接酶支持样本动态估计类别原型即可完成推理。在CRBN到VHL的基准测试中，ProMeta在K=2、Q=3设置下AUROC值达0.796，在K=2、Q=5设置下AUROC值达0.883，相比对应的监督图神经网络基线分别提升19.9%和6.8%。相同协议下反向VHL到CRBN的迁移测试得到AUROC值分别为0.702（K=2, Q=3）和0.821（K=2, Q=5），验证了方法的双向适用性，同时也揭示了性能对迁移方向和数据分布的依赖性。上述结果表明，ProMeta是评估的支持/查询协议下跨连接酶小样本预测的实用框架。

title: Exact Degeneracy Under Balanced k-Shot Sampling:Consequences for Small-Sample Discriminant Analysis on LLM Embeddings
title_zh: 平衡k-样本采样下的精确退化现象：大语言模型嵌入小样本判别分析的性能影响
authors: Lingxiao Qu
abstract: Balanced k-shot sampling draws exactly k labeled examples per class. We show that it induces an exact, provable degeneracy in a family of small-sample discriminant estimators. Under balanced sampling, the within-class scatter operator of Kernelized Linear Principal Component Discriminant Analysis (KLPCDA) is not merely rank-deficient but exactly a scaled orthogonal projector. We derive the consequences in closed form: two of KLPCDA's seven variants have every signal eigenvalue exactly equal, so their eigenvector selection criterion is provably indifferent rather than ill-conditioned, and a third has a provably void objective. This follows from the estimators' construction, not any dataset; we confirm it on frozen sentence embeddings and, separately, on residual-stream activations from a decoder-only generative model. An in-formula tie-break repairs the two repairable variants, with recovery gated by class count: the residual subspace constraint costs 5x more on few-class than many-class datasets (p=0.000001).We then evaluate the repaired framework on few-shot text classification on frozen LLM embeddings (n much smaller than d, up to 4096), across four datasets, three embedding sizes, and three trained baselines (SetFit, LoRA, in-context learning). A properly cross-validated logistic-regression probe still beats every KLPCDA variant on three of four datasets, at every embedding size; guidance carried from pixel, vibration-signal, and gene-expression data does not directly generalize to this feature space. Three independent geometric separability metrics fail to explain why one high-dimensional decoder-based embedding model underperforms smaller bidirectional encoders, ruling out anisotropy; the gap is substantially an estimation-efficiency effect, not a permanent ceiling, closing by more than 80% when the support set grows from k<=10 to k=30-50 (p=0.00195, both many-class datasets).
summary_zh: 平衡k-样本采样指的是从每个类别中恰好抽取k个标注样本的采样方式。本文证明该采样方式会在一类小样本判别估计器中引发可证的精确退化现象。在平衡采样条件下，核化线性主成分判别分析（KLPCDA）的类内散度算子不仅秩亏，而且恰好是一个缩放后的正交投影算子。本文推导得到了该现象的闭式结论：KLPCDA的7种变体中有2种的所有信号特征值完全相等，因此其特征向量选择准则是可证的无差异而非病态，第3种变体的目标函数可证为空。该特性由估计器的构造方式决定，与数据集无关；本文在冻结的句子嵌入、仅解码器生成模型的残差流激活上分别验证了该结论。通过公式内的平局打破机制可修复其中2种可修复变体，修复效果受类别数约束：残差子空间约束在少类别数据集上的计算成本是多类别数据集的5倍（p=0.000001）。随后本文在冻结大语言模型嵌入（样本量n远小于特征维度d，最高维度达4096）上的小样本文本分类任务中对修复后的框架进行评估，覆盖4个数据集、3种嵌入维度，以及SetFit、LoRA、上下文学习3种训练基线。经过正确交叉验证的逻辑回归探针在4个数据集中的3个、所有嵌入维度下性能均超过所有KLPCDA变体，从像素、振动信号、基因表达数据中得到的先验经验无法直接泛化到该特征空间。3种独立的几何可分性指标均无法解释某款高维解码器嵌入模型性能低于更小的双向编码器的现象，排除了各向异性的影响；该性能差距本质上是估计效率效应而非性能天花板，当支持集规模从k≤10提升至k=30~50时，性能差距可缩小80%以上（两个多类别数据集p=0.00195）。

title: A Unifying Perspective on Probabilities as Model Predictions
title_zh: 作为模型预测的概率的统一视角
authors: Benedikt Höltgen
abstract: Although probabilistic statements are ubiquitous, foundational disagreements persist about their understanding, as exemplified by debates between Bayesians and frequentists; moreover, it is unclear when and why acting on them actually leads to desirable outcomes. Here, we argue that every probability is the output of a \emph{prediction method}, that is, it depends on both a particular way of constructing abstractions and a way of transforming them into predictions. Through this, we provide a unifying perspective on supposedly different kinds of probabilities and show that even supposedly objective ones are model-dependent. We demonstrate that when a finite calibration criterion is met, one can anticipate the distribution of utilities for a given policy and inform successful decision-making on finite sets of events. Based on the notion of prediction methods, inductive arguments, and the probability calculus, we explain the feasibility of the calibration criterion in many settings. Overall, we develop a coherent perspective on probabilities and their use, connecting key intuitions behind other interpretations along the way.
summary_zh: 尽管概率表述无处不在，但学界对其本质的基础认知始终存在分歧，贝叶斯学派与频率学派的长期争论就是典型体现；此外，人们也始终不清楚基于概率开展决策在何时、为何能够得到理想结果。本文提出，所有概率都是预测方法的输出，其取值既依赖于构造抽象的特定方式，也依赖于将抽象转化为预测的变换方式。基于该结论，本文为看似不同的各类概率提供了统一视角，证明即便是通常被认为客观的概率也具有模型依赖性。本文证明，当满足有限校准准则时，即可预测给定策略下的效用分布，为有限事件集下的成功决策提供支撑。基于预测方法的概念、归纳论证与概率演算规则，本文解释了多数场景下校准准则的可行性。整体而言，本文构建了一套关于概率及其应用的自洽视角，同时串联起其他概率解释背后的核心直觉。

title: When Does Low-Bit Quantization Preserve the Decisions of Vector Search?
title_zh: 低位量化在什么场景下可保留向量搜索的决策结果
authors: Wenxuan Xiao, Xu Cao
abstract: Low-bit quantization can achieve high recall on some vector representations and fail sharply on others, while average distortion and global rank correlation do not explain the difference. We study quantized vector search at the level of the comparisons consumed by ranking and graph-pruning algorithms. Our first result is a distribution-free decomposition: the probability that a comparison flips is bounded by the probability mass of exact margins near zero plus the tail probability of the calibrated residual. We then account for dependence between residuals that share a query or graph node, and derive covariance-aware second-moment identities and tail bounds under a joint MGF proxy. For a frozen candidate permutation, we prove a deterministic coupling theorem for Vamana neighbour selection: the approximate replay returns the exact neighbour list exactly when all candidate-level pruning actions agree on the frozen exact states. We connect these results to representation geometry through an exact Gaussian oracle, establish a strict correlation gain from a deterministic magnitude bit in an aligned bilinear model, and give a rare-contamination construction showing why marginal Gaussian diagnostics do not imply the required residual tails. When analytical assumptions are unavailable, a held-out block certificate bounds the selective failure risk of a frozen quantized rule. Across learned, classical, and synthetic embeddings, standardized exact margins predict held-out ranking and pruning flip rates substantially better than global rank correlation. The framework applies to coordinate binary codes, RaBitQ, Lucene BBQ, and product quantizers through a common decision interface.
summary_zh: 低位量化在部分向量表示上可实现高召回率，但在另一些向量表示上性能会骤降，而平均失真度与全局秩相关系数无法解释该差异。本文从排序与图剪枝算法所依赖的两两比较层面研究量化向量搜索问题。第一项研究结论是与分布无关的分解式：比较结果翻转的概率上界由接近零的精确边距的概率质量与校准残差的尾部概率共同决定。随后本文考虑共享查询或图节点的残差之间的依赖关系，在联合矩生成函数代理下推导得到协方差感知的二阶恒等式与尾部边界。针对冻结的候选排列，本文证明了Vamana邻域选择的确定性耦合定理：当所有候选层剪枝动作在冻结的精确状态下完全一致时，近似重放过程将返回完全准确的邻域列表。本文通过精确高斯预言机将上述结论与表示几何关联，在对齐双线性模型中证明确定性量级比特可带来严格的相关性增益，并构造了罕见污染场景示例，解释为何边缘高斯诊断无法推导出所需的残差尾部特性。当分析假设不成立时，留出块证书可对冻结量化规则的选择性失效风险给出上界。在学习嵌入、经典嵌入与合成嵌入的测试中，标准化精确边距对留出集排序与剪枝翻转率的预测效果显著优于全局秩相关系数。该框架通过统一的决策接口可适用于坐标二进制码、RaBitQ、Lucene BBQ与乘积量化等各类量化方案。

title: TempTPI: Informer-Based trajectory prediction for maritime vessels
title_zh: TempTPI：基于Informer的海上船舶轨迹预测
authors: Kevin Ferneding, Veronika Lietavcova, Aleksandra M. Blachowiak, Peder Heiselberg
abstract: Accurate long-term trajectory prediction for maritime vessels is essential for safety and logistical efficiency. While deep learning models, particularly Transformers, have shown promise in processing Automatic Identification System (AIS) data, they often struggle with the quadratic computational complexity of self-attention and the loss of accuracy over extended forecasting horizons. This study proposes TempTPI, a novel prediction framework that integrates an Informer-based encoder with a multi-channel temporal encoding mechanism. The Informer architecture leverages a ProbSparse self-attention mechanism to reduce computational overhead and focus on the most significant dependencies, while the temporal encoder utilizes Fourier-like frequency expansions to capture cyclic patterns (hourly, daily, and seasonal) in vessel behavior. We evaluate our model against the state-of-the-art TPTrans architecture using AIS data from Danish waters. Experimental results demonstrate that TempTPI consistently outperforms existing methods across prediction windows of 1 to 5 hours. Notably, at a 5-hour horizon, the proposed model achieves a 55% improvement in Mean Squared Error (MSE), offering a robust solution for long-range maritime situational awareness.
summary_zh: 海上船舶的精确长期轨迹预测对航行安全与物流效率至关重要。尽管深度学习模型尤其是Transformer类模型在处理AIS（自动识别系统）数据上展现出良好潜力，但这类模型普遍存在自注意力二次计算复杂度高、长预测时域下精度损失严重的问题。本研究提出TempTPI，这一全新预测框架集成了基于Informer（长序列高效Transformer）的编码器与多通道时序编码机制。Informer架构采用ProbSparse稀疏自注意力机制降低计算开销，聚焦最关键的依赖关系，而时序编码器采用类傅里叶频率扩展，捕获船舶行为中的小时级、日级、季节级周期性模式。本文使用丹麦海域的AIS数据，将所提模型与当前最优的TPTrans架构进行对比评估。实验结果表明，在1~5小时的预测窗口内，TempTPI的性能始终优于现有方法。尤其在5小时预测时域下，所提模型的均方误差（MSE）性能提升55%，可为长距离海上态势感知提供可靠解决方案。

title: In Medical Claims Data, Enhancing Predictive Performance for Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events Using Cross Attention
title_zh: 医疗理赔数据中基于交叉注意力提升主要不良心血管事件的预测性能
authors: Yuhei Fujioka, Daitaro Misawa, Tatsuyoshi Ikenoue, Shingo Fukuma
abstract: Medical claims data comprise the financial details, including the expenses and billing information, as well as the clinical information, such as the diagnoses and treatments, of patients visiting medical facilities. Recently, it has been acknowledged that large databases can be constructed from medical claims data for medical research purposes. However, the clinical information within these datasets is often medically unstructured, limiting its application in comprehensive analyses. This study enhances predictive model performance for major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), a leading cause of death worldwide. Models that predict MACE are crucial to clinical practice guidelines. We utilize a cross-attention mechanism to develop a method that effectively weights the relationships between diagnoses and treatments. Effectively repre- senting the clinical information contained in medical claims data, this approach generates more representative features for predicting MACE. The ROC-AUC score of our proposed cross-attention-based model was 0.7720, higher than other benchmark models including the conventional atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease model, the light gradient boosting machine, and a self-attention-based model. These results indicate that integrating the clinical structure of medical claims data using a cross-attention mechanism significantly enhances the performance of predictive models.
summary_zh: 医疗理赔数据包含患者在医疗机构就诊的费用、账单等财务信息，以及诊断、治疗等临床信息。近年来，学界逐渐意识到可基于医疗理赔数据构建大型数据库支撑医学研究，但这类数据中的临床信息通常属于非结构化医疗数据，限制了其在综合分析中的应用。本研究旨在提升MACE（主要不良心血管事件，全球范围内首要致死原因）的预测模型性能，MACE预测模型对临床实践指南制定具有重要支撑作用。本文利用交叉注意力机制开发了可有效加权诊断与治疗之间关联关系的方法，通过有效表征医疗理赔数据中的临床信息，生成更具代表性的特征用于MACE预测。本文提出的基于交叉注意力的模型ROC-AUC得分为0.7720，优于包括传统动脉粥样硬化心血管病预测模型、轻量梯度提升机、基于自注意力的模型在内的所有基准模型。上述结果表明，利用交叉注意力机制整合医疗理赔数据的临床结构特性，可显著提升预测模型的性能。

title: Online Inverse Integer Linear Optimization via Small-Gradient Skipping: Constant Regret and Finite Mistakes
title_zh: 基于小梯度跳过的在线逆整数线性优化：恒定遗憾与有限错误次数
authors: Akira Kitaoka
abstract: In online inverse linear optimization, the learner predicts a weight at each round, observes the optimal action of the agent, and updates its prediction. In the general setting, the gap of $\log T$ between the regret upper bound $O(d \log T)$ and the lower bound $\Omega(d)$ is unresolved (here $T$ is the total number of rounds and $d$ is the dimension). When the action set is M-convex, the regret is known to be bounded by $O(d \log d)$, but the method attaining it computes a center of gravity at every round. This paper therefore proposes Small-Gradient Skipping (SGS), a mechanism that skips the update at rounds without a mistake in the case where the correct action is uniformly separated from the other candidates, and applies it to online gradient descent, the online Newton step, and MetaGrad. The number of mistakes is then bounded, for all three, by a quantity independent of $T$; and for the online Newton step and for MetaGrad with SGS, the dimension dependence of the regret becomes $O(d^2)$ when the forward problem is an integer linear program, that is, the factor $\log T$ is removed. Moreover, when the action set is M-convex, the regret is bounded efficiently without computing a center of gravity.
summary_zh: 在线逆线性优化场景中，学习者每轮预测一个权重，观测智能体的最优动作后更新预测。在通用设置下，该领域的遗憾上界O(d log T)与下界Ω(d)之间存在log T的待填补差距，其中T为总轮次，d为维度。当动作集为M-凸集时，现有方法可实现O(d log d)的有界遗憾，但该方法需要每轮计算重心，计算成本极高。本文提出SGS（小梯度跳过）机制：当正确动作与其他候选动作均匀分离时，在无预测错误的轮次跳过更新步骤，并将该机制应用于在线梯度下降、在线牛顿步与MetaGrad三类算法。改进后三类算法的错误次数上界均与总轮次T无关；当正向问题为整数线性规划时，引入SGS的在线牛顿步与MetaGrad算法的遗憾维度依赖变为O(d²)，消除了原有的log T因子。此外，当动作集为M-凸集时，改进后的算法无需计算重心即可实现高效的有界遗憾。

title: A practical DIRECT-type algorithm for medium-scale black-box global optimization
title_zh: 面向中等规模黑盒全局优化的实用DIRECT类算法
authors: Linas Stripinis, Remigijus Paulavičius
abstract: The DIRECT algorithm is a deterministic global optimization method known for its versatility and balanced exploration-exploitation strategy. However, DIRECT-type algorithms are primarily effective for low-dimensional problems and often exhibit slow convergence as dimensionality increases, limiting their applicability to more complex optimization tasks. To address this limitation, this paper introduces X-DTC-GL, a novel DIRECT-type algorithm that incorporates dynamic partitioning and hybridization techniques. The dynamic partitioning approach adaptively refines the search space based on local one-dimensional surrogate models, enabling rapid subdivision of promising hyper-rectangles. The hybridization strategy selectively employs a hill-climbing method to exploit promising regions identified by the surrogate models. Extensive experiments on four diverse benchmark suites demonstrate that X-DTC-GL significantly outperforms existing DIRECT-type baselines, achieving improvements of ~12% in solvability and ~27% in solution quality. Performance-profile analyses indicate the fastest convergence on up to ~40% of instances, the best runtime performance on ~17% of problems, and competitive overall execution times. By improving performance within the partition-based framework, these advances strengthen the algorithm's competitiveness in state-of-the-art black-box optimization.
summary_zh: DIRECT算法是一种确定性全局优化方法，以通用性强、探索-利用策略平衡著称。但DIRECT类算法主要适用于低维问题，随着维度升高收敛速度通常会大幅下降，限制了其在更复杂优化任务中的应用。针对该缺陷，本文提出全新DIRECT类算法X-DTC-GL，集成动态划分与混合优化技术。动态划分方法基于局部一维代理模型自适应细化搜索空间，实现对高潜力超矩形的快速细分；混合优化策略选择性采用爬山法，对代理模型识别出的高潜力区域进行深度利用。在4套不同基准测试集上的大量实验表明，X-DTC-GL的性能显著优于现有DIRECT类基线算法，可解性提升约12%，解质量提升约27%。性能剖面分析结果显示，该算法在约40%的测试实例上收敛速度最快，在约17%的问题上运行时性能最优，整体执行时间具备竞争力。该研究在基于划分的框架内提升了算法性能，进一步强化了DIRECT类算法在当前最先进黑盒优化领域的竞争力。

title: Privacy-Preserving Split Learning for Federated LLM Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 面向联邦大语言模型微调的隐私保护拆分学习
authors: Heng Jin, Chaoyu Zhang, Hexuan Yu, Wenjing Lou, Y. Thomas Hou
abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on domain-specific data is essential for downstream adaptation. In many deployments, a participant cannot hold the complete model locally. This happens because the model owner keeps the full model proprietary, or because the participant lacks sufficient compute resources. Split Learning (SL) addresses this by partitioning the model between the participant and a server so that only a small portion runs locally. When the underlying data is additionally distributed across multiple institutions with privacy requirements, Federated Learning (FL) further enables collaborative training across participants by sharing only model updates instead of raw data. In this combined setting, each client transmits intermediate activations to the server, and for LLM fine-tuning, this exchange poses an inherent privacy paradox. The autoregressive nature of LLMs causes the transmitted activations to leak the input, and existing perturbation-based defenses are fundamentally ineffective in this setting. We address this leakage through a learned obfuscate-and-recover scheme that protects participants' private datasets while still allowing an independently deployable model to be trained on the server side. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves strong privacy protection with modest utility loss and system overhead, making split-based federated LLM fine-tuning practically viable.
summary_zh: 针对领域特定数据微调大语言模型（LLM）是下游适配的核心步骤。在很多部署场景中，参与方无法在本地存储完整模型：要么是因为模型所有者将完整模型作为专有资产不对外公开，要么是参与方自身算力资源不足。拆分学习（SL）通过将模型在参与方与服务器之间切分，仅让小部分模型在本地运行，可解决上述问题。当底层数据进一步分布在多个有隐私约束的机构中时，联邦学习（FL）仅共享模型更新而非原始数据，可支撑跨参与方的协同训练。在二者结合的场景下，每个客户端将中间激活值传输到服务器端，而针对大语言模型微调的传输过程存在固有的隐私悖论：大语言模型的自回归特性会导致传输的激活值泄露输入信息，现有的基于扰动的防御方案在该场景下基本无效。本文通过学习得到的“混淆-恢复”机制解决该泄露问题，在保护参与方私有数据集的同时，仍可在服务器端训练得到可独立部署的模型。实验结果表明，本文提出的方法可实现强隐私保护，仅带来适度的效用损失与系统开销，让基于拆分的联邦大语言模型微调具备实际落地可行性。

title: Evaluating Model Retraining under Drift: Paired Comparisons of Cumulative Subgroup Disparity
title_zh: 数据漂移场景下的模型重训练评估：累积子群差异的配对比较
authors: Aaron Ceross
abstract: Choosing when to retrain a deployed classifier requires assessing subgroup error rates across the sequence of models used, including periods between updates. We compare complete scheduled, loss-triggered, and subgroup-gap-triggered policies with retaining the initial model on the same observations and delayed labels. For true-positive and false-positive rates separately, the outcome is the paired difference in absolute subgroup gaps summed over deployment windows. Population evaluation in simulation, action records, and alternative schedules assess how measurement and retraining behaviour affect these comparisons. In a follow-up sample of 400 new trajectories per condition across two simulated drift regimes, all three policies had lower mean cumulative disparity, equivalent to reductions of 0.04 to 0.88 percentage points in the average gap per window. Evaluating the unchanged models against the known generating distributions preserved all mean directions, but finite-window and population comparisons agreed on whether updating increased, reduced or left cumulative disparity unchanged in 69 to 92 percent of trajectories. Under subgroup-specific drift, smaller true-positive-rate gaps accompanied lower sensitivity in both groups. In an exploratory American Community Survey replay, person weighting reversed all three race false-positive-rate mean comparisons without changing predictions or actions; all three weighted intervals included zero. Policy comparisons require group-specific rates, action distributions, and an explicit evaluation population alongside mean disparity. These analyses are non-confirmatory. Shared replay requires policy-independent observations and complete labels after the specified delay.
summary_zh: 确定已部署分类器的重训练时机，需要评估所用模型序列（包括两次更新之间的时段）的子群错误率。本研究在相同观测样本与延迟标签条件下，对比了全量定时重训练策略、损失触发重训练策略、子群差距触发重训练策略与保留初始模型策略的效果。针对真阳性率与假阳性率分别开展评估，评估指标为各部署窗口内绝对子群差距的配对差值之和。通过仿真环境下的总体评估、行为记录与替代调度方案，分析测量行为与重训练行为对上述对比结果的影响。在两种模拟漂移场景下的后续验证样本中，每种条件包含400条新轨迹，结果显示三种重训练策略的平均累积差异均更低，相当于每个窗口的平均差距降低0.04至0.88个百分点。基于已知生成分布评估未更新模型时，所有均值变化方向均与有限窗口评估结果一致，且在69%至92%的轨迹中，有限窗口对比与总体对比对更新操作是提升、降低还是未改变累积差异的判断结论完全吻合。在子群特定漂移场景下，更小的真阳性率差距伴随两组群体的分类敏感度同步降低。在基于美国社区调查数据的探索性重放实验中，在不改变预测结果与操作的前提下，人口加权操作反转了三类种族假阳性率的均值对比结果，所有加权区间均包含0。策略对比需要结合群体特定率、操作分布、明确的评估总体以及平均差异指标共同开展。本研究的分析不属于验证性分析，可复现的重放实验需要与策略无关的观测样本，以及指定延迟后可完整获取的标签。

title: NEXUS-MI: Communication-Aware Federated Personalization for Gateway-Coordinated Motor-Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces
title_zh: NEXUS-MI：面向网关协调运动想象脑机接口的通信感知联邦个性化框架
authors: Daniel Adu Worae, Aarthy Nagarajan
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based motor-imagery brain-computer interfaces (MI-BCIs) vary across subjects and sessions, complicating personalization from limited calibration data. Federated learning can exploit shared representations without centralizing raw EEG, but existing federated MI studies largely assume regular synchronization. We introduce NEXUS-MI, a gateway-coordinated federated personalization framework that treats synchronization as a coupled learning-and-communication control problem. Raw EEG and classifier heads remain local, while an edge coordinator maintains the shared backbone. We evaluate NEXUS-MI through offline replay using BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a (BCICIV-2a; 9 subjects, 4 classes) and OpenBMI (54 subjects, 2 classes). Session 1 supports backbone learning, and Session 2 provides limited-calibration personalization and held-out testing. An ideal-link reference and six heterogeneous-link policies characterize gateway participation, buffering, stale-update admission, and backbone-download control. The principal comparison holds delayed-update handling fixed while contrasting non-adaptive and communication-aware synchronization. Paired subject-level comparisons use Holm adjustment, and robustness across five matched realizations is assessed by hierarchical bootstrap. Communication-aware coordination reduced server-to-client backbone traffic by approximately 42% on both datasets, while cohort-level accuracy differences were small and realization-dependent. Cohort averages also concealed subject-level vulnerability, with losses reaching approximately 12 percentage points on BCICIV-2a relative to the ideal-link reference. These findings establish gateway synchronization as an explicit design variable in federated MI personalization and motivate joint evaluation of personalized accuracy, communication cost, update freshness, and subject-level reliability.
summary_zh: 基于脑电图（EEG）的运动想象脑机接口（MI-BCI）存在跨受试者、跨会话的差异，仅依靠有限校准数据难以实现个性化适配。联邦学习无需集中原始EEG数据即可挖掘共享表征，但现有面向运动想象的联邦学习研究大多假设同步机制是固定的。本文提出NEXUS-MI，一种由网关协调的联邦个性化框架，将同步问题建模为学习与通信的耦合控制问题。原始EEG与分类器头部始终保留在本地，由边缘协调器维护共享骨干网络。我们基于BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a（BCICIV-2a，包含9名受试者、4类运动想象任务）与OpenBMI（包含54名受试者、2类运动想象任务）开展离线重放实验验证NEXUS-MI的效果：使用第1会话数据训练骨干网络，第2会话数据用于有限校准下的个性化适配与留出测试。通过理想链路参考方案与6种异构链路策略，表征网关参与度、缓冲机制、过期更新准入规则、骨干网络下载控制的特性。核心对比实验固定延迟更新处理逻辑，对比非自适应同步与通信感知同步的性能差异。受试者级配对比较采用Holm校正，通过分层自举法评估5组匹配实现下的鲁棒性。实验结果显示，在两个数据集上，通信感知协调机制将服务器到客户端的骨干网络传输流量降低了约42%，而队列级准确率差异很小且与具体实现相关。队列平均指标掩盖了受试者级的性能波动：与理想链路参考方案相比，NEXUS-MI在BCICIV-2a数据集上的最大性能损失约为12个百分点。上述结果表明，网关同步是联邦运动想象个性化中的明确设计变量，后续研究需要联合评估个性化准确率、通信成本、更新新鲜度与受试者级可靠性。

title: EEGBind: Detecting Source-Level Interictal Epileptiform Discharges via EEG-Centric Multimodal Binding
title_zh: EEGBind：基于以脑电图为核心的多模态绑定技术检测源级发作间期痫样放电
authors: Muchen Li, Anglin Liu, Xuetian Gao, Ruijian Xu, Jintai Chen
abstract: Source-level analysis of interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) is relevant to presurgical evaluation and treatment planning because it helps characterize where epileptiform activity is likely to arise. Beyond detecting whether an IED is present, this setting requires assigning IED-positive activity to clinically meaningful brain-region categories. This setting is challenging because source-region evidence in short electroencephalography (EEG) windows can be subtle, partial, and affected by subject variability, class imbalance, and imperfect multimodal context. We present EEGBind, an EEG-centric multimodal binding framework for five-class source-level IED classification. EEGBind treats EEG as the primary modality and binds synchronized video-context features around an EEG-centric representation. Instead of relying on early or overly strong multimodal fusion, which may perturb the source-sensitive EEG representation, EEGBind uses video context as auxiliary evidence for robust classification. A view-consistent repair stage is further used to improve hidden-set robustness while preserving the learned source-class boundary. On the NeuroMM 2026 Grand Challenge Track 3 NMM-Source-IED benchmark, EEGBind achieves 0.8395 on weighted-F1 and outperforms strong competitors. These results support EEG-centric multimodal binding as a practical strategy for source-level IED classification. The open-source code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 发作间期痫样放电（IED）的源级分析对术前评估与治疗规划具有重要意义，可辅助定位痫样活动的潜在起源区域。该任务不仅需要判断是否存在IED，还需要将IED阳性活动分配到临床有意义的脑区类别中。该任务存在诸多挑战：短脑电图（EEG）窗口内的源区域证据十分微弱且不完整，同时受受试者异质性、类别不平衡、多模态上下文信息不完善等因素影响。本文提出EEGBind，一种以脑电图为核心的多模态绑定框架，用于实现5分类的源级IED分类。EEGBind将脑电图作为主模态，将同步视频上下文特征绑定到以脑电图为核心的表征空间中。不同于可能破坏源敏感脑电图表征的早期融合或强多模态融合方案，EEGBind将视频上下文作为辅助证据，提升分类鲁棒性。框架还引入视图一致修复阶段，在保留学习到的源类别边界的前提下提升隐藏测试集上的泛化性能。在NeuroMM 2026挑战赛第三赛道NMM-Source-IED基准数据集上，EEGBind的加权F1值达到0.8395，性能优于现有主流对比方法。实验结果表明，以脑电图为核心的多模态绑定是源级IED分类的实用方案。相关开源代码可通过指定链接获取。

title: EFQ-Softmax: Exp-Free Quantization for Softmax
title_zh: EFQ-Softmax：面向Softmax的无指数量化方法
authors: Haohui Han, Yuming Wan, Hongni Wang, Pengcheng Xie, Xiaodong Yan 等 (7 人)
abstract: Low-bit attention accelerates Transformer inference by moving the $QK^\top$ and $PV$ matrix multiplications to FP8 or FP4 matrix engines. However, the softmax path often evaluates shifted-score exponentials in higher precision, forms a temporary probability block, and quantizes it before low-bit $PV$ multiplication. This exp-then-quantize path creates a mismatch between a high-precision probability producer and a low-bit matrix consumer. We propose EFQ-Softmax (Exp-Free Quantization for Softmax), a low-bit probability-generation method that directly maps shifted attention scores to block-scaled E2M1 operands. For each microscaling block, EFQ-Softmax selects an exponent-only scale from the local maximum, maps the shifted scores to a normalized residual domain, and generates nonnegative E2M1 probability codes using a single affine rule. The resulting operand is used consistently in both the $\widetilde{P}V$ numerator update and the $\widetilde{P}\mathbf{1}$ denominator update. The FlashAttention-style row-maximum update, historical rescaling, high-precision accumulation, and final normalization remain unchanged. We evaluate end-to-end quality on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and WAN2.2-TI2V-5B, and separately measure kernel-level performance on the A5 vector unit. EFQ-Softmax improves the Qwen3-8B seven-task mean from 0.6749 with MXFP4 to 0.6773 and the Qwen3-VL nine-task mean from 0.7826 to 0.8000. On WAN2.2, it maintains temporal consistency and visual quality comparable to the FP16 and MXFP4 baselines under VBench. On the A5 vector unit, EFQ-Softmax reduces the vector-stage latency of the fused probability-generation kernel by 40.33% on average across sequence lengths from 16K to 128K. These results show that direct low-bit probability generation can replace the conventional exp-then-quantize path while preserving end-to-end model quality.
summary_zh: 低位宽注意力机制将QK^T与PV矩阵乘法迁移到FP8或FP4矩阵运算引擎中，可加速Transformer推理。但现有Softmax计算路径通常以更高精度计算移位分数的指数，生成临时概率块后再执行量化，随后才进入低位宽PV乘法环节。这种先算指数再量化的路径导致高精度概率生成环节与低位宽矩阵运算环节之间存在精度不匹配问题。本文提出EFQ-Softmax（Exp-Free Quantization for Softmax，面向Softmax的无指数量化方法），一种低位宽概率生成方法，可直接将移位后的注意力分数映射为块缩放的E2M1操作数。针对每个微缩放块，EFQ-Softmax根据局部最大值选择仅含指数的缩放因子，将移位后的分数映射到归一化残差域，仅通过单仿射规则生成非负的E2M1概率编码。生成的操作数可直接用于P~V分子更新与P~1分母更新，FlashAttention风格的行最大值更新、历史重缩放、高精度累加与最终归一化流程均保持不变。我们在Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct与WAN2.2-TI2V-5B模型上评估端到端性能，同时在A5向量单元上测试内核级性能。实验结果显示，EFQ-Softmax将Qwen3-8B的7任务平均得分从MXFP4基准的0.6749提升至0.6773，将Qwen3-VL的9任务平均得分从0.7826提升至0.8000。在WAN2.2模型上，EFQ-Softmax在VBench评测下保持了与FP16、MXFP4基准相当的时间一致性与视觉质量。在A5向量单元上，对于16K到128K的序列长度，EFQ-Softmax将融合概率生成内核的向量阶段延迟平均降低40.33%。上述结果表明，直接低位宽概率生成可替代传统的先算指数再量化路径，同时不损失端到端模型性能。

title: Efficient Graph Neural Networks for Multicarrier Wideband Hybrid Beamforming Optimization
title_zh: 面向多载波宽带混合波束赋形优化的高效图神经网络
authors: Beier Li, Mai Vu
abstract: 6G wireless technology is poised to adopt higher and wider frequency bands, leveraging highly directional beamforming. However, the vast bandwidths amplify the impact of beam squinting. Traditional solutions, such as adding a true-time-delay filter to each antenna, are cost-prohibitive due to the required hardware scale. This paper proposes a signal processing alternative using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to optimize hybrid beamforming in multicarrier wideband systems. Using a bipartite graph to represent a shared analog beamformer among multiple subcarriers, we develop three GNN structures with distinct digital beamformer representations (i) at the subcarrier nodes, (ii) at the edges, or (iii) integrating traditional singular-value decomposition solutions. By designing an efficient message-passing mechanism, these structures offer insights into the impact of different GNN designs on communication system performance and computational complexity. Extensive analysis and ablation studies show that our proposed GNN structures outperform traditional optimization methods and existing ML-based solutions. Furthermore, the proposed GNNs exhibit strong resiliency to beam squinting and better robustness against imperfect CSI than even fully digital beamforming and all existing hybrid designs. These GNNs can also be extended to multi-user scenarios and demonstrate excellent generalization capabilities, allowing trained models to adapt to diverse multicarrier and multi-user settings without retraining.
summary_zh: 6G无线技术将采用更高、更宽的频段，依赖高定向波束赋形技术。但超大带宽会放大波束斜视效应的影响。传统解决方案例如为每根天线添加真时延滤波器，所需硬件规模过大，成本难以接受。本文提出一种基于信号处理的替代方案，利用图神经网络（GNN）优化多载波宽带系统的混合波束赋形。通过二分图表征多个子载波之间共享的模拟波束赋形器，开发三种具有不同数字波束赋形表征形式的GNN结构：（1）将数字波束赋形表征为子载波节点属性；（2）将数字波束赋形表征为边属性；（3）融合传统奇异值分解解决方案。通过设计高效的消息传递机制，上述三种结构可揭示不同GNN设计对通信系统性能与计算复杂度的影响。大量分析与消融实验表明，本文提出的GNN结构性能优于传统优化方法与现有基于机器学习的解决方案。此外，所提GNN对波束斜视具有极强的抗干扰能力，在信道状态信息（CSI）不完善场景下的鲁棒性甚至优于全数字波束赋形与所有现有混合波束赋形设计。该GNN还可扩展到多用户场景，具备优异的泛化能力，训练后的模型无需重训练即可适配不同的多载波与多用户配置。

title: ALIGN-HOLD: Experience Alignment for Real-Time Hold Control in Large-Scale Ride-Hailing Matching at DiDi
title_zh: ALIGN-HOLD：面向滴滴大规模网约车匹配实时滞留控制的经验对齐框架
authors: Zuhao Zhang, Xu Liu, Kai Wan, Zihao Lu, Li Ma 等 (6 人)
abstract: Real-time hold control is a high-leverage mechanism in large-scale ride-hailing systems: by selectively deferring driver-order pairs, the platform can wait for better matching opportunities and improve end-to-end passenger-driver experience. Existing production systems such as EXHOLD learn bandit-based hold policies from handcrafted combinations of trip completion, cancellations, waiting time, and driver effort. However, designing such rewards becomes increasingly difficult as marketplace preferences are heterogeneous and observed passenger-driver behavior can be sparse, noisy, and affected by dynamic supply-demand conditions.We present ALIGN-HOLD, a production-scale experience alignment framework that learns hold policy from implicit marketplace preferences. ALIGN-HOLD constructs complementary preference pairs from order trajectories, driver trajectories, and contemporaneous local matching graphs, and trains an experience Reward Model (RM) using balanced multi-view sampling and model-adaptive hard preference sampling. During simulator-based policy learning, the frozen RM provides a dense, context-dependent reward and supports label-free filtering of low-identifiability interactions whose behavioral feedback is difficult to attribute to matching quality.We deploy ALIGN-HOLD on DiDi's ride-hailing platform and evaluate it in a 28-day randomized A/B experiment, covering approximately 100,000 passenger requests per day. Compared with the deployed production policy, ALIGN-HOLD achieves statistically significant improvements in trip completion rate and driver income, while significantly reducing passenger cancellations before and after driver acceptance. Complementary ablations, RM diagnostics, and behavioral analyses validate the contributions of the proposed components. ALIGN-HOLD has been fully ramped up and is currently serving DiDi's Brazil marketplace.
summary_zh: 实时滞留控制是大规模网约车系统中极具价值的机制：通过选择性延迟部分司机-订单配对，平台可等待更优的匹配机会，提升乘客与司机的端到端体验。现有生产系统例如EXHOLD基于行程完成率、取消率、等待时长、司机工作量的人工组合特征，学习基于多臂老虎机的滞留策略。但随着市场偏好的异质性不断提升，观测到的乘客-司机行为存在稀疏、噪声大、受动态供需条件影响等问题，设计这类奖励函数的难度越来越高。本文提出ALIGN-HOLD，一种生产级经验对齐框架，可从隐式市场偏好中学习滞留策略。ALIGN-HOLD从订单轨迹、司机轨迹与同期局部匹配图中构建互补偏好对，采用平衡多视图采样与模型自适应难例偏好采样训练经验奖励模型（RM）。在基于模拟器的策略学习阶段，冻结的奖励模型可提供稠密的、上下文相关的奖励，支持对低可识别性交互的无标签过滤，这类交互的行为反馈难以归因到匹配质量。我们在滴滴网约车平台上部署ALIGN-HOLD，开展为期28天的随机A/B实验，覆盖每日约10万条乘客请求。与原有生产策略相比，ALIGN-HOLD在行程完成率与司机收入上取得了统计显著的提升，同时大幅降低了司机接单前后的乘客取消率。配套的消融实验、奖励模型诊断与行为分析验证了所提组件的有效性。目前ALIGN-HOLD已全量上线，服务于滴滴巴西市场。

title: Settling: Equilibrium Inference for Non-Convex Validity Sets
title_zh: Settling：面向非凸有效集的均衡推断方法
authors: Lyes Saad Saoud
abstract: Many learning systems return a single point estimate even when admissible outputs form disconnected or non-convex sets. Under squared loss, an ambiguous conditional distribution can therefore have a Bayes-optimal conditional mean that is invalid. We formalize this failure as conditional mean collapse and introduce Settling, an equilibrium-based inference operator that separates proposal generation, consistency evaluation, and test-time equilibrium selection. The operator treats a mean-seeking proposal as an initialization and refines it toward a locally stable configuration; conditional on initialization, refinement is deterministic. We establish exact-gradient descent, local convergence, and an inexact-gradient robustness condition relevant to learned consistency critics. In a reproducible 100-context geometric diagnostic, the mean-seeking baseline succeeds in 0/100 contexts, stochastic denoising in 100/100, and Settling in 99/100 while producing substantially lower trajectory roughness. A 1,200-run sensitivity study yields 97-100% success across obstacle-jitter ranges up to 0.20 and 94-100% across one-time initialization perturbations from 0.05 to 0.50. Cross-domain panels remain mechanism illustrations; learned high-dimensional validation remains an open empirical test.
summary_zh: 许多学习系统即使在允许输出为非连通或非凸集的场景下，也仅返回单点估计。在平方损失下，模糊的条件分布可能存在贝叶斯最优条件均值不属于有效输出集的问题。本文将这类失效形式化为条件均值坍缩，提出Settling，一种基于均衡的推断算子，将提议生成、一致性评估、测试时均衡选择三个环节解耦。该算子将基于均值的提议作为初始化，将其细化到局部稳定配置；在给定初始化的前提下，细化过程是确定性的。本文证明了该方法与精确梯度下降的等价性、局部收敛性，以及与学习得到的一致性评判器相关的非精确梯度鲁棒性条件。在可复现的100上下文几何诊断实验中，基于均值的基线方法在全部100个上下文中均失效，随机去噪方法在全部100个上下文中均成功，Settling在99个上下文中成功，同时生成轨迹的平滑度远高于随机去噪方法。1200次灵敏度实验结果显示，在障碍物抖动范围最高为0.20的场景下，Settling的成功率为97%-100%；在初始化扰动范围为0.05到0.50的场景下，成功率为94%-100%。跨域对比仅作为机制演示，学习高维验证仍是有待后续探索的实证问题。

title: Muon-C: Operator-Aligned Muon for Convolutional Kernels
title_zh: Muon-C：面向卷积核的算子对齐Muon优化器
authors: Jiaxin Qing, Lexin Li
abstract: Muon replaces matrix momentum with an approximately orthogonal polar direction, but its geometry depends on the matrix representation. For convolution, standard unfolding describes a local patch map rather than the convolution operator. We introduce Muon-C, an operator-aligned optimizer that represents kernel momentum as frequency-wise channel-transfer matrices, polarizes these blocks independently, and uses a critical Fourier grid to return updates exactly to the original finite kernel support. We show that the new geometry arises from combining the block partition and Fourier coordinates. The exact-polar direction is a linear minimization oracle under the critically sampled convolution norm. Its worst-case guarantee relative to the continuous convolution-operator norm is never weaker than unfolding and is strictly stronger for $3\times3$ kernels. On CIFAR-10 flow matching with matched applied-update RMS, Muon-C reaches 9.87 FID at 40k iterations, compared with 22.26 for unfolded Muon and 51.31 for Adam. It reaches their final quality using $0.62\times$ and $0.64\times$ their model FLOPs, respectively. Under equal tuning budgets, Muon-C achieves 3.42 FID. Gains persist across data scales and transfer to classification across convolutional architectures.
summary_zh: Muon优化器将矩阵动量替换为近似正交的极方向，但其几何特性依赖于矩阵的表征形式。对于卷积操作，标准展开操作描述的是局部补丁映射而非卷积算子本身。本文提出Muon-C，一种算子对齐优化器，将核动量表征为逐频通道转移矩阵，独立对这些块执行极化操作，利用临界傅里叶网格将更新结果精确映射回原始有限核支撑域。本文证明新的几何特性由块划分与傅里叶坐标结合生成。精确极方向是临界采样卷积范数下的线性最小化神谕。与连续卷积算子范数相比，Muon-C的最坏情况保证性能不弱于基于展开的Muon优化器，对于3×3核的场景性能显著更优。在CIFAR-10流匹配任务中，在应用更新的均方根值匹配的前提下，Muon-C训练40k迭代即可达到9.87的FID值，而基于展开的Muon优化器与Adam优化器的FID值分别为22.26与51.31。Muon-C达到对比方法的最终质量所需的模型浮点运算量仅为后两者的0.62倍与0.64倍。在调优预算相同的前提下，Muon-C可达到3.42的FID值。该性能优势在不同数据规模下均成立，且可迁移到不同卷积架构的分类任务中。

title: PELM: Power Efficient On-Device LLM Inference with Speculative Decoding and Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling
title_zh: PELM：结合投机解码与动态电压频率调节的高能效端侧大语言模型推理方法
authors: Weisi Yang, Stephen Xia
abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) directly on mobile platforms at the edge is gaining traction due to a myriad of benefits, such as increased privacy, personalization, and reduced latency. However, LLMs have heavy computational requirements, which are difficult for resource-constrained mobile and edge platforms to fulfill. In addition to limited compute resources, mobile and edge systems often have a compact form factor and lack physical mechanisms to dissipate heat generated from high processor usage rates (e.g., fans) to prevent throttling and reduced processing power, which LLMs can easily cause. To mitigate these effects, prior works have proposed various power governing strategies, such as dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), for reducing power and heat generation for heavy computational tasks on mobile platforms. Recently, DVFS methods tailored for mobile LLMs have also been proposed. However, these methods mostly focus on optimizing hardware parameters and processor frequencies, and they fall short under some thermally constrained scenarios. Drawing from recent advances in machine learning, we identify and take advantage of the key insight that not all tokens require full-depth inference to maintain high-quality generation. Motivated by this, we present PELM, a solution that augments traditional DVFS processor frequency tuning with two additional workload-specific knobs: 1) speculative decoding and 2) variable verification depth to expand the optimization space to multiple dimensions for more power efficient on-device LLM inference. In extensive evaluations across hardware platforms and datasets, PELM demonstrates superior performance compared to state-of-the-art power governing methods, with up to 23.1% speedup and 52.4% reduction in energy consumption, while maintaining comparable task performance. The source code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）直接部署在边缘移动平台上可带来隐私性提升、个性化程度提高、延迟降低等诸多优势，相关研究受到广泛关注。但大语言模型的计算需求极高，资源受限的移动与边缘平台难以满足。除计算资源有限外，移动与边缘系统通常外形紧凑，缺少风扇等物理散热机制，无法消散大语言模型高处理器占用产生的热量，进而会触发处理器降频，导致处理性能下降。为缓解该问题，现有研究提出了多种功耗管控策略例如动态电压频率调节（DVFS），降低移动平台高计算负载任务的功耗与产热。近期也出现了面向移动大语言模型定制的DVFS方法，但这类方法大多聚焦于优化硬件参数与处理器频率，在部分热约束场景下性能表现不佳。基于机器学习领域的最新进展，本文提出核心洞察：并非所有token都需要执行全深度推理才能保证生成质量。基于该洞察，本文提出PELM，一种在传统DVFS处理器频率调优的基础上新增两类面向工作负载的控制旋钮的方案：1）投机解码；2）可变验证深度，将优化空间扩展到多个维度，实现更高能效的端侧大语言模型推理。在跨硬件平台与数据集的大量评估中，PELM的性能优于现有最先进的功耗管控方法，在保持相当任务性能的前提下，最高可实现23.1%的速度提升与52.4%的能耗降低。相关开源代码可通过指定链接获取。

title: Distillation of Synthetic Data for Time Series Foundation Models
title_zh: 面向时间序列基础模型的合成数据蒸馏方法
authors: Niloy Biswas, Noureddine El Karoui
abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly pre-trained on synthetically generated time series trajectories, where the data generating process is known. Current pre-training recipes are based on loss objectives which compare TSFM outputs to realized future values of each trajectory. We instead propose loss objectives which compare TSFM outputs to the conditional forecast distribution of each trajectory, a procedure we call synthetic data distillation (SDD). SDD corresponds to a Rao-Blackwellization of the training objective, in that it leaves the expectation of stochastic gradients unchanged while provably reducing the covariance of the stochastic gradient under the Loewner partial ordering. We empirically validate SDD on a TSFM model family of sizes from $4$M to $2.5$B parameters, and observe faster convergence of validation loss at every model size: on Gaussian Process data, SDD attains or improves upon the Status Quo loss whilst requiring $10\%-40\%$ less training iterations.
summary_zh: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）越来越多地采用生成过程已知的合成时间序列轨迹开展预训练。现有预训练方案采用的损失函数将时间序列基础模型的输出与每条轨迹的真实未来值做对比。本文提出一类新的损失函数，将时间序列基础模型的输出与每条轨迹的条件预测分布做对比，该方法被命名为合成数据蒸馏（SDD）。合成数据蒸馏对应训练目标的Rao-Blackwell化操作，可保证随机梯度的期望保持不变，同时在Loewner偏序意义下可证明降低随机梯度的协方差。我们在参数量从4M到2.5B的时间序列基础模型系列上开展实证验证，结果显示在所有模型规模下，合成数据蒸馏均可加快验证损失的收敛速度：在高斯过程生成的数据上，合成数据蒸馏可达到或超越现有基准方法的损失水平，同时所需的训练迭代次数减少10%-40%。

title: Geometric organization of olfactory descriptor data in the Poincaré disk
title_zh: 嗅觉描述符数据在庞加莱圆盘（Poincaré disk）中的几何组织规律
authors: Aniss Aiman Medbouhi, Farzaneh Taleb, Giovanni Luca Marchetti, Danica Kragic
abstract: Odor quality is commonly represented using high dimensional descriptor profiles, yet their low dimensional organization remains unclear. We investigated whether a two-dimensional hyperbolic embedding can provide an interpretable representation of this structure. We applied hyperbolic metric multidimensional scaling to two complementary datasets: 480 Sagar rating profiles from three participants rating 160 odorants on 15 continuous descriptors, and 4983 GoodScents--Leffingwell molecules annotated with 138 binary descriptors. The embeddings substantially preserved pairwise descriptor distances, supporting subsequent analyses of radial and angular organization. In Sagar, rating profile entropy was strongly and negatively associated with hyperbolic radius, with diffuse profiles closer to the center and concentrated profiles closer to the boundary. This radial organization emerged primarily at the level of the full descriptor profile, rather than any individual descriptor, and remained robust across alternative descriptor representations, participant specific analyses, and averaged ratings. Sweet, musky, fruity, pleasantness showed the strongest directional trends. In GoodScents--Leffingwell, active label entropy, reflecting descriptor multiplicity, increased with radius, whereas orthogonalized descriptor entropy, reflecting spread across orthogonal modes, decreased with radius. Related binary descriptors occupied coherent localized high-density regions. These findings reveal complementary radial and angular organization in the hyperbolic representation of olfactory descriptor data. They support hyperbolic mapping as an interpretable descriptive framework in which radius summarizes global profile properties, while the angular component captures continuous descriptor gradients and categorical organization.
summary_zh: 气味品质通常采用高维描述谱表征，但其低维空间的组织规律目前仍不明确。本研究探究二维双曲嵌入是否可为该结构提供可解释的表征方案。我们将双曲度量多维尺度方法应用于两个互补数据集：其一为来自3名受试者对160种气味的15个连续描述符评分得到的480条Sagar评分谱，其二为标注了138个二元描述符的4983个GoodScents--Leffingwell分子。得到的嵌入结果大幅保留了描述符间的成对距离，为后续径向与角向组织规律分析提供了支撑。在Sagar数据集中，评分谱的熵值与双曲半径呈显著负相关：弥散分布的评分谱更靠近圆盘中心，集中分布的评分谱更靠近圆盘边界。这种径向组织规律主要存在于完整描述谱层面，而非单个描述符层面，且在不同描述符表征方案、受试者独立分析、平均评分场景下均保持稳健。甜味、麝香味、果味、愉悦度呈现出最强的方向趋势。在GoodScents--Leffingwell数据集中，反映描述符多重性的激活标签熵随半径增大而升高，而反映正交模式分布的正交化描述符熵随半径增大而降低，相关的二元描述符分布在连续的局部高密度区域。上述发现揭示了嗅觉描述符数据的双曲表征中互补的径向与角向组织规律，证明双曲映射是一种可解释的描述框架：其中半径可表征全局谱属性，角向分量可捕捉连续描述符梯度与分类组织模式。

title: Positional task conditioning for scalable defect detection across product families in large product catalogs
title_zh: 大规模产品目录下跨产品家族可扩展缺陷检测的位置任务条件化方法
authors: Soham Satyadharma, Gabriel Roccabruna, Suleiman A. Khan
abstract: Product families in large product catalogs suffer from inconsistencies such as duplicates and unit mismatches that degrade customer experience. Detecting these requires reasoning over multiple error types across lengthy product listings, where LLM classification quality degrades due to long-context limitations. We address this by decomposing detection into focused sub-tasks that reduce context and isolate error types, improving F1 from 52\% to 87\%. For scalable deployment, we introduce Positional Task Conditioning (PTC), which distills this capability into a single smaller model by reinforcing task identity at structural prompt boundaries. PTC outperforms rationale-based distillation across five models and two architecture families, achieving within 1.79\% F1 of the frontier at upto 98\% lower cost. Our system is deployed across multiple countries processing 10+ million product families.
summary_zh: 大型产品目录中的产品家族普遍存在重复、单位不匹配等不一致问题，会损害用户体验。检测这类问题需要对长产品列表中的多类错误进行推理，而大语言模型受长上下文限制，分类质量会出现明显下降。本研究将检测任务拆解为多个聚焦性子任务，通过缩减上下文长度、隔离错误类型，将F1值从52%提升至87%。为实现可扩展部署，我们提出位置任务条件化（Positional Task Conditioning, PTC）方法，通过在结构化提示边界强化任务标识，将上述检测能力蒸馏到单个更小的模型中。在5个模型、2类架构体系的对比实验中，PTC的表现优于基于基本原理的蒸馏方法，在成本降低最高98%的前提下，F1值仅比当前最优水平低1.79%。目前该系统已在多个国家部署，可处理超过1000万个产品家族。

title: Robust Industrial Cyber Physical Classification Using Neuromorphic Temporal Embeddings and Hybrid SNN XGBoost Under Machine Unlearning Attacks
title_zh: 机器遗忘攻击下基于神经形态时间嵌入与SNN-XGBoost混合架构的鲁棒工业信息物理分类
authors: Ammar Kamoona, Sajad Koushkbaghi, Mahdi Jalili, Peter McTaggart, Xinghuo Yu
abstract: The digitalisation of electrical distribution networks has increased the exposure of power-grid infrastructure to cyber attacks. Existing intrusion detection systems (IDSs), however, often rely on computationally expensive deep learning models that are difficult to deploy at the edge. Periodic retraining also exposes these systems to machine unlearning attacks, where selective data removal can degrade detection performance. We propose a hybrid Spiking Neural Network (SNN) and XGBoost architecture that combines efficient temporal encoding with a lightweight classifier and provides structural resilience to such attacks. The SNN is trained once on clean data and used as a fixed feature extractor, while only the XGBoost classifier is retrained during model updates. Evaluated on two real-world public power-system datasets, the proposed method achieves 99.9\% accuracy (F1-macro 0.999) on the Synchrophasor dataset and 95.0\% accuracy (F1-macro 0.943) on the MSU/ORNL dataset, outperforming standalone baselines. Under selective label-flipping attacks, the hybrid model loses only 0.9\% F1-macro at 10\% poisoning and delays target-class collapse from 60\% to 70\% poisoning compared with raw models. These results demonstrate that neuromorphic temporal encoding can provide both accurate cyber-attack detection and improved resilience to data poisoning in cyber-physical systems.
summary_zh: 配电网络的数字化提升了电网基础设施面临网络攻击的暴露风险。现有入侵检测系统（IDS）大多依赖计算成本高昂的深度学习模型，难以在边缘端部署；同时周期性重训练过程会让系统暴露于机器遗忘攻击中，攻击者可通过选择性删除数据降低检测性能。本研究提出一种脉冲神经网络（Spiking Neural Network, SNN）与XGBoost的混合架构，将高效时间编码与轻量分类器相结合，对上述攻击具备结构层面的弹性。其中SNN在干净数据集上仅训练一次，作为固定特征提取器使用，模型更新阶段仅需对XGBoost分类器重训练即可。在两个真实公开电力系统数据集上的评估结果显示，该方法在同步相量数据集上达到99.9%的准确率（宏F1值0.999），在MSU/ORNL数据集上达到95.0%的准确率（宏F1值0.943），性能优于所有独立基线模型。在选择性标签翻转攻击下，当投毒比例为10%时，该混合模型的宏F1值仅下降0.9%，与原始模型相比，可将目标类崩溃的投毒比例阈值从60%提升至70%。上述结果表明，神经形态时间编码可在实现高精度网络攻击检测的同时，提升信息物理系统对数据投毒的抗扰能力。

title: TEFM: Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling for Structured Data
title_zh: TEFM：面向结构化数据的令牌高效可信建模
authors: Zhichao Hou, Lingdao Sha, Xueyu Mao, Yang Liu, Peijie Qiu 等 (6 人)
abstract: In this paper, we solve two fundamental obstacles in applying LLMs to critical domains: token efficiency and faithfulness. To address both constraints jointly, we present TEFM (Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling), a framework designed for structured data analysis in critical domains. TEFM achieves token efficiency by compressing lengthy structured observations into compact Behavioral Code tokens, dramatically reducing token consumption with minimal information loss. Moreover, TEFM enables faithful rationalization through a dual-fidelity objective that jointly optimizes code-level reconstruction and prediction-level fidelity, identifying minimal sufficient feature subsets grounded in input data. Comprehensive experiments across various domain datasets and model backbones (Qwen3, Gemma-2, Phi-4) show that TEFM achieves competitive classification accuracy with dramatic token reduction (approximately 1\% token retention in clinical and 2\% in security domains) while producing faithful rationales.
summary_zh: 本文解决了大语言模型在关键领域落地的两大核心障碍：令牌效率与输出可信性。为同时满足这两项约束，我们提出令牌高效可信建模（Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling, TEFM）框架，面向关键领域的结构化数据分析场景设计。TEFM通过将长结构化观测数据压缩为紧凑的行为代码令牌，在几乎不损失信息的前提下大幅降低令牌消耗。此外，TEFM通过双保真度目标联合优化代码层重建与预测层保真度，可识别出基于输入数据的最小充分特征子集，实现可信的推理过程。在多领域数据集、多种模型骨干（Qwen3、Gemma-2、Phi-4）上的大量实验表明，TEFM在取得与基线模型相当的分类精度的同时，可大幅削减令牌使用量：在临床领域令牌保留率仅约1%，在安全领域约2%，且输出的推理过程完全可信。

title: Differentially Private Average Treatment Effect Estimation by Propensity Score Blocking
title_zh: 基于倾向得分分块的差分隐私平均处理效应估计
authors: Duncan Stewardson, Grayson W. White, Adam Groce
abstract: Average treatment effect (ATE) estimation in observational studies is a fundamental statistical tool used frequently in social science, medicine, and other fields. These fields often work with sensitive data where privacy protections are important, so a differentially private mechanism for ATE estimation is highly desirable.
